III Afirki lokkolo Annassarey mayra waate saruuso na dabari nda fondo yaŋ te ga boro biyey no bayray Boro bi laabey boŋ-duura banda i ma annasaara saruusu gorandi ga tilasandi afirki borey ga I ma sijiro hanna din kaŋ ga ti tilas gorandi ma ga kala i ma konda goyo nda jine margasinay ra kaŋ kambu hinka kulu za-jindey mana bangay ga boori Afirki borey kaŋ ga bay haaley din ga sinda hina fo kulu kala yaddayaŋ i ma ye ga kambe daŋ care kambe ra yaŋo kaŋ sinda haali no gaabi ga boro biyey baafuna barmayyaŋ nda gaabi cine ra Annasaara kaŋ ka ga goro ga ngey lokkol yaŋ albeerey cawandiyaŋ nangu sinji ga cabe afirki borey se kaŋ teera hanno yaŋ no ngey ga i cawandi kaŋ ga naŋ i ma wadaata
Sanno wo ra iri ga taariifi alhaali yaŋ sanni te ga cabe kaŋ annasaarey mayra kande barmayyaŋ iri baafuna se kaŋ ga ti iri wane addiney gananyaŋey nda iri naamey darza Iri ga kalaaso kaŋ gonda boro dumi-dumi naamey nda dumey kaŋ yaŋ si koy care bande sanni te nangu kaŋ borey ga koy day no ga cawandi wala ga dondon
Cawandika goyo ga ti cawandiyaŋ I ma naŋ wo-din ma du ga te cawandika ga goy nda cawandiyaŋ fondo hinzanta kaŋ ga ti bayrayey neesiyaŋ Annasaara zaamaani kalaaso ra i ga lokkoliizey neesi no afo-fo a gar mo doŋ biirimay ra wo kwaara dottiijey no ga i neesi
Ii Taarifi neesiyaŋ Annasaarey cawandiyaŋo nufaa ga ti i ma baarici komi yaŋ cawandi kaŋ ga annasaarey ga i wane goyey nda i addiina ga Mayray fondo wo-din duma ga cabe kaŋ boro biyey hima ga annasaarey naamey caw nda koyne boro gure-gure yaŋ no hima ga du zaamaani bayrayey kaŋ bayray timmante goy hinne no i ga guna Afirki laabukoyey sambu mo kaŋ dirawey din ga ti fondo hanney iri zankey biirima se ngey kaŋ i sokon ga soola ngey wane naamey nda i addiney se
Annasaara mayra banda alwaato na barmayyaŋ beeri te a na bareyaŋ boobo te a na daŋ care yaŋ boobo te a na fayyaŋ beeri yaŋ mo te Annasaara mayra alwaato ra nda boro biyey mayra alwaato ra barmayyaŋ beeri te doŋ biirima ra Iri fisiyaŋo si dira kala kambu fo boŋ kaŋ i na batama hanse iri ma dabarey ci iri ma ci mo wo kaŋ ba hagu mo afirki borey se
Laasaabu no kaŋ i hima ga te i jine koyyaŋ fondo ra i ma daŋ ngey lakkaley ra mo i batamey zaadayaŋ i alwaato ra jamaa sokonyaŋ ra kaŋ sinda dabe hanno yaŋ Afirki borey baafuna i wane laasaabey/miiley i wane sankey haaley manti kala fondo yaŋ kaŋ annasaara ga ne i si laabu zaadandiyaŋ fondey ra Lokkol sintiney feeriyaŋo no naŋ cawandiyaŋ kambo zaada
Ii Kuray baajine hinka jamaa cawandiyaŋ nda goy dondonyaŋ doŋ biirima ra Jamaa cawandiyaŋo si te gagari hinka boŋ Gagari sintina wo almayaali nda jamaa baafunay dondonyaŋey doŋ foori-foorey ga dottijey hanganyaŋ tuurey bayyaŋ alsilaamataray nda cafaritaray bayyaŋ gagari hinkanta mo ga salaŋ naamu foorey boŋ kaŋ ga ciya jamma neesiyaŋ/yoonay kaŋ albeerey ga dum i ga i hawzu ga du to nangu hanno borey do Goy dondonyaŋ cawo si gana kala I Farmi goy dondonyaŋ Danay sacetaray garaasataray nda caakaytaray/kaymi dabarey silmaŋ ga
Ii doŋ dondonyaŋ gagari hinka neesiyaŋo fondey ma si dirgan almayaalo jamaa nda borey nango afirki biirima do haray Kundaa hinzaa kulu afolloŋ no a ga te sokonyaŋo ga kaŋ ga boro fo kulu tinayey gaayi a wane jiiro ga wala a wane nango ga jamaa ra Da baayaŋ i si ne kala bora kulu wane no dondonyaŋey duuyaŋey nda i neesiyaŋey mo kulu doŋ biirima haali no
Zamaani lokkolo cine ra boro folloŋ-folloŋ se no i ga yoona te Sijiri si no kaŋ i kayandi jaabey kaŋ te fondo ra sanni yaŋ wala bayray yaŋ kaŋ i gaayi i na i daahirandi afirki borey gora ra Amma iri naamey bayrayey zaadandiyaŋ kaŋ gonda darza yaŋ manti kabiizey laasaabante sanda zaamaani cawandiyaŋo ra I ga hin ga neesiyaŋ duurey daŋ jeeri-gaaru walhã kaŋ go ganda ra
Walhã Neesiyaŋo sokonyaŋo Kambo Bayrayey Jamaa sokonyaŋo Almayaaley nda kwaaraa mayra sokonyaŋo nda a ce-dirawo
Iii Duurey neesiyaŋ afirki cawandiyaŋ-dondonyaŋ haaley ra Afirki laabey ra neesiyaŋ bayra manti kala teera no kaŋ i gaayi cawyaŋ guuso daba boŋ a manti mo kala sanni kaŋ laabo saruusey ayey gaayi Doŋ biirima ra neesiyaŋ wo manti kala haali yaŋ kaŋ i gorandi kaŋ jamaa ga guna nda adamayze darzay bayyaŋ Ɲayzetaray nda care gaayaŋ no afirki baafunay goray ra i ga daŋ jine Naamo din kaŋ gay wo hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo kaŋ ga ti ganji hinzanta cawandiyaŋ-dondonyaŋ na a ganandi Iri ga neesiyaŋ dumi hinka sanni te walhã wo ra ga du ga di i bare-bareyaŋey kaŋ i ga hin ga te
Walhã neesiyaŋ dumi-dumey Afirki doŋ biirima neesiyaŋo Afirki zaamaani biirima neesiyaŋo Sanno tunanta Sanno nango nda a fonda baafunay gora ra Goy waaniyaŋ duure kaŋ si barmay Nangey Baafunay darzey Kaŋ ga laabo saruusey guna Sokonyaŋey fondey Almayaali nda jamaa gagaro Kalaaso gagaro Almayaali nda jamaa mamburey baafunay Cawandikey cawandiyaŋ fondey kaŋ i goray sokonyaŋo ga gaayi ga Goyo gasandiyaŋ gagari baajiney Dottiijey yaamarey Cawandiyaŋo soolaa Naamey ra teerey sokonyaŋo Cawandiyaŋ gasandiyaŋo Duurey tabbatandiyaŋ nda i daahirandiyaŋ Duurey neesiyaŋ Walhã ra i ga di fayanka beeri te ce-dirawo nda dabarey kaŋ yaŋ i goy nda ga Doŋ biirima fonda ra jamaa ga bayray fayyaŋ care se no gaabi nda i daahirandiyaŋ marganay beeri teerey ra
Dabaro kaŋ ga hagu cawyaŋ neesiyaŋo fonda ra ga ti cawandika ga cawka daŋ fondo no a wane lokkol goyo ra A ga ceeci ga a sandayey bay ga du ga a daŋ ce-diraw ce-kayante yaŋ ra a ma du ga konda nga dondonyaŋo jina Neesiyaŋ no kaŋ ga te cawandiyaŋo waate nda dondonyaŋ goy kulu ga
Haali wo-ne ra neesiyaŋ wo manti kala darza no Cawka wo se a ga naŋ a ma to jine gagaro ga a ma nga waaniyaŋey gaabo nda a sandayey waare a ma ye ga gagari fo yeera a ma fatta cawandiyaŋo ra nda a ma du sattifika wala caw banyaŋ tira fo Cawandika se cawandiyaŋ teera no kaŋ ga naŋ i ma sanka sambu ga to jine dumbaro/patarmo ga ga goy taji yaŋ sijiri ga cawandiyaŋ dabarey guna ga ye ga di mo neesiyaŋ dabarey Goyey kaŋ cawandika sijiri cawandiyaŋ haaley boŋ ga naŋ cawko fo kulu nda goy fo Goy sanniizo ga cabe kaŋ a ga tilas cawka ga a ma dondonyaŋ goyey te Cawkey hayrayey se fondo no kaŋ ga naŋ i ma du laabaari cawka kookaro boŋ nda mo i ma du baaru cawka dondonyaŋ jine-koyyaŋo ce-dirawo boŋ
Doŋ biirima ga neesiyaŋ daŋ hari kaŋ i cina jamaa goyey ra kaŋ gonda seeda yaŋ kaŋ ga naŋ borey ma bay hala i ga kookaro nda duurey daahirandi Jamaa boŋ no tinayey go i ma guna nda lakkal ga di hala cawka ga du darza fo wala a ga barmay nangu no ga du ga kambe daŋ kwaaraa baafunay nda arzaka zaadayaŋo ra I ga kocciya sambu no sanda kwaaraa kulu wane amma manti kocciya go kwaaraa ra hinne
Jamaa dabaro din ga naŋ almayaaley ma ngey zankey biirimay tilso sambu i ma haggoy nda adamayzey darzey hinne se Fonda din ra no sohoŋ iri go ga kalaasey kaŋ gonda cawko boobo neesiyaŋo mo caw
Cawandika teera hinzanta no cawo soolaa nda cawandiyaŋ bumbo banda A ga cawandiyaŋ/dondonyaŋ banandi/daabu no nda goyo nafey gaayiyaŋ Neesiyaŋ ga bangay sanda teera baajine kaŋ ga tilas i ma te cawandiyaŋ nda dondonyaŋ haaley ra A te cawandikey se boŋ haway beeri kaŋ te i se tinay nda goy beeri kaŋ yaŋ gonda nafa yaŋ i wane cawandiyaŋ dirawo se
Iii hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋ sanda laawal kaŋ ga afirki naamo nda neesiyaŋo daŋ care ga Neesiyaŋ dumi boobo no ga bara boro ga du ihinka cawandiyaŋ-dondonyaŋ haaley afirki lokkol kayney nda cawandiyaŋ lokkoley ra Ngey ga ti neesiyaŋo kaŋ ga te alwaati fo caw banyaŋ ga nda cawo hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo Sintinay wana no ga ba gumo neesiyaŋey ra kaŋ ga ti wo kaŋ cawka dondonyaŋ wana kaŋ i ga a bayrayey kulu gosi kaŋ ga ban nda jeeri nooyaŋ gonitaray nda jine koyyaŋ kalaasu fo ra A ga saba nda caw gonitaray kaŋ boro du balasyaŋ
Hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo ga naŋ boro ma bay nangu kaŋ cawka to nufa fo ga A ga naŋ i ma di hala i ga cawandiyav sijira barmay kaŋ go ga te barmay no i ma ci mo nangu kaŋ cine lokkoliizo go nufa fo se A ga naŋ koyne cawka ma bay nangu kaŋ cine a to cawyaŋ-dondonyaŋ ga a ga naŋ mo i ma a lakkalo candi cawka ma du ga faham fondo yaŋ kaŋ i ga gana kaŋ yaŋ ga gaabu/boori nda wo kaŋ yaŋ manti ya-din no boro ma janceyaŋ laasaabu te boro bumbo goyo boŋ Hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo si te kala cawandiyaŋey waate A nufaa ga ti a ma cawka fahamandi gumo fahamay ce-kayante nda jando kaŋ go nga nda nufaa game nda sandayey kaŋ a go ga di koyne a ga cawandika laabaarandi mate kaŋ cine cawkey go ga faham nda a cawandiyaŋo a ma du ga hanse se
Afirko ra iri fahamandi kaŋ neesiyaŋo hari no kaŋ bora kulu wane no care gaayaŋ nda ɲayzetaray baafunante Wo-din se no neesiyaŋo ga hin ga koy nda iri baafunay gorayey Walhã kaŋ ga ka ra iri ga hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo haaley cabe gagari sintina ra gagari hinkanta ra mo dabarey kaŋ ga saba nda doŋ teerey
Ga cabe nangu kaŋ cawka go nufa fo se I ma cawkey sokon ga i dum mo konkonse teeyaŋ i ma ngey kwaaraa taariifo i hinayey waana-waana goyo kaŋ i ga hin ga te i jine-koyyaŋo fondo ra I ga hin ga i gosi i wane hinayey kaŋ ga konkonse te i ma duurey mo yeeti ga no
I ma cawandiyaŋ-dondonyaŋ dabarey marmay Iri ma iri ganda teerey no darza bayray nda naamu sanney do haray I ga hin ga cawkey neesi i wane naamu nda gama teera silla hanney waareyaŋ ga
Cawandiyaŋo waate no a ga te I ma ganda bayrayey sokon ga i daŋ cawandiyaŋ sijiro ra ga laabo ciiney daŋ ga i cawandi cawkey neesiyaŋo si te kala cawandiyaŋ fondo fo boŋ ga du ga ganda bayrayey laasaabu i ma du ga i goy kalaaso ra
A ga cawka kookari nda a sandayey ci a se I ma gonitaray cawey sillaa te nda ganda bayrayey neesi Bayrayey neesiyaŋo si te kala bayray kundaa Hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋ haaley Fondey kaŋ i ga hin ga sasabandiyaŋ afirki ganda ra (lokkol ma ciya nangu kaŋ ga cawandiyaŋey nafa harey guna
Cawandiyaŋ satey ra cawandikey ga laasaabu ga di fondo kaŋ ngey ga sambu ga du ga cawkey ka cawkey ga gonda sanday ga Cawkey mo ga hin ga ga te kunda-kunda ga ngey sandayey ci cawandikey se
I ma haali yaŋ te kaŋ ga naŋ jamaa ma kambe lokkolo goyey nda a hawzuyaŋo ga I ma lokkoliize baabey daŋ saware i ma laasaabu lokkolo kaŋ ga ti ncawandiyaŋey nango I ga hin ga lokkliizey neesi hayrayey kambe daŋyaŋo nda i goyey lokkolo hawzuyaŋ ce-diraw fondo ra
I ma boro ma dondon boro boŋ se no gaabi sanda mate kaŋ a go iri doŋ teerey ra Cawandikey ga goy marguyaŋ goy-jinayey soola I ga cawkey neesi i wane goy marguyaŋ gonitatara ga I ga hin ga i neesi mo i wane goy hattayaŋey hawzuyaŋo nda hanseyaŋo boŋ
Afirki baafuna/arzaka nda naamey haaley ga naŋ dondonyaŋ nda teera boobo ma te I ga di kaŋ laawaley nda dabari yaŋ wo go no Cawandikey cawandikey jine-funey lokkoliizey hayrayey nda lokkliizey bumbey hima ga i warci no cawandiyaŋ haali dumi-dumey ra laabo arzakaa boŋ nda i ma i daŋ biirimay cawandiyaŋ sijirey nda nafa goy fondo ra Wo-ne ga ciya fondo kaŋ ga batama baafunay/arzaka zaadandiyaŋ boona gaabandiyaŋ ga du ga cawandiyaŋo boŋo bare goyteerey cawo do-haray kaŋ ga boori farmi nda kura se A ga naŋ batama nafa-harey ma du darza Alhaali fo mo ra a ga boori i ma cawandiyaŋ sijirey boŋey bare ga du ga lakkaley barmay i ma cawka mo lakkalo feeri caw-tirey darzandiyaŋ ga I ga hin ga cawandiyaŋ sijiri gorandi kaŋ ga nafa-harey nda hinayey din kulu mo no darza I ga hin ga ngey wo cabe caw-boŋey wo ra Gonitarayey caw-boŋ ga dondonyaŋ goy baajiney gonitarey kaŋ i ga gaabandi nangey kaŋ yaŋ i ga i gasandi daŋyaŋ alhaaley nda neesiyaŋ kaŋ i ga goy nda dumey
Iii mate no i ga neesiyaŋ ce-kayante te nda kalaasey kaŋ gonda dimmaa beeri Jomtien ga koy dakar teera kundaa afirki laabu boobo na kookari beeri yaŋ te ga lokkol furoyaŋ no gaabi Za alwaato din no kalaasey dimmey beeri waana-waana gomnanti lokkoley ra Cawandikey kaŋ sinda cawandiyaŋ gaabo kalaaso hawzuyaŋ nda a neesiyaŋ gonda dimma beeri yaŋ Haali wo-ne ra a ga boori iri ma iri boŋ hã mate no i ga te ga ye ga cawandiyaŋ fondey nda dabarey kaŋ ga naŋ cawkey ma dondon cawandikey mo ma du ga cawkey duurey neesi Cawandikey hima ga ye ga di ngey cawandiyaŋey sijirey guna nda i wane neesiyaŋ ce-dirawey Iri ga dabarey sijiri kaŋ ga naŋ i ma neesiyaŋ goyey daŋ borey goray ra
Iii cawandiyaŋ fondo tajey Hunkuna cawandiyaŋ fondo taji yaŋ go no kaŋ ga no daama i ma cawandiyaŋo te afo dumi dondonyaŋo afo dumi neesiyaŋo mo afo dumi cawandiyaŋ taji fo dumi kaŋ ga cawkey kambe daŋyaŋo no gaabi cawandiyaŋ teerey barmayyaŋ neesiyaŋ dumey bare-bare nda goy nda gonitaray yaŋ Dabari wo-ne no iri ga sijiri araŋ se laasaabu-kar care ga-toonandi kaŋ ga hin ga koy lokkoliize dimma beeri A si dira kala fondey nda ce-dirawey wo dabaro wo i na a te no kaŋ cawkey kulu ma ngey boŋ daŋ dondonyaŋ ce-dirawo ce-kayante ra sata yaŋ ra Cawkey ga laasaabu sanda fo wala hããyaŋ fo boŋ afo-fo day i ma tuuyaŋey kar care ga nda caley waney ga i ma tuuyaŋ hanna toonandi ngey kunda beero do Ce-diraw I ma ganji beerey waare ihanney wala wo kaŋ i ga bay kaŋ ga sandi cawandiyaŋ se
I ma hããyaŋ fo te i ma naŋ cawko fo kulu ma nga laasaabo te alwaati kayna ra I ga hin ga ne boro kulu ma nga tuuyaŋo hantum i ma du ga i daahirandi se
I ma boro hinka-hinka sata boobo hã tuuyaŋo kaŋ i du Cawandika ga hin ga gagari wo-ne wo hawzu a ma hã boŋ wolanteeru yaŋ ga i ma salaŋ wala a ma tombala te ga boro hinka sata hã
Iii dondonyaŋ dumi-dumey I ma sijiri dondonyaŋ haali tajey se nufey kaŋ ga i ba i ma to se i ma mo daŋ i cawandiyaŋ dabarey kaŋ i ga hin ga te se Wo-ne ma ga hala i ga dondonyaŋey neesi a ga boori i ma haali hagantey nda bare-bareyaŋey kaŋ go gagari hinza game laasaabu) dondonyaŋ nufey) cawandiyaŋ goyey) neesiyaŋ dabarey
) Dondonyaŋ nufey bayray fo no wala goy waaniyaŋ fo no cawka hima ga waani cawa banda Mate kaŋ i ga dondonyaŋ nufa hantum nda ne-ya
Iii neesiyaŋ dumi-dumey Cawkey dondonyaŋey neesiyaŋo si bara kala dondonyaŋ/cawandiyaŋ ce-dirawo ra A du ma ga boori se ga te ce-kayante ce-diraw wo-ne ga te a se ganji I ma dondonyaŋ haali te kaŋ ga naŋ cawka ma goy fo te Goyo din teeyaŋ ga cawka hima ga du sanday fo i ga gaakasinay hããyaŋ te a se nda tilasandiyaŋ nda nafa hari yaŋ no a se Hala a ga gaakasinay hããyaŋ nda tilasandiyaŋ nda nafa-hari guna cawka ga laasaabu ga bayray taji cina cawo nufaa Bayra din hala a ban ga a waare a ga hin a ma goy nda goyo waate
Doŋ biirimay nda dondonyaŋ ce-dirawo manti kala caw fondo hinka kaŋ furo afirki baafunay gorayey sokonyaŋo nda ce-dirawo ra Laabiizey i wane biirima diiyaŋo ga mana ngey boŋ daŋ kala haali hinza ra kaŋ ga ti toonandiyaŋ care gaayaŋ nda ɲayzetaray

Afirki zankey alhakkey laabey-da-cara sanni-beerey tira tajey boŋ teera hanno no amma kaŋ si wasa Afo day poltik sanka kulu kaŋ i sambu kaŋ ga koy ga saba da laabey-da-cara fondey gonda sanday yaŋ za i ne i ma goy d'ey da cimi Kokor-banda jiiri-wayey ra afirki laabey gaabey gaze gumo Tina kaŋ i dake i boŋ arzakaa sogonyano nda gomnati hawzuyaŋ hanna ma ga na dolle ka laabey nda ngey zankey ga (adepoju thomson) Afirki wayna-kana ra laabey kan ga ci niizer burkina faso singal kuduwaaru wala binin na ngey boŋ tilassandi ka tiney kaŋ go ngey boŋ dake satey kaŋ go ngey boŋ-goray ra boŋ nda laabo wala laabey-da-cara satey kaŋ go ngey boŋ-goray ra boŋ ga-baano nda cawandiyano do haray
“dabaro-din no ga kande gomnati ma goy nda satey kaŋ go ngey-boŋ-goray alwaati banda kaŋ nga d'ey na kambe daŋ goy-tira yaŋ ga tira kaŋ ga boro kulu ga ze ka alkawli toonandi hari kaŋ ga naŋ sijiri maanante kaŋ ga ci albeerey cawandiyano nda i bayray-duura” (mcapln fita) Laabu foyaŋ wo na ngey laabu-gandey ka-banda kaŋ ga sijirey kulu maanandi laabo gunda ra haray borey se dogonay ma du ga te amma nooro nda goy-jinayey sambayano te sanday kaŋ naŋ sijiro-din kafana Nooro nda goy-jiney ma ka da latiyaŋ beeri wala i si ka pat-pat Kaŋ manci wo din laabey-da-cara- gaakasinay sata kaŋ hima ga ka-bandayano no gaabi man du fondey kulu kaŋ ga naŋ a ma goyo te mate kaŋ ka-bandaa ma goro ga boori ga saba da afirki naamey ra teerey (hyden) Hala day ka-bandayano waana-waana lokkol kayney do hara ga naŋ gaakasina ma nafa borey se a ma si te sabiili kaŋ ga naŋ gomnati ma laabo-gandey kaŋ ga maana yababe
Ya-din ga jandi beeri goono sankey kaŋ gomnatey sambu afirki zankey alhakkey boŋ da alhaaley kaŋ si ga timme sankey din fondo ra Alhaaley wo si bangay day kala laabey kaŋ go lakkal-tunay ra do Laabey-wo ga ba afirko ra zama no-din zanka boobo zuru ngey hayrey banda ka ngey laabey naŋ Gomnatey nda poltiko borey jaŋ-ka-bayra laabey-da-cara ciiti fondey kaŋ ga zankey alhakkey guna te tafar kaŋ ga jamaa kulu ganji i ma wa-faku gurja din ra(akkari nda sagayar)
Za gayyaŋ no laabey-da-cara na zankey dan-goyo ganji zankaa kaŋ ga goy wo hina-siiyaŋ beeri hinka no go a ga a go zanka a go talka Fonda-din ra no i ga wata ka zankaa daŋ goy tinoyaŋ ra wala teera laaloyaŋ ra(bit) Afirki kwaara-beeri boobo ra zankey go fondey boŋ i sinda sutura i sinda saajaw i ga barkar gunde ra haray ma i taanu doori-doora kaŋ man ci teerra laaley kaŋ ra i ga furokonkonsa boobo ra i cabe kaŋ afirki zankey kaŋ go goy ra dimma ga koy ga to ngey boro milyo ne ka koy jiiri Haali kaŋ ga te afirki gomnatey nda a poltikiizey se garan-garaŋ guguri Talka-tara day no kande afirki zankey ma furo goy (adamsi)
Zankey talfiyano boro se hima da i ma moy dan a ga ga boori Fuula-kwaaray koyey satey nda alfagey hima ga albeerey kan ga zankey dan goy jukke Al-umma naamey neesiyano hima ka iri fahamandi da zankey goyo wo Fu alhaaley no i ga guna ka faham da taaley nda suujey kaŋ go zankey goyo ra Andunna talaato fahama kaŋ anniya ga ci zankey ma fun-korfo i ma si ye ka goy si lakkal di da boro ga zankey nda ngey hayrey ka koy al-umma kulu alhaalo bay(abebe nda bessel) Da boro sambu fulaniize kayna alman-kura kaŋ a ga te gonda nafa da a si ganji a ma cawyaŋ kulu te Tabbat wo-din hima ka koy kurayyano ga kaŋ si kande hayrey talkatara ma si i daŋ i ma fizaw kuruyano wala cawo
Waasu ka hiijandiyano nda wayborayzo daŋ-banguyano wo balaawu no kaŋ ga zanka milliyo yaŋ ga-baano nda lakkaley sara sanku afirko ra (moody) Kokari beeri go ga te bo amma yeeni go a ra zama taaley na kaaji jayante te al-umma naamey ra Fondo ra tina kaŋ go lokkol boŋ gonda himma Da i du ka wayborayzo gaayi lokkol kala a ma to jiiri ka koy jiiri i ga waasu-ka hiijiyano nda hayyaŋ-waasa ganji a ga naŋ mo zankey-din ma caw ka to nangu kaŋ i ga caley yaamar balaawey-din ga kaŋ ga ci dan-banguyano nda lokkol fattayano Balaawey wongo ra bora kulu hima ka kambe- dan- care-kambe- ra lokkolo bumbo cawkey hayrayey cawandikey nda al umma kulu Silmano ga ci da i na wayboro-cawandikey dimma tonton a ga hin ga wayborayzey zuga i ma caw ga te cawandiko yaŋ wala ka hima da ngey wayboro-cawandikey (stromquist nda al) Balaawu taaco lakkal-tuna kaŋ ga ci zankey kaŋ ga zuru nangu fo ga ka na i bon-zayano ganji zama zankey-din si hallasay ra ba kayna kogondo-laabey nda niizer bumbo go tangamo din ga
Lokkolo bayrayey-da-cara fondey Laaabey-da-care-game ra hijira fondo ra azawa-kambe laabu boobo na diraw tajiyaŋ daŋ ngey cawandiyano sijirey ra ka koy ka saba da boro dumi-dumi boobo naamey(akkari nda radhouane) Dandi-kamba laabey wo waana-waana afirki laabey dirawey-din ce si ga kay wala mo nangu fo-fo no a go ga te-te wala i ma di ga dondon taray haray
Iri ga miila mo kaŋ afirki nda niizer ga hima nangu yaŋ kaŋ ra naamey-da-care biirima hima ka te diraw-taji Iri ma si dirgan kaŋ mayray-futa kaŋ ga iri na zaamani lokkolo tubu no na iri afirki naamey nakasandi Iri laabey bon-duura banda iri si daahirandi kaŋ lokkolo na lakkal daŋ kwaarey nda laabo naamey ga Fondo wo-ne ra iri hima ka naamey-da-cara dirawey burkin(aman)
Iri ciiney nda afirki naamey kaŋ sinda gaabi lokkolo ra no kande kaŋ bayray duura si kubay Iri ga bay mo kaŋ i si ga fonda gana kaŋ ga zanka kulu hima ga caw nga ciina ra ba day a ga ci a lokkol- jiiri-sintiney waate no jiirey da jiirey ba mo kaŋ ceeciyaŋ guusey cabe kaŋ cawandiyano tabbatanta gonda hanfaani boobo (cummis) Alwaato to i ma naŋ iri afirki ciiney ma furo cawo ra Za jiiri ra unesco laabey-da-cara cawandiyano bira na tira fo ka kaŋ ma “ i ma cawandi i ma du bayray ciine-boobo cawandiyaŋ ga” A yaamar afirki wayno-kana laabey ma cawandi da ciine-hinka Tiraa-din man jeeri kala burkina niizer nda singal cawandiyaŋ sijirey ga A cabe mo kaŋ i hima ga goy da ciine-hinkaa cawandiyaŋ dumi-dumey kaŋ goono laabey ra (bie unesco) Ciine-hinka cawandiyaŋ ce-kayante yaŋ te sanda niizer nda afirko ra nangu fooyaŋ (malan garba) schneuwly nda al benso) A cindi i ma tonton wo-kaŋ goono ga i ma du cawandiyano boorey kulu yardaa
Iri di kaŋ dumey-da-cara sabayano kaŋ go kuduwaaru dumi fo yaŋ game ra hima ga te dondonyaŋ hari niizer Sabayano-din si te kala dumi hinka wala dumi boobo game ra Sanka no borey ga sambu care se ka hiijandi care se Kuduwaaru wano kaŋ se i ga ne”toukpé” za kaayi kaayey waate no i na sankey-din sambu ngey game ra a na foori-ka-sinay (baasataray) no gaabi borey ga fooru da care i ga care hahara salma-haaray ra kaŋ sinda futay care se
“za don-don no baasatara-din furo borey game ra Teera fo yaŋ kaŋ te i game ra no na baasatara-din sijiri (kayne nda beere game ra almayaali hinka da cara game radumi hinka da cara game ra) Fodo kulu dumi ra no baasatara-din gana ka furo A na yanje ganji borey game ra borey ga care gaakasinay i ga fooru da care i ga hiiji care ga Wo-din ga kande lakkal-kanay borey game ra jamaa ma margu ka te boŋ follon”(insiata)

Irikoy ne Harey ma fundikooni boobo hay kaŋ ga yooje wo kaŋ yaŋ gonda fundi Curayzey mo ma deesi beene batama ra ndunnya se beene Irikoy na teeku ham bambatey mo taka da fundikooni kulu kaŋ ga yooje wo kaŋ yaŋ ga nyuturu-nyuturu harey ra a ni taka ngey dumey boŋ A na curo kulu kaŋ ga deesi mo taka nga dumo boŋ Irikoy di kaŋ woodin mo ga boori

Waati kulu borey kaŋ kwaaraa borey suuban kwaara bumbo ra dondonandiyaŋo () ma ga no ga furo a jine Care bande no koyciya dondonandiyaŋo nda a beera ga te mate kaŋ a ga hima nda sanda mate kaŋ abdou moumouni dioffo (fita) na a filla
Afirki doŋ biirima wo se (mungala p) Afirki doŋ biirima go ga goy/nafa nda nga kambe goy-jiney nga hina deedandi arzaka poltik nda baafunay alhaalo ra ga kookari ga boro yaŋ no bayray hanno kubante
Afirki naamey ce-dirawo ra cawandiyaŋ goy jiney ga ba gumo ba kaŋ se hantumi si no I ga haggoy nda ciina waaniyaŋo zankaa wala furotajo cawandiyaŋo ra Jandi faajikaaray foorey humburkomay kambe-goy dondoandiyaŋey ga ti goy-jiney kaŋ i ga goy nda fonda din ra (abdou moumouni dioffo unesco mungala caille)
Naamey ra biirima caw nafaa Ba kaŋ se taali boobo go afirki doŋ biirimara (hantumi jaŋay dondonyaŋ saruusi wala sata sanda lokkol nda kalaasu jaŋay sijiri jaŋay wkc) a gonda darza cimcimi yaŋ
nangu kaŋ doŋ biirima nda zaamani wano ga hima care ga ti kaŋ adamayze boŋ no cawandiyaŋ dumi hinkaa kulu ga goy (zanka furo-taji arkusu beeri) ga du ga a no bayray goray waaniyaŋ nda goy waaniyaŋ kaŋ ga koy nda a booney nda jamaa ce-diraw fondey Hari kaŋ i fay mo baayaŋo kulu si kala i ce-dirawey nga goy-jiney kaŋ i ga nafa nda ga ngey nufey gasandi do hare Doŋ lookol maana karni ta lokkolo se fahamey sanney Cawko yaŋ kaŋ gonda laasaabu hanno kaŋ du doŋ biirma nda zaamaani cawo danga wo kaŋ i ga te nibarsite abdou moumouni ra no na laasaabu te za gayyaŋ doŋ biirimama zaamani lokkolo gaabandi a ma du ga to nga nufey ga Ba sohoŋ laasaabo gonda gaabi alhaalo kaŋ ra hunkuna lokkolo go se
Laasaabey kaŋ i te Doŋ biirimawo ba kaŋ se a alhalo ga a ga hima hari kaŋ bisa hunkuna a bara sanda bayray kaŋ te zaamayaŋ afirki ra Zaamayaŋo mafaarey ga ti kaŋ a ga goy nda cawkey baafunay nda i windanta alhaalo a cawey sokonyaŋo cawkey nda jamaa booney laasaabuyaŋo wkc Alhaaley wo kulu i hima i ma i laasaabu no da i go ga cawandiyaŋ ce-dirawo nda cawandiyaŋ tirey sijri no da i ga ba hunkuna lokkolo jine-koyyaŋ fonda ra caagaley ganandi Iri ma care fongandi kaŋ lokkolo wo go ga du sanday boobo kaŋ go ga a ganji a cawandiyaŋo ma boori a ma te mo nafa Wo-din se no a ga hima hunkuna iri ma laasaabo din tajandi naamey cawandiyaŋo boŋ cawandiyaŋ ce-dirawey ra ga du ga i cawandiyaŋ fondey bay sandayey bonzayaŋ fondo ra Abdou moumouni tar ga lasaabo wo te zama a di a nafa (dioffo p)
Abdou moumouni miila ga ti i ma biirimay hinkaa din ma koy care bande (doŋ nda zaamaani waney) kaŋ ga naŋ i ma boro kubante yaŋ biiri ga cawandi kaŋ ga konda ngey laabo jina Haro wo mo arzaka baafuna nda poltik fondo ra kaŋ ra barmayyaŋ go ga furo kayna kulu lokkol kaŋ ra i na cawyaŋo sokon sijiri-kayna yaŋ nda mo cawandiyaŋ ce-diraw kaŋ ga mooru waati kulu baafuna
Care ra gora kaŋ i go ga ceeci gasu afiriki sohoŋ boro fo kulu biirimay hinkaa din na a barmay (naamey nda zaamaano) Nangu fo te-goyey kaŋ borey sambu do hare mo iri hima ga ceeci ga ihanney bay wo kaŋ yaŋ te mafaari afirki biirima ma zaama
Fayando kaŋ go biirimay/cawandiyaŋ nda dondonandiyaŋ game ra Biirimay gonda kuray hinza kaŋ ga ti cawandiyaŋ (bayray duuyaŋ) alhaali cinayaŋ (lalabu nda laabiizetarey boŋ cawandiyaŋ) nda windanta kambe-goyey dondonyaŋ (goy kaŋ ga kande albarka kambe-goy tandey nda kambe-goyteerey goy cindey do goyteeri yaŋ wkc) Kuray hinzaa wo kulu no i ga hima ga laasaabu da i ga ba i ma ne i na cawyaŋ kubante no cawka se
Cawandiyaŋo ga hima no a ma dondonyaŋo nda goy ra furoyaŋo te care bande Fonda kaŋ ra a ga te ga ti i ma ne cawandikey ma garay-garay goy yaŋ te kaŋ ra i ga windanta kambe-goyey byrayey daŋ Habu boŋ caw fo silmaŋ ra cawandika si kay cawandika tiraa fotey wala tiyaatar-kayney hinne ga nda cawkey habu cabeyaŋ se A ga hima no a ma i dirandi ga kond'ey habu a ma du ga windanta din cabe cawka se waana-waana alhaaley kaŋ boŋ cawo ga te (hayciyaŋ dayyaŋ neerandi dayko neerandey gisiyaŋ nangey wkc) Da i ye ga ka kalaaso ra a ga ne cawkey ma goy nda hari kaŋ i di ga habo cabe ga faajikaarey kaŋ i du nda neerekey yeere wkc Da cawo mana saba nda habu zaaro za kaŋ barmayyaŋ ga hin ga furo alwaato sijiro ra cawandika ga hin ga a sosorandi wala ga a sarandi ga a te habo zaaro hane
Afirki laabey ra baafunay teerey waana-waana nizeer laabo borey ga care sokon no ga naamu foori yaŋ gorandi kaŋ ga ci ya alwaati beeri yaŋ kaŋ boro ga nangu barmay (baafunay addiini)
Boro ga du tabbatandiyaŋ a wane hiney ra ga goy kaŋ koy jamaa se te Afirki wayno-kaŋey laabey ra darza nooyav nda i dondonyaŋ goy ga no i ga a te jamaa ra ga du ga to bayray fo gagari ga laabaari nooyaŋ nda naamu ganayaŋ ce-diraw ra Jamaa care sokonyaŋo din si ga goro kala fondo yaŋ nda naamu haali yaŋ kaŋ ga dondonyaŋ no gaabi hala care nda cara no nda dottijey (chan c et al) (sanni kaŋ i hima ga faham ne sanda borey kaŋ ga ciya wadde nda wadde lakkalkooni kaŋ i ga sambu di ga dondon borey kaŋ koy ga diy'ey nda i yadda ga ciya tilas jamaa sanni hanno kulu ga
Dumbi hinkanta ga salaŋ hari kaŋ ga hin ga bara doŋ birima nda dondonyaŋey neesiyaŋo afirki ganda teerey game ra Nga no ga ti i ma hããyaŋ te biirimay neesiyaŋey darzey nda annasaara lokkol waney ce-dirawey boŋ (yerly)
II Laabey doŋ biirima teerey darzey Moumouni (p) no na afirki doŋ biirima seeda baajiney kaŋ ga jamaa naamey cabe Nafa beeri no a gonda almayaaley nda jamaa do Kundaa nda jamaa haali Boŋ daŋyaŋ gomni teeyaŋ nda lakkal baafunay fonda ra Haali hanno duuyaŋ kambu kulu ra Zanka lakkal nda ga-hamo zaadayaŋ kayna-kayna
Afirki laabiizey wo alwaati kulu no i ga goy kambe ga kambe ra kaŋ gonda care nooyaŋ nda care gaayaŋ Doŋ goray wo-ne dumi ga kaayi-kaayey addiney goyey no gaabi nda boro kulu yaddayaŋey adamayzetaray beerayey ga Wo-din se no caille (p) na miila wo-ne ci doŋ biirima fondey kaŋ baafunay teerey darzandi Dumi waani-waaney nda boro biyey care sokonyaŋo si kala fonda hinka kaŋ ga wo kaŋ se borey waafaku i ma ne doŋ biirimay darzaa/naffa cabe zama a sinda wadde no a ga haggoy nda laabiizey ibaayo kaŋ ga kond'ey jine
Almayaali ra jamaa kambe daŋyaŋ biirimay gagari sintina Afirki almayaali go zanka se sanda nangu kaŋ ɲa nda baaba tataliyaŋ hallasay nda biirimay nangu kaŋ ga dondonyaŋ fondo boobo feeri a se Kocciya ɲaŋo no ga a hallasi a ma ciya wayborayze wala alborayze Jamaa ra goray alwaati no kaŋ ga zanka daŋ nangu kaŋ (caille p)
Baabo wala ɲaŋo boŋ no a go i ma kocciya daŋ fondo a ma furo jamaa goy ra (goy jamaa goryey wkc) a ma ndunɲɲa bayray nda hariyaŋ kaŋ ra a ga nga kambe daŋ jamaa goray teerey ra Baabo no ga kocciya jina ga furo tajo cawandi nda alboro goy mate ka baabo no ga kocciya cawandi cine ɲa mo ga wandiyo kayna ga wandiya cawandi hari kulu ka baabo no ga kocciya cawandi ga koy nda wayboro wala ɲa goy (caille p)
don biirima teerey barmayyaŋ guuso Doŋ biirima du barmayyaŋ beeri kaŋ annasaarey kaayaŋo kande alwaati mo kaŋ na baafuna fondey butugu za kaŋ a mana jamaa goray fondey nda naamu fondey sambu (ki-zerbo)
Annasaarey cire furoyaŋ mana teerey hinne barmay bo a na ba boro biyey bayrayey daŋ care ra gumo-gumo ga i tilasandi i ma naamu fo teerey dondon kaŋ ga koy nda fondo yaŋ kaŋ i gaayi (akkari & dasen) Afirki borey ga miila kaŋ lokkol nda baafuna manti kala a folloŋ no afirki borey baafunayey ra kaŋ yaŋ ga hayyaŋ no darza zankataray nda biirimay go a se beene i ga goborotaray hinne goray nda hari baakasinay no gaabi» (caille p Xiii) Zanka wo laabo kulu arzaka no jamaa ra kaŋga fay mate kaŋ hantumkey na a ci nda (caille p) wo kaŋ annassara mayra waate cawandiyaŋo kar ga say
afirki zanka ga goro wayborey jare ga (sanda mate kaŋ boro ga goro tuuro tiksa ga) (caille ibid P Xiii) hala i ga bora sambu sanda boro kaŋ ga jamaa kulu nafa afriki doŋ biirima ra
Wo-din se no a wane alwaati sintina ra (caille p Xiii) Laasaabo din kaŋ naŋ kocciya ma ciya boro kulu wane wo ciine si no koyne annasaara lokkolo diiyaŋ ga
Cawandika goyo ga ti cawandiyaŋ (araŋ ma faham ga ba kaŋ goy no kaŋ maana ga ti i ma boro no bayray nafante a ma du ga nga hinayey tonton ga du gonitaray goy kambu fo ra) I ma naŋ wo-din ma du ga te cawandika ga goy nda cawandiyaŋ fondo hinzanta kaŋ ga ti bayrayey neesiyaŋ (fondo sintina ga ti cawo soolaa hantumyaŋ ihinkanta mo cawandiyaŋo) Annasaara zaamaani kalaaso ra i ga lokkoliizey neesi no afo-fo a gar mo doŋ biirimay ra wo kwaara dottiijey no ga i neesi
Annasaara mayra banda alwaato na barmayyaŋ beeri te (i ma i neesi) a na bareyaŋ boobo te (i ma i ci) a na daŋ care yaŋ boobo te (i ma i fahamandi) a na fayyaŋ beeri yaŋ mo te (i ma faham i se) (bancel et blanchard) Annasaara mayra alwaato ra nda boro biyey mayra alwaato ra barmayyaŋ beeri te doŋ biirima ra Iri fisiyaŋo si dira kala kambu fo boŋ kaŋ i na batama hanse iri ma dabarey ci iri ma ci mo wo kaŋ ba hagu mo afirki borey se
Ii Kuray baajine hinka jamaa cawandiyaŋ nda goy dondonyaŋ doŋ biirima ra Jamaa cawandiyaŋo si te gagari hinka boŋ (caille) Gagari sintina wo almayaali nda jamaa baafunay dondonyaŋey doŋ foori-foorey ga dottijey hanganyaŋ tuurey bayyaŋ alsilaamataray nda cafaritaray bayyaŋ gagari hinkanta mo ga salaŋ naamu foorey boŋ kaŋ ga ciya jamma neesiyaŋ/yoonay kaŋ albeerey ga dum i ga i hawzu ga du to nangu hanno borey do (furtaji nda sambantaasi i ma du ga baafunay tinayey sambu) Goy dondonyaŋ cawo si gana kala I Farmi goy dondonyaŋ (boro ma dondon fari goy hayrayey wala beerey bande nda kuray (boro ma konda almaney kuray) Danay sacetaray garaasataray nda caakaytaray/kaymi dabarey silmaŋ ga
Ii doŋ dondonyaŋ gagari hinka neesiyaŋo fondey ma si dirgan almayaalo jamaa nda borey nango afirki biirima do haray Kundaa hinzaa kulu afolloŋ no a ga te sokonyaŋo ga kaŋ ga boro fo kulu tinayey gaayi a wane jiiro ga wala a wane nango ga jamaa ra Da baayaŋ i si ne kala bora kulu wane no dondonyaŋey duuyaŋey nda i neesiyaŋey mo (jamaa ra goy fo ga nangu/gagari daahirandiyaŋ) kulu doŋ biirima haali no
Zamaani lokkolo cine ra boro folloŋ-folloŋ se no i ga yoona te Sijiri si no kaŋ i kayandi jaabey kaŋ te fondo ra sanni yaŋ wala bayray yaŋ kaŋ i gaayi i na i daahirandi afirki borey gora ra (akkari & dasen) Amma iri naamey bayrayey zaadandiyaŋ kaŋ gonda darza yaŋ manti kabiizey laasaabante sanda zaamaani cawandiyaŋo ra I ga hin ga neesiyaŋ duurey daŋ jeeri-gaaru walhã kaŋ go ganda ra
Baafunay darzey sokonyaŋ Baafunay darzey sillaa nda i nafa bonkoonitaray mayra ra Baafunay darzey kanandiyaŋ kunda-kunda Kwaaraa bayrayey sillaa nda cawey fahamandiyaŋ Naamey ra teerey fahamandiyaŋo Naamey ra teerey sokonyaŋo nda furtajey kaŋ i go ga si darzey (kookarey) sifayaŋ seedey Bayrayey daahirandiyaŋ Neesiyaŋ fondey fahamandiyaŋ i wane kambo nda i wane bayrayey dondonyaŋ gagaro boŋ
Iii Duurey neesiyaŋ afirki cawandiyaŋ-dondonyaŋ haaley ra Afirki laabey ra neesiyaŋ bayra manti kala teera no kaŋ i gaayi cawyaŋ guuso daba boŋ a manti mo kala sanni kaŋ laabo saruusey ayey gaayi Doŋ biirima ra neesiyaŋ wo manti kala haali yaŋ kaŋ i gorandi kaŋ jamaa ga guna nda adamayze darzay bayyaŋ Ɲayzetaray nda care gaayaŋ no afirki baafunay goray ra i ga daŋ jine Naamo din kaŋ gay wo hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo kaŋ ga ti ganji hinzanta cawandiyaŋ-dondonyaŋ na a ganandi (cawandiyaŋ soola hantumo nda cawandiyaŋo bumbo) Iri ga neesiyaŋ dumi hinka sanni te walhã wo ra ga du ga di i bare-bareyaŋey kaŋ i ga hin ga te
Haali wo-ne ra neesiyaŋ wo manti kala darza no (perrenoud) Cawka wo se a ga naŋ a ma to jine gagaro ga a ma nga waaniyaŋey gaabo nda a sandayey waare a ma ye ga gagari fo yeera (hala a tibi) a ma fatta cawandiyaŋo ra (kaayaŋ) nda a ma du sattifika wala caw banyaŋ tira fo Cawandika se cawandiyaŋ teera no kaŋ ga naŋ i ma sanka sambu ga to jine dumbaro/patarmo ga ga goy taji yaŋ sijiri ga cawandiyaŋ dabarey guna ga ye ga di mo neesiyaŋ dabarey Goyey kaŋ cawandika sijiri cawandiyaŋ haaley boŋ ga naŋ cawko fo kulu nda goy fo Goy sanniizo ga cabe kaŋ a ga tilas cawka ga a ma dondonyaŋ goyey te Cawkey hayrayey se fondo no kaŋ ga naŋ i ma du laabaari cawka kookaro boŋ nda mo i ma du baaru cawka dondonyaŋ jine-koyyaŋo ce-dirawo boŋ
Doŋ biirima ga neesiyaŋ daŋ hari kaŋ i cina jamaa goyey ra kaŋ gonda seeda yaŋ kaŋ ga naŋ borey ma bay hala i ga kookaro nda duurey daahirandi Jamaa boŋ no tinayey go i ma guna nda lakkal ga di hala cawka ga du darza fo (maa) wala a ga barmay nangu no ga du ga kambe daŋ kwaaraa baafunay nda arzaka zaadayaŋo ra I ga kocciya sambu no sanda kwaaraa kulu wane amma manti kocciya go kwaaraa ra hinne
Hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo ga naŋ boro ma bay nangu kaŋ cawka to nufa fo ga A ga naŋ i ma di hala i ga cawandiyav sijira barmay kaŋ go ga te barmay no i ma ci mo nangu kaŋ cine lokkoliizo go nufa fo se A ga naŋ koyne cawka ma bay nangu kaŋ cine a to cawyaŋ-dondonyaŋ ga a ga naŋ mo i ma a lakkalo candi cawka ma du ga faham fondo yaŋ kaŋ i ga gana kaŋ yaŋ ga gaabu/boori nda wo kaŋ yaŋ manti ya-din no boro ma janceyaŋ laasaabu te boro bumbo goyo boŋ (shahvali et zarafshani) Hanseyaŋ neesiyaŋo si te kala cawandiyaŋey waate A nufaa ga ti a ma cawka fahamandi gumo fahamay ce-kayante nda jando kaŋ go nga nda nufaa game nda sandayey kaŋ a go ga di koyne a ga cawandika laabaarandi mate kaŋ cine cawkey go ga faham nda a cawandiyaŋo a ma du ga hanse se
Iii mate no i ga neesiyaŋ ce-kayante te nda kalaasey kaŋ gonda dimmaa beeri Jomtien (nduɲɲaa laabey ceeyaŋo kaŋ i bangandi kaŋ bora kulu ma koy lokkol ne ga koy annasaara jiiri) ga koy dakar teera kundaa (i ma tu cawyaŋ baajiney ga ne ga koy annasaara jiiri) afirki laabu boobo na kookari beeri yaŋ te ga lokkol furoyaŋ no gaabi Za alwaato din no kalaasey dimmey beeri waana-waana gomnanti lokkoley ra Cawandikey kaŋ sinda cawandiyaŋ gaabo kalaaso hawzuyaŋ nda a neesiyaŋ gonda dimma beeri yaŋ Haali wo-ne ra a ga boori iri ma iri boŋ hã mate no i ga te ga ye ga cawandiyaŋ fondey nda dabarey kaŋ ga naŋ cawkey ma dondon cawandikey mo ma du ga cawkey duurey neesi Cawandikey hima ga ye ga di ngey cawandiyaŋey sijirey guna nda i wane neesiyaŋ ce-dirawey (prosser et trigwell) Iri ga dabarey sijiri kaŋ ga naŋ i ma neesiyaŋ goyey daŋ borey goray ra
Iii cawandiyaŋ fondo tajey (cawandiyaŋ dumi waani fo) Hunkuna cawandiyaŋ fondo taji yaŋ go no kaŋ ga no daama i ma cawandiyaŋo te afo dumi dondonyaŋo afo dumi neesiyaŋo mo afo dumi cawandiyaŋ taji fo dumi kaŋ ga cawkey kambe daŋyaŋo no gaabi cawandiyaŋ teerey barmayyaŋ neesiyaŋ dumey bare-bare nda goy nda gonitaray yaŋ (chamoux) Dabari wo-ne no iri ga sijiri araŋ se laasaabu-kar care ga-toonandi kaŋ ga hin ga koy lokkoliize dimma beeri A si dira kala fondey nda ce-dirawey wo dabaro wo i na a te no kaŋ cawkey kulu ma ngey boŋ daŋ dondonyaŋ ce-dirawo ce-kayante ra sata yaŋ ra Cawkey ga laasaabu sanda fo wala hããyaŋ fo boŋ afo-fo day i ma tuuyaŋey kar care ga nda caley waney ga i ma tuuyaŋ hanna toonandi ngey kunda beero do Ce-diraw I ma ganji beerey waare ihanney wala wo kaŋ i ga bay kaŋ ga sandi cawandiyaŋ se
I ma hããyaŋ fo te i ma naŋ cawko fo kulu ma nga laasaabo te (laasaabu) alwaati kayna ra I ga hin ga ne boro kulu ma nga tuuyaŋo hantum i ma du ga i daahirandi se
I ma cawkey hã i ma ngey tuuyaŋey kar care ga nda ngey caley wana nda sata kayna fo (kar care ga) i ma saba tuuyaŋ fo boŋ
I ma boro hinka-hinka sata boobo hã tuuyaŋo kaŋ i du (toonandi) Cawandika ga hin ga gagari wo-ne wo hawzu a ma hã boŋ wolanteeru yaŋ ga i ma salaŋ wala a ma tombala te ga boro hinka sata hã
Iii dondonyaŋ dumi-dumey (waani neesiyaŋ) I ma sijiri dondonyaŋ haali tajey se nufey kaŋ ga i ba i ma to se i ma mo daŋ i cawandiyaŋ dabarey kaŋ i ga hin ga te se Wo-ne ma ga hala i ga dondonyaŋey neesi a ga boori i ma haali hagantey nda bare-bareyaŋey kaŋ go gagari hinza game laasaabu) dondonyaŋ nufey) cawandiyaŋ goyey) neesiyaŋ dabarey
Iii neesiyaŋ dumi-dumey (waani neesiyaŋ) Cawkey dondonyaŋey neesiyaŋo si bara kala dondonyaŋ/cawandiyaŋ ce-dirawo ra A du ma ga boori se ga te ce-kayante ce-diraw wo-ne ga te a se ganji I ma dondonyaŋ haali te kaŋ ga naŋ cawka ma goy fo te Goyo din teeyaŋ ga cawka hima ga du sanday fo i ga gaakasinay hããyaŋ te a se nda tilasandiyaŋ nda nafa hari yaŋ no a se Hala a ga gaakasinay hããyaŋ nda tilasandiyaŋ nda nafa-hari guna cawka ga laasaabu ga bayray taji cina cawo nufaa Bayra din hala a ban ga a waare a ga hin a ma goy nda goyo waate
Doŋ biirimay nda dondonyaŋ ce-dirawo manti kala caw fondo hinka kaŋ furo afirki baafunay gorayey sokonyaŋo nda ce-dirawo ra (akkari et dasen) Laabiizey i wane biirima diiyaŋo ga mana ngey boŋ daŋ kala haali hinza ra kaŋ ga ti toonandiyaŋ care gaayaŋ nda ɲayzetaray
Cawandiyaŋ sijiro ga hin ga te ga boori sanda silmaŋ ga i ma nafa-hari ce-kayante yaŋ kaŋ ga koy nda baafunay gorayey a ga cawkey goyey ci Ce-dirawo mo dondonyaŋ neesiyaŋey kaŋ ga koy nda boŋ wasayaŋ care gaakasinay nda ɲayzetaray darza hinza kaŋ ga alboro kaŋ ga jamaa nafa soola nda alboro kaŋ a arzakaa ga a muraadey te (remillard) Iri ga ci kaŋ iri mana hari hinka sambu kaŋ i hima ga caw goy gonitarayey kaŋ go cawandikey se doŋ biirima boŋ nda iri doŋ bayrayey kaŋ ra i hima ga du nafa-hareycawandiyaŋ lokkoley hina kaŋ ga cawandikey cawandi i ma iri baafunay teerey sambu sanda di ga dondon hari cawandiyaŋ haaley ra nda dondonyaney neesiyaŋ ra
Sannize baajiney yaasay cawandiyaŋ-dondonandiyaŋ ciine-naamu sanni waaniyaŋey cawandiyaŋ ce-diraw Boŋ-jina Dumey kulu ra no i ga yaasey te wala i ma i sambu dumi waani fo ra Doŋ borey ga no i na i tubu wala bine i na i te/cina alwaati kaŋ mana mooru gumo ga fahamandi mate kaŋ borey bara nda + (wala i ga miila i go) ga ci mate kaŋ boro fo kulu go ga di nga cala ga baafunay alhaalo cabe Sanni alhaali dunguriyo maanakoyey kundaa ra no i go sanda sanni ganji yaasayze sanni dunguryo sanniize… Da baayaŋ kulu sooro yaŋ no kaŋ gonda maana kaŋ jamaa baafunay bayrey no i ga toonandi borey do ga i boŋey feeri Alhaaley kaŋ i ga a bay nda ga ti kongu bandayaŋ nda bayray nooyaŋ Wo-din se no i ga ba ciiney cawyaŋo nda adamayzey baafuna cawyaŋo Sanni dunguriyey wo cawyaŋo no kande cawo kaŋ ma yaasey cawo

no (bornand p) Me-sanni goy no kaŋ ra maaba ga wangaarey teerey kaŋ te taariifo ra kaŋ ga dambarandi deede Borey kaŋ se wangaarey din deeda ga kaanu se no i ga a tewangaaritarey deeda kar ga say yaŋ cine ra maaba ga goy nda faakaaray dabari dumi yaŋ sanni dumi-dumi yaŋ ga wangaarey kaŋ i go ga ce sifa Me-sanni ciine no maabey wangaaritarey tariifey deedey gonda hari yaŋ kaŋ manti me-sanni hinne (gaagaari ɲootandiyaŋey boro dondonyaŋey haari-haarey caale-caaletaray care gunayaŋ) wala mo jinda ga (sawti barmayyaŋ jinde barmayyaŋ jindey sambuyaŋ nda i ye ganda yaŋ)
Naamu batuka nufaa wangaaritaray deeda ga ga ti afo day a ma jamaa kaŋ ga ba ngey ma ma ngey wangaarey tarzamey lakkal ye nga ga ga i farhandi Ihinkanta a ma teerey gorandi borey kulu lakkaley ra a ma te (saibou adamou & issoufou) Wangaaritaray deede gonda seede yaŋ kaŋ ga a fay nda deede cindey
Wangaaritaray jaabi seeda fo kaŋ ga waana afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey ra ga ti deeda alwaato Hari kaŋ ga waana nda jamaa me-sanni cindey ga ti kaŋ nga wo i si a deede alwaati kulu amma kala jamaa baafunay fondo fo yaŋ boŋ silmaŋ ga hala daŋ bangiizey fooro ga te Bucey din waate maaba beerey no ga wangaaritaray deede dumo te Alwaato kaŋ i ga daŋ ga wangaaritaray deede din te mo ga ku (biebuyck) A ga hin ga te guuru yaŋ wala zaari yaŋ (seydou) sanno ga sundiyaata wangaaritara deeda si te kala hinne hala i ga kama-blon kaŋ go kangaba maali laabo ra jiiri iyye ga ka jiiri iyye fuwo hanseyaŋ batey te Kaŋ na a ka wangaaritaray deeda alwaato i ga jamaa kaŋ ka ga hangan suuban no bora darzaa wala a kunguyaŋo nda safari se Silmaŋ ga sanda mate kaŋ (seydou ibid) na a ci nda mandingu wangaaritara deeda wo bonkoonitaray almaayaali maabey hinne no ga a deede Amma wangaaritaray deede kaŋ ga ciya goy fo wane si te kala borey kaŋ ga goyo te jine ga i fongandi nda i teera beerey goyo zaadayaŋ ma ga
me-sanni dumey kulu kaŋ i doonu wala i deede ra wangaaritaray deede ga waana nga wo moolo no ga sanno dum Moolo nda sanno no ga koy care bande ga maaba deeda boryandi ga a baafunandi (fobah eblin p) ga jaabo no darza a ga kambe daŋ a cinayaŋo da a sokonyaŋo ga Kesteloot nda dieng (pp-) wo se Wangaaritaray deeda gonda darza beeri koytaray batamey kulu ra kaŋ ra a sintin
Sintina day wangaaritaray deeda wo foori hari no A wane dursayaŋo manti kala bine-farhãy nda kuluuje jamaa se Fondo no kaŋ ga jamaa ga gana ga ngey bine-kaanay nda kuluuje cabe Haarey no wangaaritaray deeda ga taŋ doŋ dottijey ga kaŋ fari goy na i taka-baraw sanda sohoŋ borey mo kaŋ yaŋ go ga tangam nda nduɲɲa baafunay bine-hasarawo Borey boney gasandiyaŋ fondo ra kaŋ ga ti (chevrier p) a ga hananandiyaŋ nda safari goy yaŋ te Koyne a wane zamuyaŋ fonda ra mo a ga hangankey zuga zugayaŋ kaŋ si hin ga te kala nda sanni deedandey nda jandiizey Ciiyaŋ jaabo din nda moola kaŋ ga a dum nufaa ga ti a ma jamaa lakkalo di a ga naŋ i ma ma kaani ga daaru Deeda si tu kala mate kaŋ barthes () na a ci nda bine-kaanay kaŋ ga naŋ jamaa ma kuluuje Amma ce fo yaŋ boro ga hin ga ne kaŋ jamaa go ga ma wangaaritaray deeda teeyaŋo waate
Wo-din banda wangaaritaray deeda ga jamaa baafunay poltik nda i diiyaŋey goy te hala a ga salaŋ boro fo kaŋ te darza a alwaato ra boŋ Teerey beerey zamuyaŋey din ga te a himcarey se di ga dondon i baafuna ra Wangaaritaray deeda maanaa ga jamaa zuga ga koy poltik goy ga a ga te mo kaŋ jamaa ma care di nafa fo ma ga kaŋ fondo ra jine-fune fo go ga tangam Koyne a ga naŋ borey ma care di jamaa ma care margu ga te afo Wangaaritaray deeda ga hima i se diji alhaali kaŋ ra i ga di ngey boŋ i wane baafunay teerey laasaabey i wane diiney waana-waana i wane borey kaŋ baafunay dumey kaŋ i ga ba ngey ma te ga du ga bay ngey ya boro kaŋ yaŋ no Jaabi kaŋ gonda maana a ga lakkaley yeeti sinjiyaŋ ga (vettorato sp)

Afirki wayno-kaŋa wangaaritaray deeda maabey dudalo gande Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey ra maabayzo wangaaritaray deeda jaabo cawandiyaŋ ga te nangu hinka ra almayaalo ra nango kaŋ boro ga sintin ga dondon nda cawyaŋ batama do nangu kaŋ boro ga kambe goy dondonyaŋ go Almayaalo windanta ga ti kocciya cawandiyaŋ batame hanna sanda mate kaŋ ogandaga (p) na a ci Nangu sintina no kaŋ maabayzo ga nga sanni dondonyaŋ sintina te nga hayrayey kuruyaŋo ra
«boro folloŋ goy dondonyaŋ [wangaaritaray deeda kambo do hare] ga naŋ hayra ma nga izo no bayray goy waaniyaŋ nda haali yaŋ kaŋ ga koy nda almayaalo baafunay alaadey nda goyey (diouf mbaye & nachtman p) Maabataray cawandiyaŋ dudalo tabbatanta wo maabey no a ga guna (wo kaŋ yaŋ boŋ konkonsa te saaga nda liboore nizeer laabu nda kirina maali laabu)
Batamey din ra wangaaritarey deeda si te kala alwaati kuuku ra a ga salaŋ mo (camara p) a gonda mo nga goyey kaŋ i ga jin ga te nga gagarey nda nga fondey
Maabey dudalo boŋ wangaaritaray deeda waaniyaŋo gonda goy yaŋ jina Hala i ga a cawandi a ga tilas cawka ma funa maaba banda ga (enkerli) Nooru kulu kaŋ cine burciniize ga wi wala jinay kaŋ a ga no a si hin ga furo dudalo din cawo ra Wo-din hala i ga cawo sintin sanda mate kaŋ iri laabaari nookey na a ci nda maabayzo hima ga baranda jiiri ga koy laasaabay kaŋ ga ti alwaato kaŋ ga koy nda cawyaŋ nda laabaari gaayiyaŋ Jiiro kaŋ i ci nafa fo ga ti kaŋ alwaato din zankey mana sinti ga di sanday kaŋ ga i lakkaley ta ga i ganji i ma dondoŋ ya-din no laabaari nooko fo ci
Hala boro ga koy dudalo cawo do a ga tilas mo i ma maabayzo soola nda safari nda ŋwaaray Wo-din ga hin ga te burciniize wala almankooniize atciriya hari kaŋ i na a ɲumay nd'a haŋyaŋ wala ɲumay nd'a yaŋ Teera din no ga maabayzo saaya tonton a gonitaray goyo ra a ga cabe mo kaŋ a mana burciney kambe banda Wo-din banda no i ga a dondonandi ne-ciine Wo-din se i ga goy nda biiri boobo sanda gurum/tirayze yaŋ kaŋ ga a bayrayno lakkal ga tonton Hala ba wo-ne ga te a hima ga du no jina (dolz & schnewly p)
Wangaaritara deeda cawandiyaŋo gonda gagari boobo Annasaara jiiri faakaaray fo kaŋ furo jaliba baaje nda garba game ra bangandi borey se gagari hinza Afo day za jiiri iyye no cawka ga sintin ceeyaŋ wala kaayi ceeyaŋ kaŋ ga ti burcini almayaali fo kaayey maayey zamuyey wala almayaali tuuri-ɲaŋo ciiyaŋo Wo-din banda no deede dondonyaŋ kaŋ ga ti wangaarey taarifey ga ka Bananta ga kaŋ ga ti gagari hinzanta moola kaŋ ga sanno dum dondonyaŋo no (pp-)
Dondonyaŋ ce-dirawo nda a gagarey banda iri ma to sohoŋ kay mate kaŋ cine i ga wangaaritara deeda bayra dondon nda maabey dudaley boŋ Wo-din se i na cawandiyaŋ soola yaŋ gorandi kaŋ ibeero ga ti dudalo kaŋ se i ga ne cawandiyaŋ nango Nga no ga ciya kalaaso kaŋ ra cawandiyaŋo goyey ga te A wane ce-dirawo se i ga jinay yaŋ kaŋ i ga nafa nda margu sanda tonyaŋ tuuri nda hayni kwaari kaŋ i ga ton Cawko kayney no ga jinayey din margu Cawandiyaŋo din ra cawandika ga goy nda dabari boobo sanda wangaaritaray deeda kulu wala deeda jara (patarmi-patarmi) ci nda gaabi yaŋ Gagaro din ra nga no ga ti salaŋko beero satto din cawkey wo ga hangan day no
Dabaro kaŋ i ga goy nda gumo wangaaritaray deeda cawandiyaŋo ga ga ti sanniizey kaŋ ga koy care banda (toulou p) Cawyey yeerayaŋ no afo-fo kaŋ cawandika ga te Wo-din banda cawka ma sanney yeera mate kaŋ cine sintinay bora na a ci nda
Cawkey daŋ goyo ra yaŋo ga maaba cawandika mo ga cabe goyo baagasinay beeri waana-waana cawandiyaŋo fondey Za goyo sintina maaba ga bangandi cawkey se cawo kaŋ boŋ i ga salaŋ ya din ga bayra kaŋ i ga dondon Cawandika ga ci no kaŋ sinda tuguray kulu sanda silmaŋ ga kaŋ goyo ga sintin nda dumitaray tuuri-ɲa deede yaŋ Cawandiyaŋo fondey kaŋ cawandika ga ci ga ti a ma fahamandi cawka se hari kaŋ a ga dondon Koyne mo cawandika ga ci a cawka se cawandiyaŋo ce-dirawo nda a tilas haaley kalaaso ra Goy baagasinay alhaali ga maaba cawandika ga goy nda bayray kaŋ a tubu kaŋ ga ti (sensevy mercier & schubauer-leoni sp)
Afriki wayno kaŋey laabey wangaaritaray deeda jaabo fondey bayrayey dumbi wo-ne si salaŋ kala afirki wano-kaŋay laabey wangaaritaray deeda boŋ sanda me sanni wo dumo kaŋ i ga hin ga cawandi annasaara lokkol ra Alhaalo wo no ga cabe kaŋ i ga hin ga a cawandi liise jiiri sintina faransi ciine kambo ga Amma fonda ga ba i ma cawey maanaa fondey nda dabarey ci Iri ga bay wangaaritaray deeda gonda nufa boobo (nufey din kulu i na i sanni te dumbey kaŋ bisa ra) kaŋ ga hin ga naŋ i ma a cawandi liise nda koloozey ra Cawandiyaŋo ce-dirawo ga te nda suurey kaŋ ga koy nda faransi ciine cawandiyaŋo nizeer ra Deeda wo cawandiyaŋ sijiro fahama si kala sanney wo ra Sintina day wangaaritaray deede kulu ga cabe kaŋ adamayse baafunay haaley gonda cawyaŋ nda fahamay boobo Koyne taarifo kambo do haray wangaaritaray deeda ga naŋ furtajey ma hari kaŋ te ga bisa nda i kaayi taarifey bay
Cawandiyaŋ fondey kulu murciyaŋ kaŋ wangaatarey deeda ga sambu ga naŋ zaamaani lokkolo ma si ciya ga barmay ga te (saibou adamou & hamidou p) Anniya kaŋ ga te silmaŋ ga i ma wangaaritaray deede cawandi nizeer ra si te kala nda liise faransi ciine cawandiyaŋo nufey nda sijiri-kayney ra Laabaari nooyaŋ nda me-sanni nda hantum hiney tonton Dabarey nda fondey kaŋ ga fahama ciiti nda ka tarayyaŋ zuga Boro ma du naamu kaŋ ga koy nda alwaato kaŋ ga goy nda hari kaŋ go ga te nduɲɲaa ra (koloozey nda liisey ra faransi ciine cawandiyaŋ sijiri-kayna fita
Nufa sintina ga ti wo kaŋ ga gaabi daŋ Ne-wo wo i ga hin ga goy nda wangaaritaray deeda nafa-harey ga du ga cawkey goyo gonitara dogonandi ga a zaadandi Fonda wo ra kaŋ i suubaŋ ga ti (adam) Hala i jeeri ce-dirawo din ga i ga hin ga wangaaritaray deeda dumo liise sanda suura dumbari ra (deede ciiyaŋ nda fahamandiyaŋ…) Caw dumi kulu si te kala cawandiyaŋ dumbari haali ra kaŋ ce-dirawo mo gonda patarmi boobo Silmaŋ ga ciiney hima care seedey cawo ga iri ga sijiri araŋ se dumbari deeda kaŋ gonda nufa wo-ne yaŋ
Deeda dumbaro ce-dirawo ga te patarmi boobo ra cawey kaŋ i gaayi boŋ Patarmi sintina ga cawandiyaŋo goyo ga hin ga te wangaaritaray deeda suuraa cinaro nda a cawey bayyaŋ sorro cawyaŋ cawiizey kaŋ ga naŋ sorra ma care ganayaŋ nda maaney kaŋ yaŋ ga koy care banda suuraa kambey ma du ga care gana ga boori ma ga Patarmi hinkanta ga goy ga hin ga te wangaaritaray deede suuraa borey boŋ Cawey murceyaŋey no a ga gana sanda wangaaritaray deeda suuraa sokonyaŋo sijiro borey nda i wane goyey nda mo cawo ce-dirawo Patarmi hinzanta ga batama nda alwaato kaŋ ra wangaaritaray deede go ga te nda cawiizey wo haaley alwaato nda batama goyey taarifi deede nda goy batama nda alwaato seedeypatarmi taacanta maaba te diiyaŋey wangaaritaray deeda bayyaŋ (diiyaŋo ganayaŋo do haray) Kokoranta patarmi guyanta ga salaŋ suura deeda boŋ nda sawto
Deeda dumbaro ce-dirawo banda laasaabo ga koy nda jine nda liise wangaaritaray deeda cawandiyaŋ fondo hinkanta kaŋ ga hin ga te A si furo mo kala faransi ciine sijiri kayna hinzanta nufaa ra wo kaŋ ga ti Nga no ga ti i ma wangaaritaray deeda naamu darza cawandi nda yaasa kaŋ ga ne (ourghanlian sp) cimi no afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey wangaaritara deeda naamu nda boŋ bayray ma ga wangaarey deedey gonda luga boobo wangaarey boŋ I cawandiyaŋ liisey ra ga hin ga naamo tuku Cawandiyaŋ fondo wo ne ra nufey kaŋ i go ga ceeci ga ti afirki cawko tajey ma Adamayze darzey nda naamey kaŋ wangaarey kaŋ bisa yaŋ gaayi bay Darzey din te nga wane ga du ga du haali taji
Wo kulu banda boŋ-jina cabe kaŋ i ga hin ga wangaaritaray deeda cawandi liise a goy booba se A cawandiyaŋo si te kala fondo hinka boŋ afo ciine sanni no afa mo naamu sanni no Fondo sintina ga i ga cawandi no sanda suura dumbari hinka hala i na dumbari te i na i sijiri jina cawandiyaŋ fo kulu dumi ga Patarmi boobo no i ga dumbaro cawandi nda kaŋ yaŋ gonda ngey nufey ngey cawey nda ngey dabarey Naamu fonda fa ga dira lalabuyaŋ adamayzetaray nda baafunay cawandiyaŋ nda dondonyaŋ darzey boŋ I cawandiyaŋ ga wangaaritarey deeda ga adamayze darzante dumi fo bangandi kaŋ ga te di ga dondon cawkey se kaŋ yaŋ ga du (van zanten & rayou p)
Kayfuru i ga doona ga ne kaŋ hayyaŋ banda wo biirimay no ga cindi Day ifo ga ti biirimay ya-din ga Biirimay sanniizo maaney ga ba gumo kala i si a maana cimcimo bay Annama ba kaŋ se a maaney ga gaabu i ga fay-fay mo iri ga ne kaŋ afo kulu nufaa ga ti Bayrayo kaŋ ga no cawko fo kulu hima ga du no ga kande goy waaniyaŋ nda goray waaniyaŋ Baba moussa a r malam moussa l & rakotozafy j (fita) ne Kundaa ra baafunay hanna banda (care ra goray waaniyaŋ biirimay) biirimay ga hima ga naŋ adamayze ma du hina kaŋ ga laasaabu (nga bumbu nda boro cindey) mate kaŋ nduɲɲaa kulu laassabey go nda (lalabay biirimay)
Wo-din se no a ga hagu i ma ceeciyaŋ te a boŋ ga du ga faham nd'a Georges snyders si/ceeci ga kande fahamay fonda wo ra a tiraa kaŋ ma jine-koyyaŋ cawandiyaŋo doŋ biirima nda biirimay tajo A sanno ga doŋ biirima sanniizo gonda maana waani-waani hinka kaŋ ga ti «biirimay alhaali fo dumi nda wo kaŋ go no sohoŋ kulu marganta kaŋ i si ga fay-fay kaŋ ra kay-kayyaŋey nda darayyaŋey kaŋ fun sohoŋ gazeyaŋey ga (snyders fita)
Iri ma ceeci ga snyders laasaabo fisi Maana jina kaŋ a no kaŋ ga ti biirimay alhaali fo dumi ga borey fongandi laasaabo kaŋ annasaara jiney te biirimay boŋ Boro jiney wo manti mo kala annasaara yaŋ I ra alain kaŋ ma cimcimo ga ti emile-auguste chartier go no emile durkheim go no jean-yves château go no nda afo yaŋ koyne Borey jiney wo kulu se doŋ biirima daba manti kala anniyaa kaŋ i sambu ga konda koyciya/cawka (snyders p) Te-goyey wo nafaa ga ti kaŋ i ga hima hari yaŋ kaŋ a ga dondon kaŋ ga a daŋ fondo kaŋ ga a ma kaanandi ga a no darza ga a fondey feeri Doŋ biirima maana hinkanta snyders se ga sohoŋ lokkolo cabe nda nga duumi taali dumi-dumey kaŋ i ga hima ga hanse waati kulu
Marcel inné (p) wo se Cawandiyaŋo wo dumi ce-dirawo gonda dondonandiyaŋ te-goy yaŋ kaŋ i ga te ga dake-dake care ga kaŋ ga goy nda jamaa ra goray alhaali nda baafunay ce-diraw boŋ Teere no kaŋ kwaaraa arkusey ga te borey kaŋ mana nin jina boŋ Kunda jama ra baafunay boŋ no doŋ biirma ga dira A ga koyciya waaniyaŋo fahamay gagaro carma nda a ga-hamo hina laasaabu A nufaa ga ti a ma koyciya no bayray bayray nooyaŋ mo si te kala naamey ra kaŋ si yadda i ma goy nda hari kaŋ mana hagu
Afirki taarifo nda a naamay ra gonda sabiiliyaŋ kaŋ ga ndunɲa laabiizetaray bayra gorandi Care beerandiyaŋ care ba-kasinay ɲakafosinotaray dabuyaŋ kaŋ se borey gurjay jiirey nda jiirey sanda “mande sijiri-beero” kaŋ ka ga te waazu borey ma yarda care ga care beerandiyaŋ nda lakkal kanay fondo ra(unesco fita) Me-da- me ga no i na mande sijiri-beero-din kar-ka-say ndunɲa ra A ga mun-adamayze fundi no darza boro kulu gonda fondo a ma ba-funay borey ma saba ka te afo kaŋ fayanka si i game ra wayborey alhakkey te-ni-baayi fondey ciiti hanno sasabandiyaŋ nda care diiyaŋ sijiri-beero ne al-umma kulu ma goro lakkal-kanay ra boro kulu da nga naamo da nga bayra laabo ma goro gurbi follonka ra i ma si a fay me-ŋwaaro ma wasa ci-ni baayo ma tabbatandi
Laabey-da-care-game ra margaa kaŋ i te bayray tontonno boŋ kaŋ se i ga ne “ ndunɲa laabiizetaray bayra ma zaada afirki wana-kana ra” Kaŋ unesco sogon jiiri kaŋ na cdeao laabu margu ne kaŋ fahamay-janay kulu si laabiizetaray nda ndunɲa laabiizetaray bayra game ra I na laabey kulu kan ka marga do yaamar i ma bayraykooney nda laabaari-nooyan-fondey boney feerri ndunɲa-laabiizetaray-bayra boŋ i ma cawandikey nda caw sogonanta nda wo kaŋ i man sogon borey kulu bayrayey tonton i ma hino-borey nda hawzukey nda lokkol sasabey jine funey nda caw-tira hantumkey nda cawandiyaŋ goy-jinayey kaŋ ga ndunɲa-laabiizetaray-bayra guna nda lakkal-kana nda borey alhakkey I ne mo i ma sijiri ka zaamaani-laabaari-nooyaŋ fondey boŋ kaŋ ga borey boney-feeri ga du ga goy d'ey I ma i yaamar i ma fondo-dogono ka laabey-da care-game nda laabu-gandey game ra kaŋ ga al-umma zuga i ma kambe daŋ teera-hanney nda fondo-tajey dirawey ra (unesco)
Sanno bananta ka ci iri ma bay kaŋ laasaabo nda hanseyano kaŋ iri hima ga te da a ga ci niizer no da a ga ci afirki bumbo no ndunna laabiize-taray-bayra duure hima ka afirki naamey ce-gana kaŋ sinda i ma teera-waani yaŋ sambu ka daŋ care ra Da iri sambu sata-kayney do wayboro nda alboro sanno hima ka te da lakkal niizer ra kaŋ si borey turandi Mate kaŋ (pelizzari na a ci da) dabo kaŋ go lokkol-bayray-duura nda borey alhakkey ga hima ka bangay al-umma nda adamayze bayray cawko beerey laasaabu-beeri banda
Boŋ-jaro wo kaŋ go cawandiyaŋ tira-beero ra ga hin ga kande boŋ-feeray kaŋ ga niizer cawandiyano boryandi Goy-jinay no kaŋ i ka taray iri ciine taaci ga kaŋ i ga hin ga daŋ ka cawandikey dondonandi se wala cawandikey bumbo kaŋ go laabo talaato kulu ra ma goy d'a fondo kaŋ ga hagu da nangu-nangey ra Da iri ga ba afirko cawandiyaŋ fondey ma boori bora kulu hima ka kambe-daŋ-care-kambe ra cawandiko cawkey nda ngey hayrey ka cabe kaŋ lokkolo nda al-umma ga ba dondonyaŋ (bougma nda al)
Taarifo fuumey Da iri bay kaŋ niizer al-umma tuubiyano banda no alkuraana cawandiyano ka iri ma yarda kaŋ cawo-din gay jiirey nda jiirey (hamani) Nibarsite-beerey bangayyano sanda sankore wana kaŋ go tombouktou (mali) nangu-beeri boobo kaŋ i ga alkuraana caw sanda agadez wala wo-kaŋ man gay say wana (niizer wayna-kana ra) no ga iri cabe kaŋ alkuraana cawo gay afirki wayna-kana ra Kaŋ na a ka “târikh” hinka kaŋ taarifi-ciiko beerey ga goy d'ey afirki gando wo ra al-maghili tira-beero kaŋ ga ci tuuyaŋ iyya kaŋ i kande askia hããyaney se cabe mate kaŋ no hino-borey nda niizer –ganda borey na alkuraana cawo no gaabi za jiirey-da-jiirey
Dudal no i ga ne naamo ra alkuraana cawo se hari kaŋ go ga kande candi-canda foyaŋ (meunier dir) Za mayray-futa waate annasarey si ga naanay dudalo din ga zama a si koy ka saba da anniyey kaŋ go i se Kaŋ annasaara bay kaŋ nga si hin ka dudalo ganji ka nga lokkolo tilasandi borey ga kulu a na madarsa feeri kaŋ ra i ga laarabu-ciina cawandi naanay ma furo nga nda borey game ra Madarsa si cawandi faransi-ciiri nda laarabu-ciine da alkuraana bayrey foyaŋ faransi-ciine caw buuna-buuna jare ga Madarsaa-din ga annasaara nafa zama a ga no a ga alfagey bay a ma du ka fitinantey kuru
Alkuraana cawo mata kaŋ a go ga te naamo nda zaamaano game ra Jiiri zanguri ra dudalo cawo nda madarsa cawo go ga alkuraanaa cawo te care banda Amma madarsaa no gomnati go ga saajaw ba day kaŋ dudal ba d'a Wo-din na hirri dan zaamaani lokkolo da naamey game ra nga ka kande (coulibaly) zaamaani lokkolo wo kambuwo-korfo haali kulu no si a maanandi da borey teerey nda borey kaŋ a ga miila nga go ga gaakasinay naamey
Fondo follonka ra sow() go ga joote kaŋ hala ka ka sohõ cawkey hayrayey baayaŋ kulu si bay i fo no ngey izey go ga caw zaamaani lokkolo ra sanku i ma miila ka kande ngey gaakasinay cawo sijirey se Sow ye ka tonton ka ne iri go ga di hima-ka-sinay jana kaŋ go al-umma nda lokkolo game ra Iri ga bay mo kaŋ hari kulu kaŋ na jandi daŋ zankey lokkol bayrayey nda i naamey bayrayey ga ga naŋ i bine-ma-fun lokkolo ga(meunier dir) Wo-din si zanka nafa zama a go ga candi canda ndunnaa hinka game ra bayrayey kaŋ a du naamo do nda bayrayey kaŋ doole-doole lokkolo ga ba ka a no kaŋ sinda a se maana wala nafa
Alkuraana cawandiyano do (mahamane mahaboubou) di kan barmayyaŋ boobo te madarsey nda za mayray-futa man ka dudaley do Amma ihinkanta day no barmayey din gunacinarey nda ce-dirawey nda lokkol koyyaŋ alhaalo cazwandiyaŋ baajine-baajiney cawandikey banandey nda i wone jine-koyyano nda cawo sogonyano i ma ngey ga-feeri lokkolo sijiri beero se nda wkc Barmayyaney baayaŋ kulu si fun kala al-umma ga i ga hin ka fun mo gomnato wala satey kaŋ go ngey boŋ-ma ga do Miila hanney kulu kaŋ borey te siiyaney wo boŋ man te dabarigayante jannay mata kaŋ (mahaboubou na a ci da) Alwaato-din ra alkuraana ga cawyaŋ lokkol boobo kaŋ zaamaano alhaaley man tuku go ga jamaa kulu candi ga kande cawko boobo boro yaŋ no kay i se i zaadayano ra Walhã-beeri wo-ne kaŋ go ganda no ga cabe barmayyaney kaŋ te lokkoley-din moy-duma nda i ce-dirawey ra
Alkuraana ga cawandiyano taarifo ra iri di kaŋ fondo hinka ra no a dira boŋ-ga dursayano nda hantumo kaŋ ga te da kambe wala mansin(godin) Kaŋ ga naŋ alkuraana ga cawandiyano ma zaada a ma nga nufey kubandi cawandikey ga dabari dumi-dumi kulu barmay
Mate kaŋn barbata-koyey na sourate hantum da i ne alhaalo kaŋ ra zumbuyano te annabi mohamad (psl) nda maleyka zibirilla (kaŋ ka cawandiko gurbi ra) kubayyaŋ sintina te annabi se sanday Sanday beeri ra no a du versets gu sintiney sourate ra Fonda-din ra iri ga hin ka faham da cawandiyaŋ ce-diraw hinka) boro kulu si du bayray da ni man taabi da ni man gurzugay da ni man muraadu yaŋ wi) kaŋ ga naŋ dondonyaŋ ma tabbat kala boro ma du cawandiko ce-kayante
Mate kaŋ sourate na a ci da verset ra alkuraanaa dumbari-dumbarey kaŋ a zumbu da mafaaro ga ci annabi mohamadu (psl) ma du ka dontoney gaayi i ma boori mate kaŋ i go ga cawandi da I na a ganji a ma waasu ka wo-kaŋ yaŋ a du filla zama dontonka daahirandi kaŋ nga cawandiyano sinda sikka (alkuraan)
Sanda boŋ-jare verset na al-umma cawandi da da-beeri iddu kaŋ alsilaama hima ka du ndunna ka guna alaahara boŋ-ye-gandayaŋ ka jingar (salât) i ma mooru furkutaray i ma zakat ka i ma sutura i ma hagoy da amaana nda talfi jingar beerandiyaŋ Boŋ-jare (verset) na da beerey wo filla a ye ka afo yaŋ tonton i ga
Alkuraana na nga boŋ-cabe sanda munadamayze kurko (sourate verset) Verset zanguri boobo no i ka alhaaley kaŋ ga munadamayze faaba boŋ Ndunɲaa ba-funa wo mafaaro ka ci boro kulu ma irkoy daahirandi nda nga diyawo kaŋ ga ci annabi mohamadu (psl) ka nga boŋ wa da furkutaray Wo-din si te kala munadamayzey ma du bayrey boobo wo-din se i ga batu bayrayukooney ga i ma al-umma cawandi hari kaŋ ga boori nda wo kaŋ si boori I hima ka i kabarandi kaŋ suba banando si saba borey kaŋ yarda nda borey kaŋ murte game ra (alkuran) Fondo follonka ra no i ne kaŋ bayray ceeciyaŋ go alsiilaama kulu boŋ Annabi ne mo kaŋ bayra ceeciyano go alsilaama kulu bon za a hay kala a koy ga tu nga koyo se sanda ndunɲa ba-funa kulu waate
alkuraana caw-ba-jiney fondey Alkuraana caw-ba-jiney fondey go nangu kulu haray Tira-beero wo ga te nga bumbo cawo se fondo nda alsilaamataray bayray foyaŋ kaŋ se a ga te ganji tikisa wala gaabi Wo-din ka kande kaŋ “alkuraana cawyaŋ” nda “alsilaamataray cawan” koy ga hima care ya-din mo no maana follon ka no Iri ma faham kaŋ i si alsilaamataray cawandi kaŋ manti da alkuraana ya-din mo no i si alkuraana caw kaŋ manti alsilaamataray fondo ra Ciito boŋ bora kulu ga bay kaŋ alkuraana ga ci ciiti fondo sintina alsilaamataray addino kulu se (ramadan) Wo-din se nga ga ci ciito cawo se ganji nda sandayey kulu barbatey cinaro Ciito borey ga du alkuraanaa ra verset nda dabari boobo kaŋ ga te seeda yaŋ cimi wala taari bangandiyaŋ ga A ga te gosi yan batame sanda carmay bine-laasaabu gaayi-da-bine laasaabu sanni waaniyaŋ nda wkc Nga cawyaŋ ganjo fondo ra alkuraana ga furo cawandika nda cawka game ra ka te batame kaŋ ra i ga gonitarey dumi-dumi yaŋ bangandi kaŋ ga bayray-guuso fo yaŋ nafa
Da i ga ne “alkuraana cawyan” sanno din gonda maana boobo kaŋ ga za za cawo sintina ka koy bayray kulu kaŋ dumi no ga Kaŋ na a ka me-ga-cawo caw-ka-doono goono (tajwîd) kaŋ ga no cawo gonitara ga bangay tafsir mo goono kaŋ ga borey fahamandi bangayayano alwaatey nda hari kaŋ i kande Wo-din ga cawkey fahamandi i ma si daray ka sanney dan care ra I ga bay kaŋ madiina wala makka no bangayyaŋ wo-ne fun Ga ka ka tonton wo-din ga dabey nda fayankayaney cawo kaŋ go caw-boŋ verset da care game ra sanku nangu kaŋ verset fo ga ka ka a fo sanni barmay nga ka ci sanni-wiiyaŋ bayra Kaŋ na a ka bayrayey wo alkuraanaa cawka ga larabu ciina dondon Amma zaamaani wo-ne ra za lonkonta (jiiri sintina) no cawkey ga ciina dondon
Bayrey wo-ne yaŋ kulu banda cawka ga bay nango kaŋ nga go alkuraana sogonyano ra boŋ-jare hizbs Dumbu karyaŋ fo dumi yaŋ ga cawka dan a ma hin ka alkuraana caw jirbi iyye wala jirbi hinza (godin) Gonitara fondo ra tira-taji fo yaŋ fatta kaŋ ga cabe dabari yaŋ (alwaato neesiyaŋ ra) alkuraana cawo dondonyaŋ sintina ga Ngey ka ci tira fo yankaŋ i go ga goy d'ey liisey ra Tira fo yaŋ mo fatta borey da cara game ra “boro ma hin ka alkluraana caw caw-kanandi ra” (salifou) Mate kaŋ te kulu laarabu-ciina biiriizey cawo ga koy ka gana alkuraana cawandiyaŋ boŋ-jare se
Iri ma di cawkey ciina ga koy alkuraanaa ciina Alkuraanaa cawo si te da kala cawkey ciina Wo-din no goono ba da cawo mooru bayrey wala fahamey boobo no goono fonda-din ra boro ga faham da nga bumbo ciinaa barayey nda alsilaamatara bayray yaŋ Ngey naamey nda ngey ciiney fahama ga dogon ba day alkuraana cawo ga kond'ey alwaati fo yaŋ ra taarifi nda laabu-gande fo yaŋ kaŋ i si bay ra Cawo kuuyano nda a alhaalo kulu waate tira boŋ no a kulu ga te Zankey ciina ga cawo nda tirey boŋ cawo gonda dogonay fahama ra Hala i ga to tira boŋ cawo ga walhã bo no a ga sintin da Cawo jine koyyano waate boro kaŋ ga ba ga hin ka larabu-ciina nahaw (nah) wala hantumey alhaaley (sorf) caw Da i to alkuraana baribata (tafsir) do ibn kathir tira ga djalâl tira hinka no i ga sintin da ba kaŋ i ga beeri (fitey ga ba) Ga i ma bisa ka to tafsir cima-cimey ga sanda suyûtiy nda qurtubiy nda wkc
kay-furu Hayrey nda lokkolo gama sanno man jaŋ ka lokkolo hawzukey boŋ-haw Taarifo ra lokkolo nda almayaaley manti kala wayce hinka kaŋ hirrey ka ci afo ga cawandi afo ga biirijiirey ga bu ga tunlokkolo ka ga ci “bayray guntu” bare ka ka ga nga nga moy-duma feeri al-umma se Sohõ kokaro kulu si kala kunda hinka ma wa-fakay zankey cawo fonda ra Hunkuna gomni boobo go lokkolo bande porze boobo yaŋ ka kaŋ ga hayrey nda lokkolo sasabandi i ma kambe-daŋ-care kambe ra (maubant nda leclec) Da hayrey kay ngey waani zankey cawo ga cawandikey mo man miiri ngey nangey ra boro kulu si goy da cawo hawzukey jine-koyyaŋ si tabbati I ga bay mo kaŋ da bora kulu na kambe-daŋ-care-kambe ra cawo ga boori day no
Konkonsa-beerey kulu kaŋ i te almayaaley biirima boŋ cabe kaŋ hayrayey kaŋ izey to lokkol-fu sasabey do wala jine daamantey do no ga mo-daŋ cawandikey se (asdih) Cawandikey sanney to nangu mooru ka bisa hayrayey heeni-heena nda i mutteyaney Cawandiko boobo ga di kaŋ hayrayey kaŋ i si di mutte no wo kaŋ yaŋ ga furo lokkolo haarakey ra mo ga wata Alaasiri foyaŋ ga ne “lokkol wangay” (thin périer)”hayra humburkumo” (verba) “kanyaŋ si hin ka ngey zankey hawzu”(lorcerie ndcarvalo)cawandikey wo diiyano ga zankey cawo sanda si kala almayaaley hina-siyano ga nda talkatara Wo ka kande kaŋ cawandikey ga zankey daŋ ngey da hayrayey game ra lakkal-kanay ma ka(maubantnda leclerc asdih)
Naamey biirima afirki bayrayey boŋ Fassara Naamey biirima duura si jeeri kala afirki-gunto suuji nda gomney boŋ Biirima-din si te kala da sanni gomdoyaŋ dondonyaŋ goni-taray nda foori-foorey konko-karyaŋ nda gaani Care-diiyaŋ care gaakasina nda kundaa ma te boŋ-fo ga no a na gaabi daŋ Mun-adamayzo ma si mooru al umma ka ci naamey-biirima nufey kaŋ banda a go Kaŋ borey boona ka ci i ma duumi i ga arra-daŋ barmayyaney se (sawadogo dugué rodriguez nda ouaba)
Naamey biirima nda niizer hayrayey kambe-danyano Lakkal-cinayaŋ no niizer naamey biirima ga te d'a Zanka ma ma nga hayrayey nda dottijo kulu se go lalabey kaŋ i hima ka du al-umma ra Niizer “hausancayzo si ka jama ga da a man nga taamey ka beerandiyaŋ ma ga Wala wayborayzo wondiya way-hiijo si ŋaawari wala hari no da manci a sambu no” (daouda fita) Ya-din ga al-umma kulu kambe no go biirima-din gurja ga bora ma du Da-hanno (moumouni) Mafaaro ka ci nda bora man du lalabu da-hanno manci nga hinne taali no wala a hayrayey al-umma kulu taali no Hausancey do “tabi'a” (lakkal) teeyaŋ no bora kulu ga kookari d'a Da din ga te i hanno hausancey ma ne “tabi'a koray” wala i laalo “muguya tabi'a” (daouda fita)
Hayrey cimi-cimey boŋ no goyo kulu go zama ngey no ga izey biiriima sintin Ko-ciya saajawko sintina ka ci ɲano kaŋ ga a si fun kaŋ ga a baabu-baabu a ma du ka zaada Sanku wayborayzo kaŋ biirima ga fayanka da alborayzo wayborayzo maanu ɲano gumo zama i ga a alhaaley kulu gana a ma koy to wayboro beeri Baabo goyo wo si kala goy dondonandiyaŋ nda al-umma ra goray waaniyaŋ Goy fanni folloŋ no baabo ga hin ka a dondonandi (farmi kuruyaŋ fatawci) Niizer al umma naamey ra wo di-ga-dondonyaŋ ga no zanka ga waani nga baaba goyo
Niizer zaamaani lokkolo cawandiyano Cawandiyaŋ sijiro Afirki laabey bon-duura jirbey ra a fo kulu na nga cawandiyaŋ sijiri beeri ka kaŋ ka ti hini-futa banda sijiro Hunkuna cawandiyaŋ sijiri beeri iddu no afirko tubu hini-futa ga (ingilisi wana faransi wana Espaɲa wana portugal wana jaamey laabu wana nda laarabu ciina) Tubo kaŋ niizer nda afirki laabey kaŋ ga salaŋ faransi-ciine ga du gonda laru yaŋ kaŋ fun hini-futa ga Hala ka ka sohõ niizer lokkolo sijiri beero si ga goy da kala laabey-da-care gama ra caw sijiri beero Ngey mo no go ga ngey nooro daŋ a ra (meunier) ne kaŋ wo-din wo manti kala za-ka-daŋ care-ra
Niizer cawandiyaŋ sijiri beero sogonyano ra almayaaley nda hayrayey kambe-daŋ lokkolo sanno ra si te kala fondo yaŋ kaŋ lokklolo poltik hawzukey ka zama lokkolo manti kala almayaaley biirima tontono Ya-din ga hayrayey goyo ka cia ma nga izo hantum lokkola ma a kuru a ma koy lokkola ma lokkolo da nga nufa baya ma lokkolo ce-dirawey baya ma ceeci ka bay mate kaŋ zankey cawo go ga te d'aa ma nga kambe fahama ci lokkolo hawzukey se lokkolo fondey kulu boŋ (i fo no zankey ga ciya cawo banda i fo no i go ga i cawandi kaŋ hima d'a)ama kambe-daŋ nooro kaayano ga a ma kambe-daŋ lokkolo hawzuyano ga Jiiri kaŋ i na lokkoliizey hayrey kunda feeri a na sanka yaŋ sambu kaŋ ka ci Nga ma lokkoliizey baabey kulu boney margu lokkolo ce-dira fondo ra Nga ma sabayaŋ da wa-fakay daŋ cawkey nda cawandikey nda hino borey game ra Nga ma kande nga kambe gaakasina lokkol ba-funa nda cawo fondo ra Nga ma albahaarey no lokkoliize baabey se cawo nda biiriima nda dondonandiyano do haray
Care gaakasina moy-duma sinda haali hanno amma borey ga di care alwaati ka ka alwaati Deedando wo ga lokkolo hawzukey sogon kanadi hinka afey ga bangay zama ngey ka ci hawzuko timmantey (gomnati nda faasakey kaŋ ga ci sandikey) Borey no i ga di alwaati kulu lokkolo haarakey ra Sata fooyaŋ sanda (antampirzey kaŋ go ngey boŋ-goray ra porzey nda fuula-kwaarayey kunjiyey) goono kaŋ si bangay gumo Borey wo banda sata fooyan mo goono sanda hayrayey kaŋ ga fatta alwaati kulu da gaaabi da himma lokkolo sanney ra Deedando ga cabe kookaro kulu kaŋ hayrayey go ga kande zankey cawo ma ga Hangawiizey ga cabe zugayano kaŋ hayrayey go te lokkolo se a ga ci cawandikey boŋ no a ga ci cawkey bon no a ga ci i sata hinka kulu bon zugayaŋ kaŋ cawandikey daŋ i ma ngey goyo te cawkey mo ma kokari daŋ cawo ra Da masala fo ka lokkolo ga hayrayey no i ci i se i man ci i se ga a boŋ-za
Anfooyaŋ i ga bare satey ga (hayrayey ɲaney nda lokkolo sata) waati fooyaŋ kwaara-koyo wala limam ka gaakasinay ceeci
Amma niizer borey boona ka ci alkuraana cawo nga no ga i sawandi annasaara cawo ga(barreteau nda tiné)
Niizer lokkolo kaŋ a tubu hini-futa ga na kubay daŋ nizeriizo da nga hayrayey nda al-umma nda addino game ra(moumouni) Lokkol jaŋ ka waaniyano mo ma ka ka tonton wo-din yaŋ ga Harey kulu no ka ka borey muttandi lokkolo ga
Hayrayey goyo kaŋ i ga te izey cawano fondo ra Sanniize yaŋ ne kaŋ ga almayaaley haaley bangandi almayaali turaaban fayyaney ɲa wattantey zankey kaŋ ga i na kambe ka boro yaŋ ga ba ngey ma hayra fo yaŋ adani yaŋ ka ne i se almayaali barkatay wala ce-kanda yaŋ ce-yaw yaŋ (thin kaŋ boŋ asdih salaŋ turney nda kao) Afirko ra almayaaley alhaaley furo-care ra i ga ba barmay-barmay mo
Almayaaley nda lokkolo gorkasina gonda sandey a ga barmay no zama hayra kindo ga hay fo bay afoyaŋ si hari kulu bay I ba-funa do mo ga cabe alhaalo-din(kawye boro wala gallu boro)niizer wo lokkol ga no almayaali kulu ga hari fo batu nga izo se “ waati kulu iri ga batu cawandika ma hari kulu te iri sewo kaŋ a ga hin day no a ga te Iri mo ga wo kaŋ cindi te sanku fu”(lokkoliize baaba fo sanni) Alhaalo wo man ti murayyaŋ za day kaŋ hayra no ga haggoy nda nga izo lakkal-cinayano nda almayaalo ra gorayyano
Konkonsa fo kaŋ i te cawkey se cabe kaŋ i baayano kulu me-ga fondogoyyaŋ hinne no i ga du hayrayey ga (daouda abdourahamane nda chekaraou) Niizer konkonso fo mo man koy kala hanseyano fondo ra lokkol-kayney ra Konkonsa-din ra hayrayey ma no fatta zama ngey ga no hanseyano ga caada hayrayey ne kaŋ teera wo-din ga fayanka-fayanka daŋ zankey game ra (abdourahamane fita) Za kaŋ zankey si ba-funay follonka ra ngey kwaara i si hin ka te afo ngey da ngey caley hanseyano do harayhayra fooyaŋ man yarda da hanseyano din sogonyano zama zankey kaŋ se i ga a te ga furo boro-jarey jine
i ma hayrayey da bay zankey cawo fondo ra Hayrayey lakkaley go ga fay-fay fu-biiriima nda lokkolo cawo beerandiyano game ra I sinda bayrey kaŋ ga i ga i ma izey cawo hawzu zama i si bay mate kaŋ ngey ga te wala zama i si hin ka a te (fotinos a) Iri cabe hayrayey da hinka zankey cawo fondo ra“ay ba-si” borey kaŋ ga miila kaŋ cawo wo lokkolo hinne no a ga gunaalmayaaley kaŋ sinda hina kaŋ ga cawandikey yaamaryano filla zankey se zama ngey wo ga kaŋ lokkol wo hari yaw no ngey sealmayaaley kaŋ si bay mate kaŋ i ga te kaŋ ga ne ngey sinda ga-ko kaŋ ga cawkey yaamaryano filla zankey sehayrayey kaŋ doona lokkolo kaŋ caw kaŋ ga hin ka cawandikey yaamarey hanse wala ka ga fizaw i ra
Hayrayey bayray jana ka te mafaari kaŋ cawandikey hima ka ni burne “i ma kambe-daŋ ngey hayra goyey ra” (feyfant nda rey) Hayrayey ga ba ngey ma faham da gorkasina kaŋ go ngey da lokkolo game ra nda ngey izey goyo kaŋ i go ga te lokkol Wo-kaŋ hima d'a ka ci i ma milla laalo wala sikka ka harayey lakkal ra ka cabe i se hari kaŋ go ga te lokkol da i ma i no sanno i ma ci hari kaŋ biney ra
i ma guna ka di haali fo no hayrayey kambe-danyano ga te da lokkolo fondo ra Gorkasina kaŋ i ga ba hayrayey ga hima i ma i cabe ce-dirawey goyey haaley nda i kambe kookaro lokkolo ce-dira ra Hayrayey kafanayan kulu ga hima da i do baara-baara wala i bine ma fun(périer) Hayrayey kambe-danyano ga hin ka te alhaali boobo rawo-din fondo ra no (epstein) na deedandiyaŋ cabe kaŋ ga lokkolo ga hayrayey ba-funay nda arzakaa do haray Kambe-danyano-din ga te da takey woi ma zankey kuru fui ma zankey cabe biiriimay nda laabiizetaray takeycawandikey ma i burne i ma du ka faham da lokkolo ra ba-funay fondey nda kookaro kaŋ zankey go ga te i ma kambe-daŋ lokkolo goyey kulu ra i ma lokkolo gaakasinay alwaati kulu kaŋ a hima d'ai ma kambe-daŋ lokkol hawzuyano nda a ce-dira ra
(durning) Ya-din cawandiko nga hayra ma goy kambe-ga- care- kambe ra wo tilas I hima no ka batame faaru wo-din se Laasaabu boobo cabe kaŋ cawandiko nda hayra sabayano go fondey kaŋ ra zankey ga zada (feyfant) I ma hayrayey no ngey nango lokkolo ce-dira ra
(asdih rayna ndarubio humbeeck nda al) Biiri care-bandayano no ga hayrayey “zuga i ma du ka ngey biiriimay goyey te” (giuliani nda payet)
Iri ga bay kaŋ gorkasina-din si jan sanday Mate kaŋ boro kulu faham da nga goyo no ga kande i ma saba wala i ma si saba Wo-din ka cabe kan cawandiko nda hayra kaŋ faham da care gonda saaye i gora ma boori ka ba haali laala Care humburkumay mo si sabayano tehayra boobo ga humbu lokkol borey ma ngey sambu boŋ-bi yaŋ wala boro yaŋ kaŋ sinda bayray kulu (ouédrago) ya-din no cawandiko yaŋ do sanku da hayrayey hima ka furo caw-fuwo ra ka di mate kaŋ cawo go ga te d'a
Manti dabari folloŋ no goono kaŋ ga nan gorkasina ma te ka boori (ouédraogo) I hima ka sandayey boŋ-za za i man fumbu Sanda lokkolo ma moy-duma hanno cabe hayrey se i ma cin ka i burɲe lokkol foori yaŋ waate salmahaarey waate nda haali hanno kulu waate wo-din ga naanay daŋ gorkasina ra (hoover dempsey nda sandler) Hayrayey burɲe ka daŋ lokkolo muraadey ra ga gorkasina niinandi ka naŋ hayrey ma furo da gaabi lokkolo goyey ra
