A ga bisa jinay kaŋ boro tubu zama lakkal wane no naamu no lokkol wane no goy nangu bayray laasaabu wane no meunier 2008 p310
Me 28, 1975 no Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey na sanka sambu Lagos, Niizeriya laabu ga arzaka fondey hawzuyaŋ sataa (CEDEAO) sinji.
A nufa beero ga ci: margasinay hanno nda arzaka fondey ma zaada laabey nda care game ra.
Wo- din no ga naŋ arzaka fondey ma te afo, adamayzey baafuna ma du ga boori, i arzaka fondey ma feeri, laabey nda cara gayzetara ma gaabu, Afirki laabey wadaatayaŋ nda i jine- koyyaŋ ma du ga tabbati.
Jiiri ga bu, jiiri ga tun, nufa wo-ne barmay ga nduggaa misey kaŋ ga laabey kulu sasabandi, gayzetaray kaŋ go laabu 15 nda care game ra gana.
A ga goy nda fondo baajiney kaŋ ga ci laabey sasabandiyaŋ, i care gaakasinay nda ngey boŋ wasayaŋ.
Fondo beeri jarey ga ci poltik fondey nda care diiyaŋ ma koy care bande; fitina ma si furo laabey nda care game ra; baani goray nda lakkal-kanay hawzuyaŋ laabey ra; fitiney bonzayaŋ waafakay ra; adamayze alhakey ga lalabuyaŋ, i gaabandiyaŋ nda i haggoyyaŋ; mayray hanno nda deemokarasi gaabandiyaŋ nga nda borey ma dogonandi care se yaŋ; arzaka fondo nda ndugga goray kayandiyaŋ.
Nufaa wo toonandiyaŋ ga sandi gumo gande kaŋ ra dumey nda naamey ga ba gumo.
Hunkuna CEDEAO te ma nduggaa kulu ra zama a sinjikey, a jine-funey, nda borey kaŋ ga naanay laabey care diiyaŋ sijiro ga, na ngey hina kulu te ga laabey margu, arzaka nda care diiyaŋ fondo ra.
Sataa wo na kosaray dabari ce-kayante yaŋ te nangu kulu kaŋ a himanda baani goray nda politik ra lakkal kaynay ma tabbati a ganda kaŋ gonda fitina ra.
A dabarey ga ti 1999 sankaa fitiney kosarayyaŋ, i hawzuyaŋ nda i bonzayaŋ, baani goray nda lakkal-kanay boŋ, 2011 sankaa kaŋ i tonton deemokaraasi nda mayray hanno fondo ra, CEDEAO sankaa (2008) fitiney kosarayyaŋ ma ga nda biirimay nda cawo boŋ wano (2003).
CEDEAO jiiri 37 baafuna ra, waana-waana ciiti fondey kaŋ i margu nda poltikey, sankey, dabarey nda tagami ce-kayantey kaŋ naŋ i na fitiney kaŋ furo borey nda care game ra, dumey nda care game ra, nda laabey nda care game ra hawzu ga boori.
Diptey fuwo, ciiti fuwo nda soojey go sijirey kaŋ laabukoyey margaa daŋ ga sankaa nda baani goray nda lakkal-kanay batu.
Baani goray tabbatandiyaŋ, fitiney kosarayyaŋ, i hawzuyaŋ, i bonzayaŋ nda i tangamo ciya baafunay ganji.
A sandayey bonzayaŋo ga mo i hima ga dabarey hanse ga i neesi alwaati ga ka alwaati ga i ma i tajanda ga du ga zaama ga boori.
Laasaabo wo no naŋ i na biirima gaabandi ga tonton, a na te mo fondo kaŋ ga baani goray ce- kayandi Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra.
Wo-ne gonda maana gumo zama ganda furo- tajey ga gooru gumo.
A ga hima mo i ma baani goray ce-kayandi i se biirima fondo ra.
Fondo wo-ne ra no i na CEDEAO tiraa kaŋ cawandikey ga guna ga cawandikey boŋ-feeri te hari banda kaŋ UNESCO-BREDA kaŋ go Dakar nda Afirki laabey jine-koyyaŋ banco (BAD) gaakasinay.
Tiraa wo manti kala nafa hari boro kulu se kaŋ ga boona baani goray CEDEAO ganda ra.
Di- careyaŋ kuuku banda kaŋ sintin 2006 Afirki wayno-kaŋa kulu ra, hari banda kaŋ i na baani goray gaabandiyaŋ cawko beerey kaŋ go ganda ra nda taray, nda UNESCO margu, no i na tiraa te.
Tiraa gonda caw iyye kaŋ ga salaŋ wo-ne yaŋ boŋ: baani gooray ce-kayyandiyaŋ nda fitiney kosarayyaŋ, adamayzey alhakey; laabiizetaray nda a ce-kayandiyyaŋ; deemokaraasi nda mayray hanno; alborey nda wayborey jine-koyyaŋ kayaŋdiyaŋ; ga-ham baani, windanta, duumi jine-koyyaŋ nda laabey care diiyaŋo.
Caw kulu gonda dumbari yaŋ kaŋ gonda kayfuru, tirey kaŋ i guna, nufa beeriyaŋ kaŋ ga cawandika daŋ fondo.
A gonda mo cawandiyaŋ walhã kaŋ ga cawo dogonandi CEDEAO laabey ra.
A ga hagu lokkol cawandikey nda wo kaŋ si cawandi lokkoley ra se.
Tiraa nufa bananta ga ci, i ma CEDEAO laabiize boobo cawandi nd'a, kaŋ lakkaley nda ga-ham baano ga kubay, nda koyne kaŋ ga ba adamayzey baani gora, care se bisandiyaŋo nda care boŋ goray hanno.
Cawandikey boŋ-feeray nooko boobo se no i na tiraa wo cabe i ma a daahirandi laabey kaŋ ra sijiri wo-ne si.
Wo kaŋ yaŋ gonda sijiro mo i ma a hanse, i ma yadda nd'a.
Kadré Désiré Ouédraogo CEDEAO sataa Jine-funa Saabi CEDEAO go ga nga saabi toonandi BAD nda UNESCO do kaŋ kande ngey gaakasinay tiraa wo teeyaŋ fonda ra.
I mana ye nda banda ba ce fo tiraa wo soolaa ra.
Saabi ma bara mo CEDEAO laabey bayraykooney ga kaŋ yaŋ na kambe daŋ tira ce-kayanta wo goyo ra.
Iri ga saabu laabey jine-funey nda saruusey jine-borey se, kaŋ yaŋ na Dakaaru, Lumi, Wagadugu nda Abuja margey dogonandi.
Iri ga saabu, iri ga kuku gaakasinkey kulu se, Iayzetaray ma ga, kaŋ iri go ga ceeci laabey nda care game ra.
Boŋ-Jina EDEAO sinjiyaŋo te koray kaŋ na Afirki laabey fay-fayyaŋ ganji.
Sankaa kaŋ ga Afirki wayna-kaŋay laabu way cindi guwa (15) na kambe daŋ Me 28, 1975 Legos, no na laabey wo margasina fonda jeeri.
A boona ga ti, i ma arzaka, baafunay, naamey hala nda poltik ganda hayandi: Wo-din ga naŋ Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey ma te afolloŋ.
CEDEAO goyey ga ti, a ma arzaka, poltik nda lakkal-kanay fondey gaabandi: Arzaka do haray, habey nda nooro ma te afolloŋ.
Poltiko do haray, diptey fuwo, yaamarkey fuwo nda ciiti fuwo ma te afo.
Lakkal-kana do haray mo CEDEAO soojey goono (ECOMOG 1999).
Fondo beerey kaŋ i ga gana ga ngey goyey te ga ti: adamayze alhakey ga lalabuyaŋ, i hallasiyaŋ nda i gaabandiyaŋ; deemokarasi gaabandiyaŋ; poltik nda jine-koyyaŋ sijirey ma te afolloŋ.
Amma sanday boobo go ga gaaru care diiyaŋo hanno se, kaŋ yaŋ ga ti: jaŋ ga ma care se yaŋo kaŋ go laabey nda care game ra, kaŋ ka ga furo hini barmayyaŋ booba, mayray sandayey, talkatara nda lakkal-tuna kaŋ go CEDEAO laabu boobo ra.
Sandayey wo kulu kaŋ go no laabey ra: ga no talkataray, mayray fuwey gaabi jaŋa, dumi fayanka kaŋ ga borey ganji wadaatayaŋ ka ga tonton.
Da i ga ba fitiney, mayrayey sandayey nda adamayze alhakey taamuyaŋey ma ban, i hima ga laasaabu taji yaŋ te ga goy ce-dirawey barmay.
Wo-din ma ga lokkol kaŋ ga adamayze alhaali barmay ga ci fondo ce-kayanta.
UNESCO goy fuwo kaŋ go Dakar no na CEDEAO tiraa wo kaŋ ga salaŋ baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ adamayzey alhakey, laabizetaray, deemookaraasi nda laabey ma care diiyaŋ boŋ biirima gana ce nda ce.
CEDEAO laabey no ga nafa nda tira wo, i na a bare Faransi, Ingilisi nda Portigal ciiney ra.
Alboro wala wayboro kulu kaŋ ga boŋfeeray no lokkol wala nangu fo cawandiko se ma ga no i na tiraa wo te.
Laabey nda care game ra wongey na nango naŋ laabiizey nda care game ra fitiney se.
Fuula-kwaaray koyey si kala han kulu danji hinka game ra wala hari kaŋ jaasa, ngey ga ti fitiney boro sintiney kaŋ ga leebu.
Jine-koyyaŋ taji no fitiney kosarayyaŋo du 1990 ra, Boutros Boutros Ghali kaŋ ga ti ONU jine-funa a baani goray tiraa sijiro ra.
I mana gaabi daŋ kala “fitiney kosarayyaŋ siyaasa beeri” kaŋ ga ti “fondo konney kaŋ i sambu ga fitiney kosaray kambu hinkaa game ra, i ma ganji jama jaŋ ga ma care se yaŋ ma fitina hay nda mo i ma si ta fitiney ma beeri ba da i tunu.” Fitina kosarayyaŋ siyaasa nufa ga ti i ma fitiney tiksey bay nda i bonzayaŋ laabo wala laabey nda care game ra.
I ma goy nda saaware hanno, sabandi, sasabandiyaŋ, salaŋ ga ye care me ra yaŋ, faaliyaŋ nda ciiti hanno teeyaŋ fitina waate.
I ga fitina kosarayyaŋ siyaasa te hawzuyaŋ, hanseyaŋ nda baani goray cinayaŋ fondo ra.
Annasaara jiiri 1997 no “Carnegie margaa” kaŋ te fitina laaley boŋ na fayanka hanno daŋ fitina kosarayyaŋ kayna nda ibeeri gama ra.
Fitina kosarayyaŋ kayna, CEDEAO laabey ra ga ti teera suubanante yaŋ kaŋ i sambu ga fitina kaŋ ga ba ga tun bonza.
Ngey ga ti fitina kaseeta, sabandi, sasabandiyaŋ, wongu jiney taayaŋ ga a kosaray, soojey nda hiney margu ga sambu nangu fo sanda, care gaakasinay nda CEDEAO soojey.
Fitina kosarayyaŋ beero kaŋ i ga te baani goray sabbay se nufaa ga ti i ma tangam nda fitiney mafaarey tiksey.
Ngey ga ti poltik tajey, mayray fuwey, jine-koyyaŋ sijiri tajey, bayray tontoni nda baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ siyaasa.
Fitiney kosarayyaŋ fondo ra, kambe daŋyaŋo ga hin ga te nda fitina kosarayyaŋ siyaasa, naaru ga konkonsa teeyaŋ, tugu ga siyaasa teeyaŋ sabandiyaŋ A ga boori mo nduggaa nda laabey margey, gomnantey kaŋ go sataa ra nda fuula-kwaaray satey ma daŋ ngey fitina kosarayyaŋ politik sijirey ra amma i ma ciya hari kaŋ i ga goy nda kaŋ borey kulu dumi ma bara a ra ga fitiney kosaray.
Fitina kosarayyaŋ fondey gonda: (a) Naaruyaŋ ga laabaari no nda addiney jine-funey mo ye yaŋ, bonkooney nda boro adilantey, i ma naaru ga koy gandey ra ga alhaaley neesi nda fitiney kosarayyaŋ hiney ceeciyaŋ (sandayey bonzayaŋ margey kaŋ ga borey kulu guna).
(b) faaliyaŋ (c) sasabandiyaŋ (d) sabayaŋ: salaŋ ga ye care me ra fondey teeyaŋ yanjekaarey game ra.
(e) soojey ma fitiney kosarayyaŋ (f) naanay danyaŋ (a) Baani goray nda lakkal-kanay kaŋ i gorandi hino barmayyaŋ boŋ, (b) Laabey fitina kosarayyaŋ sijirey ma goy laabey baani goray jine-fune nda fuula kwaarayey sata ma kambe daŋ care kambe ra ga laabari ceeci ga i ma i fisi, (c) Dottiijey kaŋ yaŋ ga borey sasabandi sata goyey nda CEDEAO jine-funa wakiilo, (d) Boro adilantey goy hanney: diyey kaŋ ga koy boro beerey do, sasabandi ma ga, (e) Fondey kaŋ CEDEAO (CPCC) fitina kosarayyaŋ sataa daŋ kayandiyaŋ, (f) laabey ma dogonay te adamayzey alhakey fuwey se, satey kaŋ ga tangam nda nukando, sata beerey kaŋ ga haggoy nda sappa nda siyaasey kunda; i ma du ga kande i se i goyo fonda ra.
CEDEAO go ga fu fo gorandi kaŋ ga sasabandiyaŋo no gaabi a ma du ga di satey kaŋ go ga fitina kosarayyaŋo kaŋ yaŋ ga ti dottijo sasanbandikey nda i wakiiley wala laabukoyo wakiilo.
Wo-ne no ga naŋ i ma fitiney kulu dumey (idogoney nda igaabey) kaŋ go gandaa ra gaabi nooyaŋo ma kaanu, a ma du mo nafa gayante.
Fitiney hawzuyaŋey nda bonzayaŋ dumey Fitiney tiksey bayyaŋ Sintina day i ma fitiney tiksey bay.
Fitina ga hin ga bara nda sabiili fo wala iboobo (i ma guna fitiney sabiiley wala tiksey).
Fitiney hawzuyaŋ dumey nafey nda taaley fisiyaŋo Fitiney hawzuyaŋ barmayyaŋo nda i bonzayaŋo ce-diraw taji wo-ne ra, no ga naŋ fondey kaŋ borey ga hin ga sambu ma fitiney ban hala abada.
I hima ga laasaabu fitina kulu kaaniyey nda a doorey haali kulu ra sanda: Fitinante hinkaa kulu ma guna wala i ma si guna Margasinay ma furo fitinante hinka game ra wala a ma si furo Fitina bonzayaŋ wala a jaŋ ga bonzayaŋ Ay du wala ni du, wala ay mana du wala ni mana du, wala ay du wala ni mana du.
Boro ma faham nda ni boŋ nda boro jarey Boro ma goy nda laasaabu nda hina kaŋ ga sandayey bonza Waafakay fondey timmandiyaŋ Fitiney hawzuyaŋ dumey ra, i ga du – Gaabi wala hini (Tangami): kambu fo ma kambu fo tilasandi nda anniyey.
Gaabikooni mayra no: Ay zaama ni jaŋ: wo-din kulu mana sanda bonza?
Alkaalitaray: Kambu hinkaa ma sambu alkaali, ikulu mo ma yadda nda a ciito.
Alkaalo sanno no ga ŋwa.
Salaŋ ga sabayaŋ: Kambu hinkaa ma saba ngey boŋ se.
Ay du ni du
A ga hima:.
Sasabandiyaŋ: salaŋ ga ye care me ra yaŋ kaŋ ra kunda hinkaa ga yarda nda ngey ma fitiney bonza duumi.
Sasabandika ga i daŋ fondo.
A ga hima "iri kulu ma zaama".
Sabayaŋ ga ti i ma sandayo bonza abada; nga mo ga ti da baani goray sintin ga zaada.
Bonzayaŋ: i ma sanda wo bonza care banda mate kaŋ ga naŋ kambu hinkaa gama ma boori.
Manti wo- ne ga ti taalo bisayaŋo.
Alhaaley barmayyaŋ: Kambu hinkaa kambe daŋ care kambe ra beero no.
Kambu hinkaa ma anniya hanna sambu ga sabagasinay taji yaŋ gaayi.
Salaŋ ga saba, sasabandiyaŋ, sabayaŋ, sanday bonzayaŋ, alhaaley barmayyaŋ, ga ti hawzuyaŋ dumi hanney kaŋ gonda nafa beeri yaŋ kambu hinkaa kulu se.
Fondo 10 kaŋ i ga gana ga fitineybonza baani-baani Araŋ ma ceeci ga bay harey kaŋ go ga fitiney te, araŋ ma si futu mo.
Araŋ ma ceeci ga bay araŋ haaley kaŋ go ga borey bine tunandi.
Araŋ ma hina daŋ nda himma ga hangan care se, araŋ ma laabaari nda fahamay ceeci, araŋ ma hããyaŋ te.
Araŋ ma harey kaŋ ga borey anfaani bay; araŋ ma araŋ anfaano bay nda hari kaŋ si boori araŋ se wala goray kaŋ araŋ sambu za doŋ.
Araŋ ma sandayo sabiilo bay kaŋ si mo i ma a dake borey kaŋ a ga guna boŋ.
Araŋ ma laasaabu mo fondo boobey kaŋ ga sandayo bonza.
“Ifo no araŋ ga miila ga ti fondo hanna?” Araŋ ma di diiyaŋ hanno kaŋ si fitina kambu kulu tuuma.
Araŋ ma goy nda cimi fondey kaŋ i gaayi ga du ga sabayaŋey kaŋ ga hin ga te neesi.
“Mate no boro cindey te fondo wo-ne ciney boŋ?” Araŋ ma fitina kambu hinkaa sabayaŋ fondo hanney bay.
Araŋ ma gaayi fondo hanna.
Araŋ ma yarda araŋ ma ye ga ka ga salaŋ ga saba da fonda kaŋ i gaayi si te Araŋ ma care di.

Alain Mouchoux OING margaa jine-funa yarima no Oslo, oktobur, 21-2210 Kayfuru ri alwaato ra, fitina kulu dumi no go nduIIaa ra, waana-waana Afirki kaŋ dumi tuusuyaŋ wala dumey ma care wangu no han kulu, ga baani- gora nda lakkal-kana ganji.
Wo-din se, a ga hagu, i ma fondo yaŋ gorandi kaŋ ga baani gora no gaabi CEDEAO laabey ra.
A ma du ga te se, i ma Iayzetaray daŋ laabiizey game ra nda laabey bumbey nda care game ra ga du ga adamayzey alhakey hallasi.
Tiraa bayra: I ma goy nda darza, harey bayray, teerey dabarey nda dey ga du ga adamayzey alhakey fondey, goyyey nda haaley no gaabi nduggaa, gandey nda laabey ra.

Ngey ga ti: “nduggaa ciiti fondey kaŋ ga adamayzey nda satey hallasi nda hari kulu kaŋ lamba i baafuna nda i burcinitara ga.” Mourgeon ne adamayzey alhakey ga ti duurey kaŋ ciiti fondey gaayi, i bara mo boro kulu se a wane borey ra nda hino do gora.
Alhakey ga ti poltik tajey se daba.
Alhaku ga ti lakkal kaŋ ciiti fondey yarda a ma hari fo te wala a ma si a te, a ma ma hari fo kaani a ma du wala a ma boro fo tilasandi a ma hari fo te nga se.
Adamayzey alhakey ga ti boro lakkaley kaŋ ciiti fondey ga bay adamayze kulu se.
Adamayze alhaku yaŋ no kaŋ boro kulu gonda za a hayyaŋo go, a go adamayze burcinitara tabbatandi.
Adamayze alhakey si neera, nduggaa hari yaŋ no, a si fay mo.
NduHHaa, gandey nda laabey adamayzey alhakey Boro alhakey Duurey kulu kaŋ adamayze kulu ga hin ga du.
Ndugga alhakey, ndugga hari yaŋ no kaŋ si neera kaŋ ciitey fondey wala ciiti tira beerey ga bay, kaŋ ikulu ibeero ga ti annasaara jiiri 1789 adamayze alhakey nda laabiize sanni beero.
Annasaara sanni kaamuso Sanniizo taarifo Adamayze hallasiyaŋ nda alhaku tugante sanno gay.
Tiraa kaŋ i ga bay gumo ga ti Ingilisi, 1215 sartu beero (Magna Karta) kaŋ ga salaŋ boŋ duure alhaakey boŋ.
Alwaati follonka ra, Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey ra Mande Sarto kaŋ se i ga ne “Kourou kaŋ Fouga” na borey gorayey laasaabu fondo hanney boŋ ga du ga baani goray ce-kayandi.
Ingiliisi laabu, 1215 sartu beero no i kubandi nda 1628 alhakey tiraa kaŋ na adamayzey boŋ-duure kayandi amiiru do, nda mo annasaara jiiri 1689 tiraa.
Jiiri zangari 16 ga, Kalvin almasiifutara ra adamayzey kulu boŋ-duure gorandi Irkoy fonda ra.
Grotius mo, almasiifu zuuzu no, za 1625 ci kaŋ adamayze gonda tilas yaŋ amma a gonda mo alhaku beeri yaŋ.
Ingilisi mayra barmayyaŋo no fondo hanno te sanniizo cinayaŋo se, a ga ciya sanno bangandiyaŋ no wala 1660 boŋ-duure tajo no, 1679, diptey sappa ganji i ma boro kulu gaayi taari boŋ.
Za 1688 no Ingiliisi laabu no mayray barmayyaŋo alhakey daŋ ciiti fondey ra.
Bayraykooney na sanney te waana-waana J.
Locke kaŋ na fuula-kwaaray mayray sanni te nga tiraa ra.
A ne kaŋ mayray hagante ga ti wo kaŋ i daŋ waafakay boŋ da mo koyne ndugga goray alhakey ga hino mayra kaynandi.
Zangari 18 waate kulu, Amirki boŋ-duura sanno bangandiyaŋo jiiri 1776, nda Faransi wana kaŋ te uttu hando zaari 26, 1789 kulu no na adamayze boŋ-duure gaabi tabbatandi.
1789 boŋ-duure bangandiyaŋo nufaa ga ti laabo hino ma naŋ adamayzey kulu ma du ngey boŋ nda hari kaŋ i ga may.
Wo-din ga ti “alhakey” kaŋ se i ga ne sintinay wadde.
Wadda-wadda hinkanta “alhakey” wo (goy nda naamey alhaku) ngey ga ti arzaka alhakey kaŋ ga ba hino kambe daŋ yaŋ adamayze baafuna se.
Hunkuna, wadda-wadda hinzanta alhakey sanni no go ga te kaŋ ga windanta kaŋ si ziibi alhakey kayandi, nda mo baani goray nda gayzetaray alhakey.
Jiiri 1325 ma care se yaŋo na gomni beeri hay; a naŋ borey du hari hanno kaŋ na borey te a folloŋ, alborey nda wayborey ma saba fitiney ciitey ga.
Duurawo mo naŋ, nduggaa laabey baani-goray sataa na ma care se yaŋ sanney gorandi annasaara jiirey 1820, 1888 nda 1889 kaŋ yaŋ gonda wayborey alhakey baani goray nda lakkal-kayna kookarey.” Adamayze alhaku nda Afirki doŋ alhakey A si boori boro ma miila kaŋ Afirki doŋ borey si adamayze alhaku bay.
Afirki gonda naamu-naamu zeeno yaŋ adamayze alhakku boŋ.
Doŋ Afirki ra, alhaku wo, ciiti fondo no kaŋ ga cimi nda taari fayanka.
Alhaku si fay nda hallasiyaŋ, nda tilas harey (Keba Mbay).
Afirki ra, dottijo buuyaŋ fu tonyaŋ no.

» Doŋ alhakey nufey ga ti boŋ-duure ce-kayandiyaŋo nda naamey gaabandiyaŋ, adamayzetaray baafuna nda Afirki jine-koyyaŋ.
Adamayzey kulu burcinitara nda a darza fondey boŋ no i go.
I ga saba, i si fay, i ga gana.
A ga gaabu i ma i ye banda wala i ma di boro fo ma i ka.

Nduggaa kulu ra.
Ciito no ga a hallasi.

Adamayzey alhakey fondey: kaŋ ga koy nda nduggaa gandey nda laabey ciiti haaley.
Goy nda haala fondey no kaŋ tilas hawzukey kaŋ ga ti hino mayray fuwey ga hin ga ci hari kaŋ te.
Ndugga laabey sankey no bayray kooni beerey kaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra ga hawzu.

Adamayzey alhakey ce-dirawo mana cina kala margasiney fondey boŋ.
Kaŋ ga bora kulu guna nda mo borey kulu no ga mo ye goyey ga i teeyaŋey waate.
Ngey ga ti goyo teeyaŋo, a fisiyaŋo, a sijiriyaŋo, a gasandiyaŋo nda a ganayaŋo, a neesiyaŋo.
Jama poltikey nda i jine-koyyaŋo si ga guna nda gaabi kala adamayzey alhakey nufey gasuyaŋo ga.
L'ABDH ga kande nga gaakasinay sijirey jine-koyyaŋo ma boorri kaŋ ga naŋ goyey ma te, i ma saba.
Sijirey, poltikey nda jine-koyyaŋ haaley kulu si kala alhakey nda tilsey kaŋ ga saba nda ndugga alhaku.
Hunkuna, i ga ba no nduggaa mayray fuwey sanney kaŋ ga jine-koyyaŋ margasinay guna adamayze alhakey boŋ ma te a folloŋ.
Hinikoyey si hin ga sanney kulu kaŋ borey wala satey du gana.
Sanno kaŋ i ga ŋwa batu zaari ra ga ba gumo ya-din mo satey hããyaŋey si ban.
Wo-din se, i ga hin ga poltik mayray borey yganje.
Goy ga ba i se kaŋ i ma du haro kaŋ se poltik bayraykooni ga ne “boro ma bisa ni hina ga.” Sanno ga to i se karre ga sanda mate kaŋ i na a ci nda sanno gasandiyaŋo fondo ra.
Da zaari goyey ba gumo mayray borey se, nda mo care dukurandiyaŋo ba, to kala day carmaykooni beeri kaŋ ga goyey ce-dirawey bay no ga to harey kaŋ i ga ba i ma du ga.
Mayra si hin ga sanday kulu bonza kaŋ ga jama nafa.
Amma jama sijiro ga ti nangu kaŋ mayra borey ga seedey kaŋ ga naŋ i ma sintin, nda mo i ma ci harey kaŋ i ga ba ngey ma te.
Laabaari nookey nda laabiizey ga ti jama sijiro teeko beerey.
I ma konda bayrayey jine kaŋ ga naŋ laabiizey ma ngey alhakey hããyaŋey nda ngey tilasey hantum jama sijiro ra.
A ga hagu mo i ma borey kaŋ boŋey feeri daŋ dondonyaŋey haali yaŋ ra, i ma du ga jama poltik sanney kaŋ ga i baafuna, nda i jama baafuna guna.
I ma sandayey bonza, i ma tangam hiney kaŋ ga haggoy nda sanney bonzayaŋo do.

I ma du da hanno adamayzey alhakey dabarey, fondey nda haaley se.
Sijirey sokonyaŋ walhã CAWANDIYAŊ CE-DIRAWO TIRA SILMAŊ Dumbari 2: Adamayzey alhakey dabaray, fondey nda alhaaley.
Cawo maayo wala cawandiyaŋo haalo: Adamayzey alhakey gaabandiyaŋo Waaniyaŋey: Alwaato: guuru 4 Goy-jiney wala ganjey Nduggaa, fandey nda laabey tirey (deemokarasi nda mayray hanno tiraa kaŋ i tonton, dumbari 1 ga koy 7), nda mo laabey wane wala tira kulu dumi kaŋ i ga guna fandu boŋ wala i ga hangan raajiyo.
Gagaro cawandiyaŋ wala dondonyaŋo ce-dirawo Adamayzey alhakey Nduggaa laabey jiiri zambar fo sanni bangante no I ma haggoy nda adamayze alhakey, i ma goy nda ikulu kaŋ go nduggaa sanney bangandiyaŋ tiraa ra.
Laabey kulu ra, i ma ceeci ga fuula-kwaarey alhakey poltikey, arzakey, baafuney nda naamey waney, afo kulu no gaabi, i ma hallasi.
Laabey kulu ra, i ma gaabi daŋ ga goy nda deemokaraasi goy fondey nda teerey, i ma haggoy mo nda adamayze alhakey, ba dumi kaŋ si ba waney.
I ma tangam nda wayborey taanuyaŋo, nda mo i ma goy nda fondo kaŋ boŋ i waafuku kaŋ ga tangam nda wayborey fayanka-fayanka.
I ma fondo konno yaŋ sambu kaŋ ga ce-yawey, ce-yaw goyteerey nda ngey windey haggoy, a ma si hallasi ga du ga fayanka-fayanka, dumi fayanka kaŋ go ga beeri ga koy iri baafuna ra ban.
Harey kulu no ga naŋ goray hanno nda yaafa care se yaŋ iri baafuna ra ma du gaabi.
I ma goy kambe ga care kambe ra laabey polktikey kaŋ ga borey sabandi gorandi, kaŋ ga naŋ laabiize kulu ma kambe daŋ poltiko goyey ga.
I ma laabaari nookey alhaako ce-kayandi i ma du ga ngey goyo te, nda laabiizey waney mo kaŋ ga i laabaarandi.
Hina-buuney hallasiyaŋ Iri ga kookari kulu te kaŋ ga naŋ zankey nda fuula-kwaarayey kaŋ laabu balaawey, teerey kaŋ ga dumi tuusu, wangey nda hari kaŋ ga hima nd'ey go ga taabandi ma du gaakasiney nda hallasey kaŋ yaŋ ga i no ngey ga-ham baaney nda waasi.
Fondo wo-ne ra sankey kaŋ iri ga sambu ne: I ma fuula-kwaarayey hallasiyaŋo fondey kayandi, i ma i gaabandi sanday laaley ra danga ma te kaŋ ndugga adamayze alhako na gaayi nda.
I ma laabey margasina gaabandi, i ma di laabey kaŋ go ga borey kaŋ wangey go ga gaaray ngey laabey ra se.
Fonda din ra, i ma naŋ ngey gaakasina ma koy care banda, i ma borey din kulu ga nda lakkal-kanay nda burcintaray ra, i ma du ga ye ngey borey ra ga goro.
I ma laabey zuga i ma kambe daŋ tirey ga, ga du ga goy nda zankey alhakey fondey, nda mo waafakayaŋo kaŋ ga salaŋ zanka kayney kaŋ yaŋ i daŋ wongey ra, i neerayaŋo wayborayze kayney waykuura nda furukutaray filmey kaŋ ra zanka kayney go.
I ma Afirki deemokarasiyo poltik satey nda mayray fuwey ga I ma gandey nda laabey fitiney kosarayyaŋo fondey no gaabi, i ma yarda nd'ey, i ma poltiko kayandiyaŋo, i ma Afirki fando baani goray goy no nooru goy ma du ga te.
I ma fondo konno yaŋ sambu kaŋ ga talkatara banandi, Afirki ma koy nda jine, a garawey ma tuusu, laabu waaney ra jinay neera ma boori, jine-koyaŋ gaagasina (APD) ma tonton, laabu waney kampaney ma feeriyaŋo ma te gumo, nda mo bayrayey ma te laabey kulu ra.
I ma Afirki ga a ma du hina yaŋ kaŋ ga ba, a ma du ga siida nda doorey kaŋ ga diksa kar ga sayyaŋo gaayi.
Tirey kaŋ i nafa nda AGI, Marc.

adamayzey alhakey bayyaŋ fondey
I ma dabando gana ga du laabaari adamayzey alhakey ganayaŋ satey boŋ.
Araŋ ga hin ga bay mo laabey kaŋ na adamayzey alhakey gorandiyaŋ harey daahirandi, araŋ ga du mo laabu boobo boŋ baribata yaŋ.
Adamayzey alhakey fondey Alhaku fondo kayna: haayaŋey kayney kaŋ goalhaku fondey bande.

fondey kaŋ i ga gana kayandiyaŋo 3 Laabiizetaray nda Kayfuru oro si hay nda laabizetaray.
Hari no kaŋ ga ba dondonyaŋ nda tangami kuuku; a ga ba alhaali kulu ra gurjay.
Adamayze yaŋ kaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra, da i ga ba ngey baafuna ma boori kala da i du bayray, gonitaray, nduIIa goray waaniyaŋ, laabiizey teera hanney nda i burcintara.
Fondo wo-ne ra, laabiizetaray biirima nufaa ga ci, a ma te hari kaŋ ga naŋ laabiizeyaŋ kaŋ ga ba deemokarasi ma kambe daŋ wala i ma me daŋ poltik, arzaka, naamu nda baafunay fondey ra.
CEDEAO laabu boobo ra no fitina go.
Wo-din banda deemokarasiyo go ga yanje te zama sappey banda sabayaŋ si ba gumo.
Laabiizey kambe daŋyaŋo si ba gumo laabo goyey ra, nga mo no ga ci kaŋ arzaka zaadayaŋo si waasu; a ga baani goray gayante mo ganji laabu ganda ra.
Wo-din ma ga cawo wo kaŋ salaŋ laabiizetaray nda a ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ gonda maana gumo-gumo.
Ya-din ga, wo kaŋ i go ga ceeci ka ci borey ma baafunay care ra, i ma care beerandi, i ma care naamu beerandi.
Ya-din mo no tirey kaŋ i te fondo wo- ne yaŋ ra, i ma goy nd'ey.
Tiraa bayra I ma laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ nda laabiizetaray darzey nda bayrayey gorandi ndugga goray alhaaley ra.
Tiraa dumbarey Laabiizetaray Laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ Bayray kanandey 1.
Laabiizetaray maaney Laabiizetaray: Laabiize manci kala bora kaŋ ga nafa nda nga laabo, nda alhakey kulu waana-waana sappe waney.
Laabiizetaray manci kala laabiize alhaali.
A ga naŋ i ma bay boro kaŋ nda boro kaŋ yaŋ go kwaara ra waato.
Sohõ mo i ma bay boro kaŋ nda boro kaŋ yaŋ go laabu fo ra, i ma baafunay laabo din ra.
Laabiizetarey ga boro no poltik do haray alhakey kulu, a ga tinay yaŋ dake boro boŋ laabo baafuna ra.
Laabiize: Alhakukoy no kaŋ gonda laabiizetaray nda poltik fondo ra alhaku, a gonda mo tinay yaŋ laabo do haray.
Hunkuna laabiize ga hima a laabo ma a hallasi.
A ga hima ga nga tinayey toonandi.
Laabiizetara kubando ga ci bora ma du laabiizetaray tiraa nga hayrayey ma ga (kaŋ ga ci laabo boro yaŋ) wala mo hino ma bora no nd'a.
Bora ma te mo arkusu.
Adamayze alhakey dabaro ma ga laabiizetaray Nga no ga laabiizetaray margu nda jama poltik fondey teeyaŋ.
Wo-din fondo ra, laabiizetaray manci kala laabiizey kookaro nda i hina kaŋ ga naŋ i ma kambe daŋ goyey nda neesiyaŋey kulu kaŋ i ga te laabo hawzuyaŋ fondo ra.
Bonfeeray ma ga i ga hima ga sanni yaŋ te danga: Laabiizetaray boŋ sanniizey: Poltik teeyaŋ nda fondo/ laabu nda jama do burcintaray Bora kulu alhakey nda jine-funetaray maaney ciiyaŋ gayzetaray, laabiizey marga Adamayze fo alhaku beerandiyaŋ Borey jaŋ ga fahamyaŋ nda laabiizetaray Laabey ra care gaakasina dokkorayyaŋo Laabiizetaray boŋ-feeray jaŋay Deemokarasi fondo ra laabiizetaray boŋ fahamay jaŋay Laabiizey jaŋ laabiizetaray beerandiyaŋ booba Salaŋ ga ye care me ra kaŋ si ga wasa Laabey cinayaŋo kaŋ boŋ laabiizey si ga te me fo Laabiizey gaakasina si ga wasa.
Laabiizetaray nda laabu jine-koyyaŋ Laabu ra, laabiize nda laabiizetaray maaney gonda tontoniyaŋ kaŋ iri ga te i se.
Wo-din ga kande, laabiize wo boro no kaŋ gonda hina jare nga laabu hino do haray.
Danga a ga nga me daŋ hini fondey kayandiyaŋ ra, a ga ci hari kaŋ nga ga ba hino ma te wala jama ma te.
Adamayze me sanni kulu hima ga zaada ga kande borey se nafa.
Wo no ga cabe kaŋ wayborey ga ti fundi gaayikey, alborey mo fundi hallasikey nda batukey, zankey mo fundi tajandiyaŋ nda a koy jine yaŋ seeda no, dottijey baafuna ma si tuusu seedey no.
Sanni bangandiyaŋ nda a boŋ waafakay fayanka Ciiti fondey boŋ, fayanka go sanni bangadiyaŋ nda sanni gaayiyaŋ boro alhakey boŋ.
Sanni bangandiyaŋ gi ci fondey kaŋ boŋ nduggaa laabey sata waafaka kaŋ ga gomnantey daŋ fondo.
Manti tilas ciiti fondo haali no, koyne mo laabo mana kambe daŋ a ga.
I ma a bay yaŋo si te kala nda jama.
Sanni fo gaayiyaŋ (sarti) boro alhakey boŋ ga ti nduggaa laabey fondo no kaŋ ga ciitey tilsandi laabey kaŋ go sataa ra boŋ.
I ga naŋ laabey ma kambe daŋ a ga, nga day i ma sintin ga goy nd'a.
A gonda soola yaŋ kaŋ i te.
Laabu fo nduRRa ciiti fondo dumi-dumey ganayaŋ Gaayiyaŋ: fondo no kaŋ laabey ga gana ga yadda nda sanni fo gaayiyaŋ.
Kambe daŋ yaŋ: fondo no kaŋ laabey ga goy nda ciitey wala sanni fo gaayiyaŋ boŋ.
Laabo ga kambe daŋ ga cabe kaŋ nga si teera te kaŋ tiraa sooley kayandi.
Kambe daŋyaŋo ga hin ga te nda borey kaŋ laabo ga donton.
"Sanney kaŋ i gaayi wala a wane fondo fo ga saba nda yardayaŋ sintina.
A ganayaŋ manti tilas amma a ga cabe kaŋ laabo gonda niyya a ma sarto laasaabu a ma du ga yaari.
Ba day kaŋ kambe daŋyaŋo manti yaariyaŋo, a ga naŋ laabo ma si teera yaŋ te kaŋ si haggu nda nufey wala sarto sijiro " Yadda yaŋ: a ga cabe kaŋ laabo go sataa ra, wo-din no ga tilas dake a boŋ a sooley kulu ma ciiti fondey gana.
Sorro baa-yaŋ diptey no ga yarda amma kala nda zuuzu fu beero na guna ga di hala a ga koy nda laabo mayray tiraa.
Goy wo-din no ga naŋ laabo hino ma nga boŋ gaayi tiraa ga.
“Yardayaŋo wala furoyaŋo ga ti laabo ciiti fondey ma koy nda sanno kaŋ i gaayi sooley.
Ba kaŋ furoyaŋo nda yardayaŋo ga hari folloŋ hay, i ce-dirawey ga fay.
Yardayaŋo ga laabo ga kambe dake tira boŋ nga a ma yarda a ga.
Furoyaŋo mo ce folloŋ no a ga te, a sinda kambe daŋyaŋ fo koyne.
Yardayaŋo sooley kaŋ hino gaayi wala furoyaŋo ga barmay nda laabo mayray tiraa.
Hala i ga yarda wala ga furo, laabo ga sarto caw ga di hala a go koy nda nga mayray tiraa.” NduHHaa, gandey nda laabey adamayzey alhakey hallasiyaŋ fondey: goy-jiney nda ce-dirawey Adamayzey alhakey sanney bangandiyaŋo 1948, no te daba ndugga alhakey bangadiyaŋo booriyaŋo nda hina kaŋ a du cabe gaabo kaŋ a du laabo kulu ra.
Gaabo nda kwaasa kaŋ adamayzey alhakey bangandiyaŋo du no ga cabe a nafey ndugga laabey ra.
Adamayzey alhakey boŋ tiraa boobo no fatta ga dake wo-din ga.
Tirey wo mo no go ga kosaray boobo te adamayzey alhakey fondo ra.
NduRRaa marga beero adamayzey alhakey sanney bangandiyaŋo, 1948 Abirillu, 1945 no laabu waytaaci cindi hakku (48) wakiiley na care margu ga nduIIa margaa beero sinji, sarto fondey boŋ.
I na nduIIaa marga beero sinji no a ma du ga wangey banandi laabey nda cara game ra a ma salaŋ ga saba tiraa te.
ONU Laabu gaabikooni fo yaŋ mana ba i ma adamayzey alhaku te.
I mana yarda nda laabu fo yaŋ wala nduIIaa laabey ma furo mate kaŋ laabu fo ga nga laabiizey hawzu nda.
I ga miila kaŋ sanney din si furo day kala ngey laabu poltiko sanni ra.
Amma laabu fo yaŋ kaŋ ga kayna wo zaama, za day kaŋ Amirka na i gaagasinay nda mo faaliyaŋ kaŋ na adamayze alhakey daŋ ONU sarto ra.
Hala day tiraa mana ci alhaku kaŋ yaŋ no, hari kulu mo si tabbatandi kaŋ laabey kulu ga yarda nda alhakey din.
Adamayzey alhakey Adamayze alhakey sataa, i na a sijiri a ma du ga borey alhakey tirey te kaŋ borey kulu hima ga goy nd'ey nduIIaa ra, kaŋ borey kulu hima ga i bay.
Sataa jine-funa Eleanor Roosevelt no na sijiri te kaŋ bare ga ciya nduIIaa adamayze alhakey sanney bangandiyaŋo wala DUDH.
Sanney bangandiyaŋo wo, tiraa kaŋ na fondey kayandi kaŋ laabey tabattandi amma a si kankamandi ciito do haray.
DUDH sinda kala adamayze alhakey aya 30.
Aya dumi hinka no go no: Fuula-kwaarayey nda poltikey alhakey: Alhakey nda boŋ-duurey kaŋ ga borey hallasi nda hin futey a ma boro fo kulu no nga boŋ-duura.
Arzaka, nduIIa goray ndaa naamey alhakey: alhakey no kaŋ ga arzaka, nduIIa goray nda naamey hallasi.
NduIIa alhakey sanney bangandiyaŋo tiraa ne kaŋ adamayze alhakey hallasa ga kande laabo boŋ duure, ciiti nda baani goray, laabo ra; alhakey din ga wa nda mayray laala nda care guruzugandiyaŋ, a ga naŋ mo baafuna ma boori nduIIaa kulu ra.
Fuula-kwaarey nda poltikey mo ga borey hallasi nda hino mayray futay, a ga boŋ-duura no gaabi.
Ayey wo ra no i go: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21.
Arzaka, nduIIa goray nda naamey ga arzakey, goray nda naamey hallasiyaŋ tabbatandi.
Ayey wo ra no i go: 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27.
DUDH darzey ga ti: burcinitaray, sabayaŋ; boŋ-duure ciiti nda care beerandiyaŋ borey nda care game ra.
Adamayze alhakey tira teekey; Rene Casin, alhaku cawandiko beeri no, Faransi boro no: Peng-Chun Chang, sin bayraykooni beeri no, jine funa yarima no Eleanor Roosevelt, Amirki boro no, jine funa no Valentin Teplikor, nduIIa alhaku cawandiko beeri no Ruusi boro no Charles Malik, Liban bayraykooni beeri no Dr (Mrs) Hausa Nehta, cawandiko wayboro no, Indu no.
Ndugga alhakey goy-jiney wo, sarti yaŋ no kaŋ i te, i na kambe dake i ga, i margu-margu wala i kulu margu ga yarda i ga, a ga tilasandiyaŋ te laabey kulu kaŋ go a ra se.
Adamayze alhakey tira dumi boobo no go no kaŋ ga naŋ boro ma faham nda sanney kaŋ boŋ i ga salaŋ.
Sintina, boro ga du sanney gaayiyaŋ tira beerey kaŋ ga adamayze alhakey wala sata beeri waney kulu guna; tira ce-kayantey no.
NduRRa fonda ra (ONU), yarda tira hinka no go no kaŋ ga alhakey kaŋ i ci alhaakey sanni bangantey ra kaŋ na fuula-kwaarey boŋ-duura nda ndugga goray wane margu ga dunguriyandi nda mo i sabandiyaŋ: Ndugga yarda tiraa kaŋ ga salaŋ arzakey, ndugga goray nda naamey boŋ.
Arzaka fondo, ndugga baafunay nda naamey boŋ alhakey: fondey kaŋ ga arzakey ndugga lakkal kanay daahirandi..
CEDEAO gonda sanni baafunante yaŋ kaŋ ga ti: Baani goray nda fitiney hawzuyaŋ tiraa kaŋ CEDEAO te annasaara jiiri 1999 Mayra hanno tiraa kaŋ i tonton annasaara jiiri 2001 Borey koy nda ya, i goray alhako tiraa kaŋ i te annasaara jiiri 1979 Jama laabiizetaray tiraa kaŋ i te annasaara jiiri 1982 Sata hinkanta go no kaŋ na yardayaŋ tira yaŋ te kaŋ nufey ga ti adamayze alhaku waana-waana: Dumi tuusu, wongu ra taari beeri, nduggaa boŋ borey wiiyaŋ, tamtaray, adamayze neerayaŋ, pottol, laabu ra ganayaŋ, goray nda lakkal-kanay, kambe kuna futa nda taali fo yaŋ wala gurugay laalo kaŋ mana hagu.
Silmaney: Yardayaŋ tiraa kaŋ ga dumi tuusuyaŋo kosaray Yardayaŋ tiraa kaŋ ga fayanka-fayanka ban Yardayaŋ tiraa kaŋ ga tangam nda care kambe kuna futa nda boro taabandi dumi-dumey kaŋ si fondo.
Sata hinzanta gonda yardayaŋ tiraa kaŋ ga boro fo yaŋ hallasi kaŋ ga ti: borey kaŋ wongu dirandi ngey laabey ra, gawey, laabu waaniize, goyteerey wayborey, zankey, leebantey.
Silmaney: Yardayaŋ tiraa kaŋ ga haggoy nda zankey alhakey Yardayaŋ tiraa kaŋ ga fayanka-fayanka daŋ wayborey game ra ban Nduggaa yardayaŋ tiraa laabu waniizey nda ngey almayaaley alhakey hallasi.
Bananta day, i ga hin ga fayanka-fayanka yardayaŋ tirey margu kaŋ yaŋ ga tangam nda: dumi fayanka- fayanka, wo kaŋ ga salaŋ alboro wala wayboro boŋ, cawandiyaŋo fayanka-fayanka, wo kaŋ mo ga goy nda banandi guna yardayaŋ tiraa kulu ga sanka yaŋ sambu laabey se nda sooley kaŋ ga goyey gasandi nda fondey kaŋ ga i neesi.
Yarda tirey kulu ga gorandi kaŋ laabey ga goyey kaŋ i te hantum satti ga ka satti, nda goyey tontonyaŋo.
Wo-din ga naŋ i ma haggoy nda alhakey kaŋ tirey gaayi.
Goyey gasandiyaŋ hantum din no ndugga bayraykooni beerey ga margu ga guna, ga i ma a neesi.
(Silmaŋ: adamayze alhakey sataa kaŋ fuula kwaarey nda poltikey alhakey sarto gorandi.
Ngey no ga laasabuyaŋ wala janceyaŋ, tontoni i ga hin ga fahamey hã mo laabu fo ga mate kaŋ a go ga alhakey no wala a si ga i no.
Nduggaa kulu ra, borey hddney nda i hããyaŋey, boro folloŋ wala laabey gonda fondo yaŋ kaŋ i ga gana ga adamayzey alhakey taamuyaŋ jance.
Lalabuyaŋ tilasey: laabo hino hima ga kambe ka adamayze alhakey ce-dirawo ra.
Silmaŋ: Hallasiyaŋ tilasey: laabo hino hima ga alhakey taamuyaŋo kaŋ boro fo yaŋ go ga te kosaray.
Silmaŋ: wayborey alhakey kaŋ ga i wa da doŋ teera cindey hallasiyaŋ.
Tiksey gosandiyaŋ: laabo hino hima ga ciiti, mayray nda arzaka fondo yaŋ sambu kaŋ ga adamayzey alhakey gasandi, a ma i no gaabi.
Jaŋ ga tilasey wo haggoyyaŋ manti kala alhakey taamuyaŋ.
Laabey dabarey adamayzey alhakey no haray Da i ga ba deemokarasi ma du gaabi, kala day da i ma borey kulu no ngey alhakey.
Laabey hiney hima ga fondo ce-kayante kulu sambu kaŋ ga naŋ adamayzey alhakey ma gasu.
Laabu kulu hino hima ga soola ga kande nga gaakasiney jiney wala arzaka ga du ga alhaku gasandi.
A hima ga, nda nga ciiti fondey, ga taali teerey daabu, ga borey kaŋ i tooge bana, ga tangam nda bara- bara.
Adamayze alhakey hin fuwey ma borey hddney tirey nda hããyaŋ waney goy kaŋ manti nda laabo zuuzey.
Laabo ciiti fondey nda adamayzey alhakey sabandiyaŋ A ga tilas laabey hiney ga i ma ngey ciiti fondey sasabandi nda nduggaa adamayzey alhakey waney.
Adamayze alhakey yardayaŋ tirey wo borey kulu sanni no za day kaŋ i ga alhakey kaŋ ga boori boro kulu se ce-kayandi.
Ya-din ga, i ma ceeci fondo yaŋ kaŋ laabey hiney nda laabiizey ga ngey tinayey bonza.
Adamayzey alhakey goyo hima ga te borey wane, jama wala satey kaŋ ga tangam alhakey fondo ra, i tangam mo sankey kaŋ i sambu ma te cimi boro kulu baafuna ra.
I ma darza harey nda bayray kaŋ go nduggaa, gandey nda laabey haaley adamayzey alhakey boŋ bay.
I ma goyey gaabandiyaŋey dabarey kaŋ go nduggaa, gandey nda laabey haaley adamayzey alhakey boŋ bay.
I ma si dirgan mo adamayzey dumey kulu.
I ma cawandiyaŋo goyey kaŋ go ndugga, gandey nda laabey haaley adamayzey alhakey boŋ te.
I ma du da hanno yaŋ nduggaa, gandey nda laabey haaley adamayzey alhakey boŋ.

Adamayzey alhakey Sijirey sokonyaŋ Cawandiyaŋo nda dondonyaŋo nufa: I ma adamayzey alhakey darza harey nda bayray kaŋ go nduggaa, gandey nda laabey bay.
Caw ma nda cawandiyaŋo halo: Alhakey ceeciyaŋ Waaniyaŋey gorandiyaŋo Alwaato: guuru 2 Jiney/cawandiyaŋ jinayey Ndugga, gandey nda laabey jiney: (Tirey, sartey, yardayaŋ tirey) mayray tira, ciitey ayey nda ciiti tira fo yaŋ.
Deesaŋ, foto nda silma haaley (antarneetu).
Adamayzey alhakey Gagaro cawandiyaŋo nda dondoyaŋo ce-dirawo I ma adamayzey alhakey haaley, nda fondey bay I ma adamayzey alhakey goray, haaley fondey nda haaley goyey gaabandi; i ma goy mo nda satey tontoney I ma adamayzey alhakey goray haaley, fondey nda haaley cawandiyaŋ goyey te I ma du da hannay adamayzey alhakey gorey haaley, fondey nda haaley se.
Bayray kanandey Adamayzey alhakey nda ngey fondey Adamayzey ndu22a alhakey kaŋ si gana: Adamayzey alhakey te ndugga i kulu hari, i si gana mo.
Boro kulu ga hin ga goy nd'ey nangu kulu kaŋ bora go nduggaa boŋ.
Boro kulu si hin ga i naŋ nga baayi ra boro kulu mo si hin ga i ganji boro fo se.
Hari kaŋ si fay: Adamayzey alhakey si fay Fuula-kwaarey, poltikey, arzakey, ndugga goray nda naamey alhakey no ga adamayze no a burcinitara.
Darza follonkey no bora kulu se, i si hin mo ga i sogon kanandi kanandi kulu dumi boŋ.
Alhakey care ganayaŋo nda i gama: Alhaaku gasandiyaŋ a ma kubay wala a ma gaze si te kala day da alhaku foyaŋ gasu.
Alhakey sabayaŋ nda i jaŋ ga fayanka-fayanka: Adamayzey kulu ga hin ga du alhakey kaŋ sinda fayanka wana-wana dumey, harey, alboro wala wayboro, jiiri, ciine, addiini, laabiizetaray wala ndugga goray, leebu, arzaka hayyaŋ wala haali fo yaŋ sanda adamayzey alhakey goy- jinayey.
Gaakasinay nda jaŋ ga care waasuyaŋ.
Boro kulu wala dumey kulu gonda alhaku i ma kambe daŋ a se kaŋ sinda bara-bara nda kaŋ gonda maana.
I ma di a se, a ma di nga goray monduma, arzaka, baafunay, naamey nda poltiko kaŋ yaŋ ga adamayze alhakey fondey gasandi.
Alhakey baribata teeyaŋ nda tilaso nda i daŋ jine yaŋo.
Laabey hiney nda tilsey hawzukey hima ga ci mate kaŋ cine no i go ga adamayze alhakey kayandi nda.
Da i si ga ciiti fondey gana kaŋ go adamayze alhaku goy tirey ra, kulu alhakukoyey kaŋ waney i taamu ga hin ga i ce zuuzu kwaara wala ciiti fu fo do sanda mate kaŋ laabo mayray ciiti fondey na a gaayi nda.
Adamayzey alhakey Adamayzey alhakey haaley Boro kulu wane no adamayzey alhakey, i na nduggaa kulu kubay, za boro hay no a te boro wane.
Tira no kaŋ ga fahamay no cawey nda ngey ce- dirawey boŋ.
I si hin ga ne cawey nda ngey ce- dirawey kubay cip-cip.
Cawandiko albora/ waybora wo ceeciko no.
A ga du tiraa ra fondo yaŋ kaŋ ga naŋ a ma koy ga bayray ceeci ga tonton a cawandiŋo ma te nafa.
Wo kaŋ i go ga ceeci ga ti CEDEAO laabey ize alboro nda wayboro boobo ma goni margasinay, boŋ wasayaŋ nda care gaakasinay fondo ra.
A ga naŋ mo i ma da yaŋ kaŋ ga lakkal-kanay gorandi duumi ganda ra, fitiney ma ban pat, jine-koyyaŋ fondey ma goro ga boori.
Wo-ne yaŋ kulu si te kala nda i ma haggoy nda windanta, naamey, fayankayaŋey hari banda kaŋ i ga ba bora kulu ma kambe daŋ care kambe ra.
Caw iyye no go tiraa wo ra.
Caw kulu ga dira bayray boŋ.
Caw fo kulu gonda dumbari hinka.
Dumbari fo kulu ga salaŋ bayray fo boŋ kaŋ gonda cawandiyaŋ nufa yaŋ.
I na fahamay no cawey nda ngey ce-dirawey boŋ.
I na tira yaŋ nda antarnetu fondo yaŋ ci tira ra kaŋ cawandiko waybora /albora ga hin ga ceeci ga nga bayrayey guusandi.
I na boŋ-feeray nooyaŋ soola, i na cawey mo sijiri walhã ra.
Dumbari fo kulu ra i na cawandiyaŋ ce-dirawo soolaa cabe.
Cawandika ga jeeri goy-jiney kaŋ go no ga, ga caw ce-dirawo boryandi.
Bayray hinza boŋ mo caw 1 ga koy 7 ga salaŋ.
Kambe daŋ care kambe ra ga goy, ga du ga to CEDEAO jine-koyyaŋ nda baafunay barmayyaŋ hanno nufey do.
Wo kaŋ i go ga batu: CEDEAO laabiize kookarante kaŋ ga ba margasinay sijiro, kaŋ yadda nda waafakey borey nda care game ra, care diiyaŋ nufa ceeciyaŋ fondo ra.
Laabiizetaray tabbatandiyaŋ laasaabuyaŋ ra a ma du ga hin ga nga boŋ wasa.
Wo kaŋ i go ga batu: A ma ciya laabiize kaŋ ga laabaarey neesi, a ga laasaabu hanno te, a du ga bay CEDEAO laabiizetaray tinayey kaŋ go nga boŋ.
A ma kande nga gaakasinay nga nda laabiize alborey nda wayborey poltikey sijirey teeyaŋey gasandiyaŋey nda i neesiyaŋey fondo ra, adamayzey alhakey tangami ra.
Wo kaŋ i go ga batu: Laabiize kaŋ ga CEDEAO seedey nda mayrayey ce-dirawey bay, a ma ciya mo laabiize kaŋ ga adamayzey alhakey, baani goray, deemokarasi batu waafakay boŋ, laabey goyey ra nda ganda goyey ra.
Wo-ne yaŋ, fondo yaŋ no kaŋ ga tilas laabiize ma du ga lakkal ye kwaarey care se nda mayray hanno ma ga, laabu kulu ma te mate kaŋ ga naŋ tiraa ma CEDEAO naamey gana; a ma goy nda wo kaŋ tiraa ci wala a ma a kubandi.
I ma laabo cawyaŋ sijirey guna ga gana.
A ga hima i ma i cawandiyaŋ ce-dirawey gana danga te ga cabeyaŋ, tiyaatar kayney, silmaŋey… I ma mo ye mo CEDEAO nufey gaabandiyaŋ nda i gasandiyaŋ ga.
Ann Thérèse NDONG-JATTA UNESCO Dakaaru Jine-funa Baani goray ce- kayandiyaŋ, fitiney kosarayyaŋ nda i hawzuyaŋ «Adamayzey lakkaley ra no wangey ga sintin, i lakkaley mo no hima ga baani goray fondey kayandi...
» UNESCO sinjiyaŋ tiraa, 1945 Kayfuru aani goray wo borey no ga a cina, i si hay nd'a.
Rom doŋ yaasay fo no ga ne: “boro kaŋ ga ba baani goray ma wangu soola.
Amma, baani goray ceeciyaŋ fondo ra, sanni wo-ne dumi si hagu.
Hari no kaŋ laasaabu ce-kayante ga kande.
Fayanka booba kaŋ go adamayzey game ra (naamey, poltik, arzaka fondey, dumey nda diiney do haray) care hattayaŋ si jaŋ borey nda care game ra.
A ga hima borey ma faham nda care, baani goray ma duumi borey nda care game ra.
Wo-din se no tiraa wo ra i mana hirri daŋ baani goray ce- kayandiyaŋ nda fitiney hawzuyaŋ game ra.
Tiraa bayra: A ga alhaali yaŋ, misa yaŋ nda dabari yaŋ no borey se baani goray ce- kayandiyaŋ nda fitiney hawzuyaŋ fondo ra.
Tiraa dumbarey Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ Fitiney hawzuyaŋ Tira 1: Baani-goray ce-kayandiyaŋ, fitiney kosarayyaŋ nda i hawzuyaŋ A ga alhaali yaŋ, misa yaŋ nda dabari yaŋ no borey se, baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ fondo ra.
Cawandiyaŋo nda dondonyaŋ nufey Borey ma du fahamay nda carmay baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ; I ma dabari yaŋ te kaŋ ga naŋ baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ ma duumi ga marga nda adamayzey baafunay fondey ganayaŋ; I ma cawandiyaŋ te baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ; I ma alhaali gana kaŋ ga baani-goray daahirandi.
Bayray kanandey Baani-goray Baani goray manti kala fondo yaŋ kaŋ ga borey ga du misa yaŋ, bayray yaŋ, ga alhaali yaŋ, laasaabu yaŋ nda da yaŋ no gaabi.
Wo-din ga naŋ boro ma faham nda boro baafuna, boro cindey baafunayey nda boro windanta.
Baani-goray maaney Alwaati kaŋ wangu si laabu ra: I ma tangam baani-goray ma te nduggaa ra; Alwaati kaŋ boro yaŋ kaŋ go ga care wangu na hari mun nunaa ra: lakkal-kanay ceeciyaŋ; Awaati kaŋ ma-care se go borey game ra, yadda go laabiizey game ra, dumey game ra, kaŋ daamantey nda hina-baney si ga care fitina, nda kusuuma si laabu ra; Alwaati kaŋ boro yaŋ kaŋ go ga goro care ra si ga fitina; Alwaati kaŋ adamayze fo kulu go lakkal-kanay goray ra; Alwaati kaŋ adamayze fo si sakulla kulu ra; Alwaati kaŋ faami, kosongu kulu si batame ra: saarayey ra siriw.
Baani-goray dumi-dumey Baani goray kwaarayzo: a manti kala alwaati kaŋ ra fitina kulu dumi si borey nda care game ra.
Baani-goray cinanta: wo-ne si te kala borey kookarey kaŋ i ga te adamayzey baafuney ma boori fondo ra.
A mana ci borey care wiiyaŋey nda fitiney hinne jaŋay.
Alhaali hannoyaŋ go no kaŋ ga naŋ borey ma du baani goray wo-ne: Bisandi care se yaŋ; Care hanganyaŋ; Salaŋ ga ye care me ra; Borey ma yadda misaaley nda boro cindey me-sanney fondo kulu ra; Wayborey nda alborey ma care daŋ me ga; Sandayey waate i ma cahã ka i bonza; Margasinay; Laasaabu hanno; Adamayze kulu ma nga dottijotaray daahirandi.
Amma alhaali hanney wo i ga ba i ma i no gaabi biirimay ra.
Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ: “Alhaali no kaŋ ra i ga naanay nda margasinay daŋ laabey nda borey game ra.
A ga naŋ i ma ceeci ga fitiney kaŋ ga hin ga furo borey game bonza lakkal-kanay ra; danga salaŋ ga care me ra yaŋ ra kaŋ sinda malfa sambuyaŋ wala lakkal-tunay fo.
Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋo manci fitiney ganjiyaŋ no sam-sam, day i ma ceeci ga hari mun nuuna kuna baani-baani ra.
Ya-din ga, a ga ceeci adamayzey alhaaley, i ma i beerandi, borey ma yaafa care se i ma yanje naŋ, borey ma zaada, baaricey ma zaada.
Ndu22aa laabey margaa ga ne kaŋ, baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ manti kala hari hanno yaŋ, da yaŋ nda baafunay misa yaŋ kaŋ ra sakulla kulu si, i ga fitiney kosaray mo za tikisey ga, salaŋ ga ye care me ra nda faaliyaŋ ga (nduIIaa laabey marga beero sankey A/RES/52/13: Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ nda A/53/243: Waafakay nda sijiri baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ).
“Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ manti kala adamayzey barmayyaŋ, fondo, jama nda mayray fuwey barmayyaŋ fondo.
A ga te no borey yaddayaŋ nda i goyey banda, a ga te mo laabu kulu ra mate kaŋ arzakey fondey, borey baafunay fondey nda taarifi fondey na a dogonandi nda.
Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ ga borey da nda i alhaaley barmay ga kande lakkal-kanay nda ma care se.
Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ biirima I ma borey biiri baani goray boŋ manti kala i ma du laabiize lakkalkooni nda wo kaŋ ga ba gaakasinay borey nda care game ra; a ga ba naamu waaney, a ga boŋ-duure kaani bay, a ga adamayze burcintaray beerandi nda fayankey kaŋ ga hin ga kande yanje.
A ma te mo boro kaŋ ga hin ga fitiney kosaray wala a ma i gaayi baani-baani ra.
Baani goray biirima mo ga goy nda laabu kulu arzaka fondey, borey baafunay nda laabey taarifi fondey.
I ga hin ga ne kaŋ baani goray boŋ biirima ganjo ga ci a ma wangu ganji: hari sintina kaŋ na wangu ganji ga ci waafakay beero kaŋ te wangu ganjiyaŋ ma ga, kaŋ i sambu danga laabey ce-diraw.
Maayo kaŋ i ga a bay nda ga ci “Pacte Briand-Kellog” kaŋ te 1928.
Jare fo mo, i na nduggaa laabey marga beero sinji 1945, “ga nduggaa wa nda wangey, i ma te hari kaŋ ga naŋ ciiti fondey ma boori, i ma goy mo nda waafakey nda wo kaŋ yaŋ nduggaa alhaku fondey ci.
I ma ceeci ga borey baafuney boryandi, boŋ-duure bambata ra.
Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ, fitiney kosarayyaŋ nda i hawzuyaŋ Baani goray boŋ biirima, ga naŋ mo koyne “borey ma faham nda care, i ma yaafa care se, corotaray ma furo laabey game ra, borey game ra nda diiney game ra.
A ga nduggaa laabey margaa, kundaa kaŋ ga haggoy nda baani goray-goyey dogonandi” (aya 26, Adamayzey nduggaa ra alhakey kayandiyaŋ sarto).
Baani-goray boŋ biirima ciya nduggaa laabey marga beero se goy bambata, nga nda laabey kaŋ go a ra.
I ma bakaraw daŋ cawo ra ma ga, baani goray boŋ biirima cawandikey ga tangam nda adamayzey burcintaray taamuyaŋey kaŋ talkatara, fayankey, wayborey ga kaŋyaŋey nda fitiney ga kande.
Sintina day, i mana ba kala baani goray boŋ biirima ma nduggaa borey alandaabayaŋo gaayi kaŋ wangu beerey go ga te.
Amma, sohoŋ a nufa beero ga ci a ma baani goray ce-kayandi.
Baani goray sinjiyaŋo sandayey Baani goray sinjiyaŋo ga hin ga du sanday yaŋ sanda: Jaŋ ga salaŋ ga ye care me ra yaŋ; Jaŋ ga adamayze alhakey beerandiyaŋ; Jaŋ ga saajo nda haro hallasiyaŋ; Jaŋ ga wayboro nda alboro saaye sasabandiyaŋ; Mayray laalo; Jaŋ ga zagu ga di harey kaŋ te bandayaŋ; Jaŋ ga deemokarasi fondey beerandiyaŋ; Lakkal-tunay; Jaŋ ga adamayzey boona kayna-kayney toonandiyaŋ; Jaŋ ga taaliteerey diiyaŋo; Jaŋ ga waasi ga misa laaley bonzayaŋ.
Amma, baani goray sinjiyaŋ sanday beerey CEDEAO ganda ra ga ci fitina laaley, borey bine-kooga kaŋ ga to fundi ciine ga, alboro, wayboro nda zanka yaŋ se; cinari beerey alandaabayaŋ, borey baafuney daŋ care ra yaŋ nda lakkal-tunay beeri.
Dabarey kaŋ ga naŋ baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ ma koy nda jina Baani goray ma koy jina ma ga, CEDEAO laabey hima ga dabari yaŋ te: Ciiti fondey ma kay laabiize kulu se; I ma kambe daŋ satey kaŋ go ga goy baani goray fondo ra se, danga satey kaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra, nduggaa laabey marga beero saruusey; I ma mayray fuwey kaŋ go laabey ra no gaabi, i ma laabey nda care game ra waafakayey beerandi; I ma laabey sariya-fondey beerandi; I ma bayrayey nda laasaabey cawandi, kaŋ ga naŋ borey ma baani-goray no gaabi; borey ma baani-goray no gaabi; borey ma waani borey ra goray, i ma faham nda ngey boŋ, i ma faham nda care; I ma te hari kaŋ ga naŋ adamayzey alhakey ma koy jine.
Afriki wayno-kaŋay laabey satey ra CEDEAO ga ci wo kaŋ na lakkal daŋ gumo baani-goray ga.
Afo, a na sooje yaŋ samba i ma borey ga-ham baano hallasi laabu yaŋ ra (Liiberiya, Saaliyo, Giine Biso a Kuduwaaru), a ye ga tira yaŋ mo ka taray baani goray fondo ra.
Silmaŋ kayna: waafaka kaŋ ga haggoy nda baani goray hawzuyaŋ, nda a gaayiyaŋ.
A ga haggoy mo nda fitiney kosarayyaŋ, nda i gaayiyaŋ (i mana a ka taray kala deesambur 1999).
Tiraa wo kubando i na a te deesambur 2001, deemokarasi nda mayray hanno boŋ.
SIJIREY TIRAA Tira 1: Baani-goray ce-kayandiyaŋ, fitiney kosarayyaŋ nda i hawzuyaŋ Dumbari 1: baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ Dumbaro bayra Cawandiyaŋ nda dondonyaŋ nufey Borey ma du fahamay nda carmay baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ; I ma dabari yaŋ te kaŋ ga naŋ baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ ma duumi ga marga nda adamayzey baafunay fondey ganayaŋ; I ma cawandiyaŋ te baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ; I ma alhaali gana kaŋ ga baani-goray daahirandi.
Alwaato: guuru 14 Goy-jiney / caw harey / tirey Sijirey nda tirey CEDEAO boŋ-feeray tiraa Silmey Fotey nda deesaŋey Tirey nda suurey kaŋ ga salaŋ baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ Antarneetu fondey kaŋ ga salaŋ baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ Sijirey sokonyaŋ walhã CAWANDIYAŊ CE-DIRAWO SIJIRO Dumbari 1: Bani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ Dumbaro bayra I ma darza harey, bayray, waaniyaŋ nda haaley daŋ baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋo ra, ga i bay.
Cawandiyaŋo wala dondonyaŋo nufey - I ma baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋo darzey nda bayrayey bay ga boori Cawo maayo nda cawandiyaŋo haalo Waaniyaŋey kaŋ i gorandi Alwaato: guuru 2 Goy-jinayey, cawandiyaŋ ganjey nda tirey Gande fo ra wongu fotey Care diiyaŋ, ma care se yaŋ nda goray hanno CEDEAO laabey cawandiyaŋ sooley CEDEAO tira baafunantey Laabaari tirey Baani-goray seeda deesaŋo (cawko kulu nda nga deesaŋo) Deesaŋ nda foto yaŋ Baani goray ce-kayandiyaŋ, fitiney kosarayyaŋ nda i hawzuyaŋ Gagaro cawandiyaŋo nda dondonyaŋo ce-dirawo Dumbaro bayra I ma du darza hari yaŋ, bayrey nda ndugga goray ga du ga fitiney hawzuyaŋ ce-dirawo bay.
Cawandiyaŋo nda dondonyaŋ nufey I ma faham nda fitiney nda i hawzuyaŋ bayra nda sanniizey; I ma waani fitiney kosarayyaŋ nda i hawzuyaŋ; I ma fitiney kosarayyaŋ, hawzuyaŋ nda i bonzayaŋ gaabandi i ma goy nda darza harey nda ciitey kaŋ ga haggoy nda fayanka-fayankey; I ma cawandiyaŋ goyey kaŋ ga fitiney kosaray, a ga i hawzu nda i bonzayaŋ te; I ma du haali hanno yaŋ kaŋ ga fitiney kosaray, a ga i hawzu, a ga i bonza.
Bayray kananndey Fitina: Fitina ga ti jaŋ ga ma care se sanni fo boŋ kaŋ ga hin ga kande sanday haaley ra, lakkaley wala ga-ham ga.
Jaŋ ga care ganayaŋ, kakaw, jaŋ ga ma care se yaŋ no: miiley, diiyaŋey, diiney, nafey, dumey, kundey, nda borey booney.
A ganjiyaŋ ga gaabu iri se zama adamayze takaro ga no a go, a go mo nangu kulu: Windi ra, Gomnantey, Mayray fu beerey, Satey, wkc.
Fitina dumi-dumey Fitina dumi-dumi no go no.
Wongey Ndugga wongu (laabey nda cara) nda Laabu wongu (laabiizey nda cara).
Ndugga wala laabey nda cara wongu ga ti fitina kaŋ na laabu hinka wala laabu boobo margu.
Wongu kaŋ mana ndugga kubay wala laabu wongu ga ti.
Wongu kaŋ furo laabo soojey nda kundey kaŋ na malfa sambu care ga wala mo kundey nda care game ra.
Borey baafuna ra fitiney Borey baafuna ra fitiney wala fitiney kaŋ ga furo borey nda cara game ra ga ti jaŋ ga ma care se yaŋ kaŋ ga furo boro hinka game ra (zama se i faham care se, donda-caray, jaŋ ga saaware care ga yaŋ, wkc.).
A ga hin ga te mo kaŋ boro bumbo no si faham nda nga boŋ (bora nda nga boŋ fitina).
Fitiney mafaarey ga ti: Laasaabey kaŋ i gaayi (ga-ham, lakkal, baafunay, borey wala dumey wkc.) Care waasu nda fayanka-fayanka (sikka, dumi-fantayaŋ, jaŋ ga yaafayaŋ, tooge care ka waaniyaŋ, alboro wala wayboro fayanka, ciiti jaŋay, yaw wangay, dumi fayanka, addini fayanka, jaŋ ga sabayaŋ, baara-baara..), Adamayzey da laalay (adiilitaray jaŋay, bakiiluitaray, sikka guunuwa, laami, canse, nooru baagasinay, kuta, jaŋ ga naanay, koytaray baagasinay, karhã, humburukumay, tooge, kambe kuna futay...), Sanney jaŋ ga care ganayaŋ (jaŋ ga ma care se yaŋ, care futandiyaŋ...), Laabaari jaŋey (miila yamo wala tangari, jaŋ ga ma care se wala jaŋ ga faham care se), Mayray laalo nda deemokarasi gazeyaŋ (mayray fuwey nukando, taali gooba jaŋey, himandey kayandiyaŋ jaŋay, talkataray, arzaka duure kaŋ sinda fondo tangamyaŋ…), Mayray baka-baana, Laabo nda laabey nda care game ra kaŋ hirrey si hin ga biirimay laala nda wongu arzaka zaadayaŋo ganji.
Fitiney dumey Poltik fitiney Baafunay fitiney Naamu fitiney Arzaka fitiney Addiney fitiney Dumey fitiney Fitiney hawzuyaŋ nda i kosarayyaŋ: dabarey Baani goray waate: i ga hin ga goray hanno te fitiney waate nda i ga goy nda fitina hawzuyaŋ cawandiyaŋo dabarey lokkol nda boŋ-feeray sentarey.
A ga naŋ i ma du da hanno, alhaali hina wo-ne yaŋ dumi: tabbatandi, waaniyaŋ, adilitaray nda margasinay, laabaari nooyaŋ hanno nda faham care se yaŋ.
Harey kaŋ wongey nda fitiney ga hay ga ba gumo: fundi nda jiney jaŋay, adamayze kar ga sayyaŋ, lakkal-tunay, fayyaŋ, kuray-fay, care wiiyaŋ, tuuriize hanyaŋ nda furukutaray, windanta nda cinarey alandaaba borey ganayaŋo, doori, wayborey komyaŋ nda i sarayaŋ, baafunay saruusey, lokkoley, labtaaney ganji goyyaŋ, wkc.
Wongey waate: “DIH nufa ga ti a ma adamayze kaŋ wongu ŋwa fundey nda i burcinitara hallasi nda mo a ma taabey kaŋ wongey kande zabu.
Ndugga fondo yaŋ no kaŋ ga hiney nda wongu teerey kaynandi, a ga borey kaŋ si yanja ra hallasi.
DIH kaŋ i cina wongey ma ga si adamayzey alhakey kaŋ ga goy alwaati kulu barmay.
Alhaku kunda hinkaa din ga care kubandi no.

Hiney kaŋ i ga gaabandi Mayray hanno Dumbaro ce-dirawo Deemokaraasi nda mayray hanno Gayyaŋo: guuru 2 Cawandiyaŋ ministaro saruuso goyteerey sillaa CAWO INTERNEETU BOŊ: DEEMOOKARAASI NDA MAYRAY HANNO Dumbari 1: Deemookaraasi Sanniizey wallafiyaŋo Deemookaraasiyo (Suuraa kaŋ Daniel Gagie, Paari I Nibarsita poltik cawandika te) Deemookaraasi wo poltik ce-diraw sogonyaŋ zeeno no.
Maanaa kaŋ Abraham Lincoln na a no ga ti “laabiizey mayra kaŋ laabiizey ga te laabiizey ma ga''.
Poltik sijiri kulu ra no laabiizey mayyaŋ go.
Laabiizey ga ti jamaa kaŋ go ga baafunay te care ra, laabu gande follonka ra.
Nangu kaŋ deemookaraasi sijiro ga fay nda sijiri cindey ga ti kaŋ nga wo ra, borey kaŋ i ga may day ga ti borey kaŋ go ga may, zama i ga i daŋ sankey kulu kaŋ ga kwaaraa guna sambuyaŋo saawarey ra.
Wo-din se no i ga ne deemookaraasi ga laabiizey nafa fondey kayandi.
Borey go ga ngey boŋ hã mate kaŋ deemookaraasi ra i ga laabiizey daŋ mayra ra.
Za doŋ, dumey kaŋ se i ga gareekey waate, kala a ma ka ga to jiiri zambar 1 nda zangu 9, hini kaŋ ra i ga sariyey ŋwa batu, diptey fuwo ra, hala i ga i sambu hinne se no i ga hini deemookaraasi ganako.
Sappey kaŋ i ga te ga boro gure-gure yaŋ suuban ga mayra daŋ i kambey ra wo manti deemookaraasi fondo.
Mayra kaŋ go laabiizey wakiiley kambe ra hinne no ga deemookaraasi fondey gana.
Ya-din ga, sohoŋ, sappey kaŋ laabiizey ga te ga ngey wakiiley sambu wo deemookaraasi fondo no.
Swis kwaara fo yaŋ hinne ra no gonda deemookaraasi kaŋ sinda wakiili suubanyaŋ.
Mayray fu, sariya, teere, naamu nda waakiili dumi-dumi yaŋ no go deemookaraasi ra.
Wakiiley no ga fondey kaŋ borey hima gana ka, nga mo no ga naŋ borey ma goy nda poltik sankey.
Wakiiley ma ga no tangami boobo go ga te, poltik fondo zeeney gaayiyaŋ wala ga i barmayyaŋ do hare.
Bayraykooney salaŋ gumo fondey kaŋ ga deemookaraasi cina boŋ.
Ngey ga ti sariyey, mayray fuwey nda mayray laasaabey.
I na janceyaŋ boobo te deemookaraasi dumi-dumey kulu se, ga afo kulu taaley ci ga du ga barmayyaŋ hanno daŋ a ce-dirawo ra.
Iri ga haw ga di tira wo-ne ra sohoŋ deemookaraasiyey ce-diraw haaley baayaŋo kulu.
Wo-din fondo ra, laabey wakiiley ma naŋ i ma deemookaraasiyey ce-dirawey nda i laasaabey kar care ga.
Wakiiley din ga no i ga jeeri ga deemookaraasi dumi-dumey fisi.
Alhaali boobo ra no cawka ga nga bayra cina.
Ihinkanta kaŋ fun sintina ga, ra no cawka ga marga nda nga caley nda windanta ga nga bayra cina.
Ifo ga ti bayray gorandiyaŋ dabaro maanaa?
Sintina: bayray gorandi dabaro ga cabe hari kaŋ cawka hima ga waani.
I si gaabandi cawandika bayra ga.
Ihinkanta: dabari wo-ne ga hin ga cawkey no maana.
I ma si cawkey no daama i ma ngey boŋ hã hari kaŋ ngey cawey ga hanse ngey se.
bayray gorandiyaŋ dabaro ga naŋ cawka ma nga bayrayey gorandi waati kulu alhaaley kaŋ gonda maana ra, a ma ye ga nafa nd'ey alhaaley din ra.
Bayray gorandiyaŋ dabaro ga cawkey bayrayey daahirandi sanday bonzayaŋ fondo ra, manti bayray nda goy waaniyaŋ no kaŋ cawka ga hin ga digga, kaŋ mo a si bay mate kaŋ nga ga hin ga nafa nda nga baafuna ra.
Bayray gorandiyaŋ cawandiyaŋ Bayray gorandiyaŋ dabaro gaabo ga ci bayray gorandiyaŋ cawandiyaŋo.
Ifo ga ti bayray gorandiyaŋ cawandiyaŋ maana?
Fondo no I ga gaayi kaŋ manti bayray nda goy waaniyaŋ hinne ga no a ga kay, amma a ga cawka daŋ a ma nga bayrayey margu ga sannay bonza kaŋ gonda a se maana.
Deemookaraasiyey janceyaŋ boobo go adamayzey baafunay boŋ caw guusey ra.
Caw guusey wo ga hin ga fondey kaŋ ga deemookaraasiyey nda mayray laasaabey margu cabe.
Tira Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi, Baani Goray nda Jine- koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ Manti i ma borey kaŋ na taali beerey te wayborey se jukkeyaŋ hinne ma ga no i na laabey nda kundey tilsandi i ma taali beerey toonandi borey do.
A ga adilitaray tabbatandi laabo ra.
Da adilitaray si no, baani goray si te.
Jaŋ ga taali teeko jukkeyaŋ ga laabey kaŋ ra baani ye ga ka ganjey nakkasandi, ga fitina nda baara-baara daŋ i ra.
A ga lakkal-tunay nda baara-baara gorandi laabo ra, a ga wayborey mo daŋ haali laalo ra kaŋ ga ti wangey tunyaŋo.

NduHHaa laabey marga beero ne ‘'Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi fahama, wangu waate, ga naŋ baani goray nda a gaabandiyaŋo ma tabbati duumi tutuutu''.
Kayfuru a baayaŋ kulu, alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi wo laasaabu no kaŋ borey miila ga, wayborey hinne no a ga guna.
Tira fo no fatta ga ci nangu kaŋ laasaabu yaamo wo ganda hay ga to nduIIaa ra.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi wo baafunay laasaabu no kaŋ ga fayanka kaŋ go borey nda care game ra, farji, dumi, talakataray wala arzaka, jiiri nda wkc do hare cabe.
A ga kundey bisandi care.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi wo ga kande adamayze zaadayaŋ nda a jine-koyyaŋ, lakkal-kanay gorandiyaŋ ceeciyaŋ fondo ra.
Wo-din banda, ba kaŋ jiiri bandey wo wangey zabu Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra, lakkal- kanay nda baani goray ma sinji ga boori go borey se sikka ra.
Borey kaŋ ga haggoy baani goray ma tabbati laabey kaŋ ra wangey bu go ga kookari ga wangey kosoray, ga waafakay daŋ borey game ra, ga laabey cina, ga baani gora, deemookarasiyo nda mayray hanno fondey gaabandi.
Ba kaŋ alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi laasaabo ga boro boobo guna, wayborey nda zankey day no wangey ga taabandi gumo.
Hakiika, baani goray si te da manti wayborey nda zankey no furo a ceeciyaŋo nda a gaabandiyaŋo ra.
Sanney wo, CEDEAO wayborey baani nda lakkal-kanay gorandiyaŋ sataa no na i te 2009 Abuja margaa soolayaŋo ga.
I ga cabe kaŋ i hima ga wayborey daŋ baani goray hawzuyaŋey nda wangey wiiyaŋ ra.
Amma, wayborey si furo arzaka nda baafunay fondey boryandiyaŋ gurja ra, da i si ga ngey bumbo nda i nafa fondey laasaabu.
Wo-din se no CEDEAO alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fuwo na baani goray nda lakkal-kanay daŋ nga sijiri baajiney ra.
Anniyaa wo se no i na alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi fondey daŋ tiraa wo ra kaŋ ga alhaali hanno no baani goray nda jine-koyyaŋ boŋ.

Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi Dumbari 1: Alboro nda wayboro himandey Dkuamybaarni bdayirayey: I ma du sanniizey nda haaley kaŋ ga alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyaŋ guna.
Cawandiyaŋo nufey: I ma sanniizey kaŋ go alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyaŋ fondey ra bay I ma cawyaŋ te kaŋ ga dira alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyaŋ I ma du alhaali hanno kaŋ ga alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyaŋ tabbatandi.
Cawey Sanniize baajiney maaney Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ: sanniizey wo no ga cabe margasinay nda fayanka booba kaŋ go alboro nda wayboro game.
Fayanka fo yaŋ kaŋ go i game ga hin ga barmay da alwaato ku wala bine da i fun naamu fo ga koy afo.
Farji: a si barmay, boro ga hay nd'a no Alboro nda wayboro sabayaŋ: alhaani hanno no kaŋ ga naŋ i ma alboro nda wayboro saayey sasabandi arzaka nda jine-koyyaŋ fondey do hare Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ: alhaali hanno no kan ga adilitaray daŋ alboro nda wayboro game.
Alboro nda wayboro ma saba cicip: alborey nda wayborey ma caw cawandiyaŋ gagarey kulu ra Alboro nda wayboro game ra fayanka-fayanka: baara-baara kaŋ i ga cabe alboro wala wayboro se Alboro nda wayboro boŋ laasaabu laaley: laasaabu yaŋ no kaŋ i ga te alboro wala wayboro boŋ ga cabe kaŋ Irkoy no na alboro bisandi wayboro; i si ne jama baafunay fondey sogonyaŋo no na i goyey fay.
Mayray duure: hini, mayra ra furoyaŋ, suubanyaŋ, faaliyaŋ, boŋ-duure gaabandiyaŋ.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi fondey Cawo wo ga no i ga alborey nda wayborey nafa fondey, i goyey nda i margasina laasaabu.
Fondey wo, fondo baajini yaŋ no kaŋ ga kwaara wala laabo jine-koyyaŋo boryandi, a ga laabo wala laabey marga- marga sijirey gasandiyaŋ.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ go arzaka nda baafunay fondey kulu ra, boro fo wala jama wane.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi fondey taarifo 1950 no i na kampani beerey (nduggaa banci beero nda sudurku beero) sijiri.
Laabey cinayaŋ nda i hanseyaŋ alwaato no.
Wangey ban azawaka-kambe, annassarey laabey ra, boro-bi laabey, kaŋ go dandi- kambe, mo go ga gurjay ngey boŋ-duura fondo ra.
Hala wo yaŋ ga te, i na wayborey baani fondey hawzuyaŋ kundaa sinji 1946.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi, Baani Goray nda Jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ 1960 furoyaŋo waate no kundey go ga gurjey, nduggaa kulu ra, ga ngey ciiti fondey do hare alhakey kayandi: Goray hanno fondey Laasaabu hanno yaŋ kaŋ ga wayborey daŋ jine-koyyaŋ goyey ra Wayborey daŋ jine-koyyaŋ fondey ra Wayboro nda jine-koyyaŋ: wayborey fatawco go ga zaada, Wayborey daŋyaŋ jine-koyyaŋ goyey ra nafey: i ga wayborey daŋ jine-koyyyaŋ fondo ra bayra/fahama laasaabu zama ngey nda alborey waney ga fay; Wayborey daŋ jine-koyyaŋ nafa ga ti: i ga sijiri hanno yaŋ gorandi wayborey ma ga, kaŋ gonda i se nafa; Wayboro yaŋ kay ngey boŋ ga, i tangam mo nda sandayey kaŋ alborey goy jaŋa kande i ga.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fonda ga boori sasabandiyaŋo kaŋ adamayze alhakey kayandi nufey do tooyaŋ se, a ga boori mo duumi jine-koyyaŋ dabarey gorandiyaŋ se.
1990 no batama hagoyyaŋ, borey, arzaka nda naamey duumi jine-koyyaŋ fondey ma care gana se, i na lakkal ye wayborey daŋ jine-koyyaŋ goyey ra nda i sasabandiyaŋ nda alborey ga.
Peekan 1995 margaa kaŋ i te wayborey ma zaadayaŋ boŋ na alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey nda jine-koyyaŋ toonandi borey do.
Wayborey ma kay ngey boŋ ga, nda borey wala kundey bisa care bonza yaŋo ma ga no i na margaa te.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fonda wo dabari taji no kaŋ ga fayankey kaŋ go alboro nda wayboro wala arwasu nda wandiyo game ra cabe.
Diraw follonka Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey wo dabari no kaŋ ga adamayzey himandey kayandi no gaabi.
A ga alborey nda wayborey sasabandi jine-koyyaŋ dabarey nda a goyey ra.
Wo-din banda mo, a ga naŋ wayborey nda alborey ma furo jine-koyyaŋ nufey kayandiyaŋ nda i sogonyaŋ dirawo ra, i ma du ikulu boona baajiney laasaabu.
Dirawo wo ga kande i ma gomney kaŋ jine-koyyaŋ goyey go ga hay alborey nda wayborey se, nango kulu hare, guna ga boori/fisi.
Hala i ga sankey sambu, nufey, dabarey nda arzaka fayyaŋo boŋ, i hima i ma fisiyaŋo wo te.
Goy fayyaŋ nda margasina kaŋ go borey game ra -Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ boŋ fahamey nooyaŋ: goray alhaali si barmay da manti i na dabarey Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi kaŋ na a sinji barmay no.
Fondo wo-ne ra i hima no i ma barmayyaŋ daŋ naamey nda laasaabey kulu ra.
Ya-din ga i ga hima ga naamey guna ga dabari hanno yaŋ gorandi borey kaŋ ga goyey te nda batamey kaŋ ra i ga goyey te ma ga.
Arzaka fondey, laabo alhaalo nda a ce-diraw fondey, diina nda naamu no ga margasina kaŋ go alborey nda wayborey game ra gorandi, ngey mo no ga ci goyey kaŋ i gisi wayborey se.
fondey wo kaŋ iri kabu- kabu ga care gana no, barmayyaŋ mo ga hin ga furo i ra.
Silmaŋ: laabu fo ga hin ga ba-care daŋ alboro nda wayboro game ra, nga mayray tiraa ra.
Ba-cara ga hin ga hiijay, fayyaŋ, hayra goyey, zankey gaayiyaŋo, hananyaŋ nda borey gaakasina guna.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi, Baani Goray nda Jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ goy-jiney: Marga beerey kaŋ te Mexico nda Beijing: Marga beerey kaŋ i te wayborey boŋ (nango kaŋ i du sanno: UNIFEM, Beijing fonda ra) Wayborey marga beeri jina kaŋ te 1975, zuwaŋ 15 ga koy zuliye 2 Kundey kaŋ go ngey boŋ caw baajiney: sabayaŋ, jine-koyyaŋ goray ra Kundey kaŋ go ngey boŋ wayborey jiiri waya daabuyaŋo goray ra STRA sambuyaŋo Kundey kaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra nduggaa goy marga nango suubanyaŋo 95, saptambur 4 ga koy 15 Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi “Singal ra alboro nda wayboro sasabandi nda cawandiyaŋ, ORGENS'' tiraa karyaŋ hinkanta, 2008 ra no i na sanney wo ka.
NduRRaa laabey lakkal-kanay yaamaryaŋ sataa sankey, Afirki wayno-kaŋa boŋ.
Wayborey, baani goray nda lakkal-kanay boŋ sankaa 1325.
Borey kulu yaddaa boŋ no i na sanka 1325 sambu oktoobur, 2000, wayborey, baani goray nda lakkal- kanay boŋ.
Ciiti nda poltik taarifi fondo no kaŋ yadda i ma: Wayborey daŋ jine-koyyaŋ goyey ra, Wayboro nda alboro sasabandi daŋ baani goray ceeciyaŋ saawarey ra, Baani goray hawzuyaŋ goyey ra Baani goray nda mayray gaabandiyaŋ wangu banda.
Goy fondo taaci (4) no go sankaa 1325 ra: wayborey ma furo sijirey kulu sambuyaŋ ra waana-waana: Laabey, gandey nda nduggaa mayray fuwey ra; Fitina kosorayyaŋ, a hawzuyaŋ nda a wiiyaŋ dabarey sambuyaŋo ra; Baani goray fondo ra salaŋ ga ye care me ra yaŋey ra; I ma te sooje yaŋ, puliisi yaŋ wala siwili yaŋ ga furo baani goray hawzuyaŋ ra; I ma te nduggaa laabey marga beero magaatakadda se wakiili yaŋ.
Wayborey nda wandiyey haggoyyaŋo ga i wa komyaŋey nda dabari-zaarey kaŋ i ga te i se zama i mana ti alboro se, waana-waana: cahãkomay nda faaba alwaatey ra, nda batamey do kaŋ borey zuru ga koy ga faaba ceeci ra; I ma borey kaŋ ga koy ga baani goray hawzu wangey do cawandi wayborey nda wandiyey alhakey, nda faaba fondo ce-kayantey boŋ, hala i ga koy wangey do.
Sariyey ganayaŋ nda wayborey alhakey kayandiyaŋ ga i kambe kuna futa yaŋo ganji nda: I ma ciiti wangu ra taali beerey, adamayzey alamdaabayaŋ, nduggaa laabey sariyey taamuyaŋey teekey se; I ma bay kaŋ batamey ra kaŋ borey zuru ga koy ga faaba ceeci wo siwil nda faaba nangu no.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi, Baani Goray nda Jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ I ma si borey kaŋ na wayboro wala wandiyo kom yaafayaŋ daŋ laabey waafakay sankey ra, zama taaley din ga hin ga te adamayze nakkasandi yaŋ wane, wangu taali beeri wala alamdaaba; I ma wayborey alhakey gaabandi mate kaŋ ga laabo sariya fondey gana; I ma baani goray nda wangu wiiyaŋ sijirey kaŋ wayborey ga sambu no gaabi.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ daŋyaŋ baani goray ceeciyaŋ gurjey ra waana-waana: I ma alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondo ra yaamarko yaŋ daŋ nduggaa laabey baani goray ceeciyaŋ gurjey ra; I ma wayborey booney laasaabu sijirey kulu gorandiyaŋ ra.
I ma wayborey kundey sijirey, i gaakasiney nda i bayrey laasaabu da i ga dabari nda sijiri beerey gorandi.
Wangey ra wayboro komyaŋ boŋ sanka 1820.
Sanka lamba 1820 yadda kaŋ wayboro komyaŋ wangu ra wo fondo no kaŋ ga baani goray nda lakkal- kanay guna.
Sankaa ne: Wangu soojey kaŋ se malfa go ma haggoy i ma si wayborey kom zaamayaŋ ceeciyaŋ ma ga; Kundey kaŋ go ga care wangu ma si yadda nda wayborey komyaŋo, i ma haggoy mo nda siwiley; Nduggaa laabey margaa nda kundey kaŋ go ga gurjay baani goray kayandiyaŋ fondo ra ma fondey kayandi kaŋ ga wayborey komyaŋ ganji.
- Waafakey/Sankey: Waafaka kaŋ ga wayborey fayanka-fayanka dumey kulu ganji (CEDEF) Afirki laabey adamayzey nda dumey alhakey waafaka kaŋ ga Afirki wayborey alhakey guna; Maputo waafaka CEDEAO goy sijiro kaŋ ga naŋ i ma goy nda laabey yaamaryaŋ sataa sanka lamba 1235 nda 1820 Afirki wayno-kaŋa boŋ Laabey adilay nda alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ boŋ dabarey.
CAWO SOGONYAŊO Dumbaro: Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiiyaŋ Cawo bayray: I ma nafa/goy nda alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyaŋ boŋ misaaley, sannizey nda alhaaley Cawandiyaŋo nufey I ma sanniizey kaŋ go alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyan fondey ra bay I ma cawyaŋ te kaŋ ga dira alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyan boŋ I ma du alhaali hanno kaŋ ga alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandiyan tabbatandi.
Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi Gayyaŋo: guuru 14 Cawandiyaŋo goy-jiney Fahamandiyaŋ cawo sijirey nda a tirey CEDEAO guna ga dondoŋ tiraa Filimey Fotey nda deesaŋey Tira nda suura cindey Anterneetu.
Cawo sogonyaŋo Cawyaŋ ce-diraw tira silmaŋ Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi, Baani Goray nda Jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ Dumbari 1: alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey Dumbaro bayrey I ma misaali, haali nda dabari hanno yaŋ gorandi, alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondo ra.
Cawo boŋo Kwaaraa alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey Cawandiyaŋo nufaa I ma alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey nda sanniizey bay ga boori Hiney kaŋ i ga gaabandi Gayyaŋo: guuru 2 Cawandiyaŋo goy-jiney Fahamandiyaŋ cawo sijirey nda a tirey CEDEAO tiraa Filimey Fotey Tira nda suura cindey Anterneetu boŋ cawandiyaŋ.
Dumbaro bayray I ma misaali, haali nda dabari hanno yaŋ gorandi, alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondo ra.
Baano gorey nda jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ Dumbari 2: Baani goray nda jine-koyyaŋo Cawo dumbaro ce-dirawo Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi, Baani Goray nda Jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ Cawandiyaŋo nufey I ma baani goray ceeciyaŋ fondey fisi mate kaŋ alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey ga ba I ma dabari yaŋ gorandi windanta ra, ga alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey gaabandi I ma cawandiyaŋ kaŋ ga alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey kayandi te I ma du alhaali hanno yaŋ kaŋ ga alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey kayandi Cawey Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey fisiyaŋ Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey fisiyaŋ no ga guna barmayyaŋey kaŋ goy sijirey kande wayborey nda alborey boŋ, waana-waana sariyey nda sijirey do hare, kuray wala gagari kulu kaŋ no.
Goy-jinay no kaŋ ga kande albahaarey fisiyaŋ nda dabarey teeyaŋ, wayborey nda alborey ma du ga furo jine-koyyaŋ goyey kulu ra.
I alhakey nda alborey waney ma saba.
Dabari no kaŋ ga alborey nda wayborey sakulley nda i bayrey laasaabu da i ga sijirey sambu wala da i ga goy nd'ey, i alhakey ma du ga saba, fayanka-fayanka mo ma du ga ban.
I ga guna ga di hari kaŋ boro kulu go ga te wala boro kulu boona ga du ga di nangu kaŋ baara-baara go.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey fisiyaŋ ga hin ga te mafaari kaŋ ga i alhakey sasabandi.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey ga kande hããyaŋey wo, gagari kulu ra: May no go ga ifo te?
Nda arzaka fo?
Ifo ga ti alborey nda wayborey booney nda i nafa fondey?
May no ga dabari arzakey nda riibey se?
May yaŋ no ga ba barmayyaŋ ma furo ce-dirawo ra?
May no si ba barmayyaŋ ma te?
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ sandayo kaŋ ga baani goray nda jine-koyyaŋ ganji ONU ne kaŋ alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey si dira kala wayborey nda alborey, arwasey nda wandiyey goyey nda i margasina boŋ.
Naamey, arzaka nda poltik fondey no ga goyey dake afo kulu boŋ.
Kwaara ra, borey booney nda himandey no ga kande wangey i ga.
Laasaabu fo kaŋ Afirki wayborey gayzetaray sataa (FAS) te ‘'wangey ra wayboro nda alboro sasabandiyaŋ nda wayborey kambe kuna futa ''boŋ, no-din Singal, Thies kwaara, 2009, ne kaŋ wayborey si CEDEAO baani goray hawzuyaŋo goyey ra, ba kaŋ i na caw yaŋ nda sariya yaŋ te fonda din boŋ.
Sariyey hinne si naŋ i ma wayborey nda alborey sasabandi fitiney hawzuyaŋ nda i wiiyaŋey ra.
Da i ga ba barmayyaŋ ma te, alborey no i ga no fahamey, laabaari nda biirimay hanno alhaaley wo boŋ: Fayanka-fayankey: Pierre Nicola no ga ne ‘' baara-baara si dooru goray ra da manti i na a toonandi boro ga no''.
Dabari-zaaray (kaŋ i ga te wangu ra, zama se bora wo wayboro wala alboro no; zankey sarayaŋey, wkc).
Dabari-zaaray wo sanniize no kaŋ ga laalayaŋ, yanje, konnaamey nda ibartaray Baano gorey nda jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ kaŋ ga kande doori cabe.
Wangu ra dabari-zaaray ga boro kulu guna amma wayboro no a ga tar ga du.
Haalo wo mafaaro ga kande kaŋ i si alborey nda wayborey sasabandi.
Kuduwaaru, Giine, Libeeriya nda Seeraleewon na kambe dake yadda tira fo ga feebiriye, 1965.
Amma wo-din mana te.
Abirillu, 1972, Gowon Niizeeriya parsidaŋo nda Eyadema Togo parsidaŋo ye ga porza din tunandi.
I na soola yaŋ te, i na laabu 12 zuure zuliye ga koy uttu 1973 ga i gaakasinay ceeci.
I na marga soola Lumi, waafakay ceeciyaŋ boŋ.
CEDEAO nufaa nda a goyo Bayraykooni beeri yaŋ nda zuuzu yaŋ na care margu Ankara zambiye 1974, ministarey mo na marga te Moroobiya, zambiye 1975.
Marga hinkaa din na waafaka neesi ga guna.
A banda no laabu 15 na kambe daŋ waafakay tiraa ga Lagos kwaara me 28, 1975.
I na kambe daŋ CEDEAO sinjiyaŋ tiraa ga Lumi, Togo laabu, noobambur 5, 1976.
Zulye 1993 no i ye ga waafakay tiraa din guna, arzaka gorandiyaŋo ma cahã, margasinay poltiko mo ma tonton.
I na CEDEAO suuban a ma ciya laabey ganji beeri guwa (5) ra afo, Afirki arzaka sataa (AEC), COMESA, CEAS, IGAD, SADC, nda CEDEAO no na kambe daŋ waafakay tiraa kaŋ ga AEC nda CER margu feebiriye 1998.
CEDEAO nufey nda a fondey CEDEAO nufa ga ci a ma margasinay nda care diiyaŋ tabbatandi arzaka fondey, baafunay fondey nda naamey do haray.
Wo-din no ga naŋ laabey ma care di arzaka fondo ra.
Care diiyaŋo ga hima ga naŋ laabey borey baafuney ma boori; arzakey ma zaada, a ma kambe daŋ mo Afirki laabey jine koyyaŋ ra.
1993 waafaka kaŋ za i ba i ma arzaka fondey nda poltik fondey feeri ga tonton laabey nda care game ra, i di kaŋ arzaka fondey ra nufey hima ga ciya day nda neera ma furo laabey game ra, i ma te mo nooru folloŋ.
Poltik fondey do mo, Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra i ma daŋ CEDEAO dipte yaŋ, arzaka nda baafunay boŋ yaamarko yaŋ, nda CEDEAO ciiti fuwo kaŋ ga saataa sankey gorandi.
Waafaka wo ga sankey sambu kaŋ ga naŋ i ma fitiney kosaray wala i ma i bonza CEDEAO ganda ra.
CEDEAO goyey fondo beerey ne: Mayray-fuwey kaŋ go CEDEAO se ne, a ce-dirawo fondo ra: Laabey jine-funey nda gomnatey margaa Ministarey margaa Saktariya beero Jarjara diptey fuwo Jarjara ciiti fuwo arzaka nda goray yaamarkey fuwo (i ga a sinji) CEDEAO jine-koyyaŋ sundurko (FADC) CEDEAO ra nooru daŋyaŋ banco (BIDC) Afirki wayno-kaŋa nooro fuwo (AMAO) Afirki wayno-kaŋa nooro boŋ caw lokkolo (IMO) Laabey care diiyaŋ boŋ cawo Nufa, goy nda darza laasaabantey Afirki ga-ham baani sataa (OOAS) Goyey kambo sata 6 Fitiney kosorayyaŋ, i hawzuyaŋ nda i bonzayaŋ fonda, baani goray nda lakkal- kanay 1999 yaddaa.
Satey nda fonda wo ra gonda hino, Saktariya beero nda yaamarko fuwo kaŋ ga sabakasinay nda lakkal-kanay daŋ laabu wo-ne yaŋ ra: Burkina-Faso, Gaana, Giine, Libeeriya, Maali, Niizer, Niizeeriya, Sinigal, Seeraleewon nda Togo CEDEAO nufaa I ma laabu gande te kaŋ sinda hirri, a ga zaada mo baani goray nda lakkal-kanay ra.
Laabu gandaa wo ga goy nda mayray hanno, a laabiizey ga hin ga du arzaka boobo kaŋ i ga nafa nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ nda windanta hallasiyaŋ ra.
CEDEAO goyey I ma markasinay nda care diiyaŋ gaabandi Afirki wayno-kaŋay arzaka marga gorandi laabiizey baafuna boryandiyaŋ se, i arzaka kambo lakkal- kana gaayiyaŋ nda a tontonyaŋ se, i ma laabey gama hanse, i ma kande mo gaakasinay Afirki ma zaada.
CEDEAO darza laasaabantey Nafaa Hallasa nda a gaabandiyaŋo no ga naŋ i ma yadda lalabu ga ndugga ra ga arzaka gorandiyaŋo te silmaŋ.
Lalabu Sata goyteerey nda a mamburey ma lalabu care ga.
I ma lalabu hari taji ka tarayyaŋ nda albahaaru windiyaŋ sataa ra.
Fayanka I ma yadda, i ma bay, i ma faham kaŋ iri jarjara ra, laabey, dumey nda naamey kulu ga fayanka.
Cimi I ma kookari ga gaabu goy fondo cimi-cimey ga, ga du naanay nda lalabu jama do iri teerey ra.
Gaakasinay I ma gaakasinay ceeci ga tonton kaŋ ga hin sataa goyo, a (laabo) alhaalo nda a naamu dumi-dumey ga, poltikey teeyaŋ nda sanka sambuyaŋ kulu ra.
Adilay I ma ceeci laabiize kulu ma ciya adili, a ma laabo ganda fondo beerey ga na ga sanni hanno salaŋ nga caley boŋ jarjara nda goy nangu beerey ra.
Kwaarandi care se I ma nafa nda fondo kwaarayey ga sankey nda poltiko teeyaŋo no gaabi.
Goy baakasinay I ma goy baakasinay cabe, i ma ba nduggaa ra teere hanney; i ma da hanno nda farhã cabe goyey do laabo ganda ra.
Cimi ganayaŋ I ma sanka sambu cimi ganayaŋ nda sasabandiyaŋ ra.
Gonitaray I ma fondo ce-kayante yaŋ gorandi borey laabey gandey nda ndugga booney fondo ra.
CEDEAO nufaa nda a goyo Care diiyaŋ ganjey Gandey arzakey jine-koyyaŋ (adamayzey zaadayaŋ, arey nda wayey sasabandiyaŋ, windante hanno); laabiizetaray folloŋ.
Baani goray nda lakkal-kanay: gande kaŋ windanta gonda baani nda lakkal-kanay, fitina si, sarandi si, baara-baara mo si.
Mayray: poltik nda arzaka mayray hanno kaŋ sinda lugu, i ga haggoy nda jama arzaka nda adamayzey alhakey.
Arzaka gorandiyaŋ: (fatawci, habu, nooru, albarka ceeciyaŋ poltik): ganda kulu ma te habu fo nda nooru dimma fo, i ma bara nda nooru banayaŋ fondo hanno.
Saruuso kaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra jine-koyyaŋ: gaakasinay gaabo, gomnati saruusey nda wo kaŋ yaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra ma margu ga goy, windante kaŋ ga te gomnati saruusey nda wo kaŋ yaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra jine-koyyaŋ se.
Baani goray, lakkal-kanay nda mayray hanno Jine-koyyaŋ nda markasinay Sabayaŋ nda yoonay hanno Nooru daŋyaŋ Mayray fuwey hina A kulu ma haguyaŋo.

I ma cawandiyaŋ hanno te CEDEAO nufaa gaabandiyaŋ nda a goyo gasandiyaŋ boŋ.

Goray nda naamey nda care diiyaŋ (cawey, fayankey, furo-tajey, ga-ham baani, windiyaŋey, nda wkc…) Fondo wo-ne ga ci ibeero zama a ga no borey ga yadda ga baafunay care banda.
Adamayzey ga yadda no jina, waato ga i ma te ganda folloŋ ra goroko yaŋ.
A ciya care diiyaŋ wala goray biirimay no, a ga tilas no laabiizey ma fondey wo kulu sambu.
Naamey ra care diiyaŋo mo si te kala foori-foorey, beefey nda marga beerey ga.
Jaŋ ga sabayaŋ nda care wangay no ga kosoray daŋ teerey wo se.
Amma dooni nda gaani ga naŋ i ma hin ga te ga boori.
Dooni jide ga hin ga doonuko nda nga jamaa margu.
Jiiri 2011 nufaa ga ti laabey care diiyaŋ nda i fatawco gaabandiyaŋ, kambe ga care kambe ra nda gomnati saruusey nda wo kaŋ yaŋ go ngey boŋ goray ra.
Sanda bonzayaŋ ga ti i ma cawandiyaŋ sijirey hanse i ma koy care banda amma i ma si hima care, i ma i margu day.
Fondo wo-ne ra, i ga hin ga silmaŋ sambu lokkoliizey care margu ga fooruyaŋ (fastiibal) boŋ zama i hima ga goy nda furo-tajey.
Wo-din ga no lokkoliizey nda sata-satey kaŋ go CEDEAO laabey ra ga margu ga furo.
Teera dumi-dumi yaŋ no i ga te care ra, manti yoonay no i ga te.
I si ciya care wanga yaŋ kala day i ma te laabey care diiyaŋ fuume.
Yoona kaŋ i ga te, manti canse wane no, kala day a ma ciya laabey nda care game gayzetaray lokkol.
Tiyaatar bisa naamu sanni ga, ndugga goray ra care tontonyaŋ lokkol no.
Hala hino na care diiyaŋ daŋ laasaabu beene silmaŋo ra, foori-foorey teeyaŋ sata-satey ra no borey sambuyaŋ ga, i hima ga goy nda arey nda wayey saayey sasabandiyaŋ dabaro.
CEDEAO wo arzaka gande beeri no.
laabey kaŋ yaŋ go a ra ga boona ngey ma baafunay care banda.
Wo-din wo gomni beeri no.

wo-din se, bora kaŋ mana yadda nda sanney wo ga hin ga a tabbatandi nda nga bayray.
A ma ye ga ka nga boŋ ga, da a ga naaru, a ga faasa jiney kabay, a ga ceeci hangasin, da a kani, a ga nga fu mayo daabu, nga fuwo bumbo ra, a ga nga jiney daŋyaŋ harey saafi, wo-ne yaŋ kulu teeyaŋ ga, a ga bay kaŋ ciiti fondo yaŋ go no, goyteeri yaŋ go no kaŋ ga hin ga faasa nga se.
boro wo-ne ma nga boŋ hã hari kaŋ nga ga ne nga laabiizey wo se da nga ga naaru nda faasa jiney.

Nduggaa laabey banco guna ga di mate kaŋ i ga sijiro din te Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra.
Wo-din se, Beene, Gaana, Niizeeriya nda Togo niyya ga ‘”gazoduc'' fo te kaŋ ga naŋ ngey ma nafa nda Niizeeriya gaazo, danji teeyaŋ se.
Danji teeyaŋ hiney, zaadayaŋ fondo teeyaŋ Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey ra Kuuraŋ danji fondo teeyaŋ Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra kaŋ se i ga ne “Power Pool Ouest Africain'' Sisiri fondey Laabey jine-funey marga sijiro kaŋ ga i yadda me 1979, INTELCOM 1: CEDEAO laabey gallu-dunkey ga du care talfoŋ, fax nda telex ga.
