I na fondo yaŋ gorandi kambu wo-ne jine-koyyaŋ dogonandiyaŋ se.
I na fondo yaŋ te kaŋ se i ga ne Trans-Ouest-Africaines Lumi margaa kaŋ te deesambur 1980 sijiro kaŋ ga i yadda: Nouakchott-Lagos km 4560 ra, i na km 3800 te (83%) Dakar-Ndjamena: km 4460 ra, i na km 3894 te (88%) Laabey ma du care yaŋ fondey: km 11423 ra, I na km 7653 te (67%) Mooto fondey dogonandiyaŋ CEDEAO karti mooto asirans wane.

CEDEAO ma ciya dumey kulu wane Fondey taranzito boŋ sanka (TRIE): a ga naŋ taranzito tirey teeyaŋ ma dogon, i ma waasi CEDEAO laabey jinayey se.
Ya-din ga, laabiizey kulu ma kambe daŋ, i ma kande ngey gaakasinay.
Deemokarasi fondo ra laabiizetaray ga boro no alhaku yaŋ nda tinay yaŋ kaŋ ga naŋ borey ma nga me daŋ gomnati jiney hawzuyaŋ ra.
Ya-din ga boro no kaŋ ga lakkal daŋ gumo hiney kulu hawzuyaŋey ra.
Laabiize kulu hima ga hini beerandi; zama deemokaraasi fondo ra no hiney ka, diptey mo no ga tirey daahirandi.
Kambe danyaŋ fondo ra, laabiizey hima ga goy yaŋ te kwaarey ra, baaricey ra nda laabo ra.
I ma du ga faham nda laabo ce-dirawo.
Laabiizetaray nda ce-kayandiyaŋ Amma, laabiize kulu se alhaku hããyaŋo hima ga saba nda a na nga tinay fo toonandi.
Boro alhaku kulu ma bay kaŋ boro fo mo alhaku no, ya-din ga boro ma boro cindo mo alhakey bay.
Arzaka fondo ra laabiizetaray Wo-ne ga salaŋ laabiizey gaakasina boŋ arzaka zaadayaŋ fondo ra.
Laabiize hima ga bay hari kaŋ ga ci nga goy fondo wo-ne ra ga marga nda laabiizey tinayey kaŋ ga ka alhakey banda.
I ga ba i ma laabiizey boŋey feeri jangaley nda patantey banayaŋ ra.
Arzaka fondo ra boŋ-duure hanno nda hina ce-kayante kaŋ ga nooru daŋ ga goyey te.
Laabey cinayaŋ sandayey CEDEAO ganda ra: mate kaŋ laabiize hima ga te fayankey hawzuyaŋ fondo ra, laabey ra nda laabey care diiyaŋo ma ga.
Boro ma hin ga baafunay nda boro laabiizey fayanka go araŋ game, manci kala laabiizetaray alhaali hanno.
A ga cabe kaŋ boro yadda kaŋ laabu wo boro kulu wane no.
Da i kande laabu cinayaŋ sanni Afirki laabey waana-waana CEDEAO laabey ra, i si fongu kala za annasaara mayra waate.
Hirrey kaŋ i jeeri annasaara mayray waate ga laabey ka care ra, na fayyaŋ te dumi folloŋ nda care game, jama yaŋ kaŋ go care ra wala ga i say laabu waani-waani yaŋ ra.
Afirki laabey, mate kaŋ i na i jeeri hunkuna, ga waana mate kaŋ doŋ borey go ga baafunay care ra nda.
Ya-din ga, a ga sandi borey ma kay ka ba ngey laabey hala i ma i cina, wo-din mo za laabey ra kala CEDEAO ganda ra.
Wo-din se no dabari taji yaŋ hima ga ka kaŋ ga haggoy nda fayankayaŋey nda koy nda ya ma gay borey game ra; politik nda arzaka fonda ma borey margu ga te afo Afirki ra waana-waana CEDEAO laabey ra.
Borey ma ma care se, i ma naŋ ngey baafuney ma te afolloŋ.
Hunkuna, sanda kaŋ go laabey se ga ci mate no i ga te ga naamu waani-waaney te afolloŋ; laabiizey care diiyaŋo mo ma tabbati, kaŋ ga naŋ laabey ma si fay.
Fayankey nda poltik fondey hawzuyaŋo si te kala nda i na borey sasabandi, i ma ciiti fondo kayandi borey game ra, zaada fondey mo i ma i kayandi, hawo kulu ma borey nafa care bande.
Wo-ne banda, boro ma ba ni cala boro kulu kaŋ cine no.
Poltik fondo ra, i ma naamey kulu gaabandi i ma zaada care bande, a ga bisa i ma i fay.
Fayanka hawzuyaŋo, wo kaŋ a ga ba day ga ci salaŋ ga ye care me ra jine-funey nda care game ra, care beerandiyaŋ ra, laabo cinayaŋo ma ga.
Boro kulu ma si ba nga boŋ ga bisa nga cala.
Boro ma ŋwaaray hari kaŋ ga bora kulu nafa; nga ga ti laabiizetaray ganjo.
Cawandikey ga hin ga laabiizetaray sandayey bangandi cawkey se i ma faakaaray a boŋ.
A ga hin ga ne i ma koy ga ceeciyaŋ te a boŋ, i ma tira yaŋ hantum kaŋ i ga koy ga cabe jama se silmaŋ: wa fitiney kaŋ go Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra cawo te.

Sijirey sokonyaŋ Alwaato: Guuru 2 Goy-jiney /caw harey / Tirey Sijirey nda tirey CEDEAO tiraa Silmey, fotey, hanganyaŋ nda gunayaŋ hari fo yaŋ Tirey nda suura yaŋ kaŋ ga salaŋ laabiizetaray boŋ Antarneetu fondey kaŋ ga salaŋ laabiizetaray nda a cawandiyaŋo boŋ Cawandiyaŋ nda dondonyaŋ goyey teeyaŋo.
Laabiizetaray Cawandiyaŋo nda dondonyaŋo ce-dirawo Laabiizetaray nda ce-kayandiyaŋ Dumbaro bayra I ma laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ darzey, bayrayey gorandi nduRRa goray alhaaley ra Cawandiyaŋ nda dondonyaŋ nufey Borey ma du fahamay nda carmay laabiizetaray nda a ce-kayandiyaŋ boŋ Borey ma ba laabiizetaray ce-kandiyaŋ fondey I ma cawandiyaŋ fondo yaŋ kayandi laabiizetaray boŋ Borey ma ngey laabiizetaray daahirandi Bayray kanandey Laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ Maaney Laabiizetaray ce-kayaŋdiyaŋ: boro ma lakkal ye laabu ga, a mayray fuwey ga, nda a goyey.
Boro ma si fappe sappey waate, laabiize hima ga laabo daŋ jine ngey ceecey ra.
Laabiizetaray mo: boro ma goy nda hari kulu kaŋ ga hagu ndugga baafunay goray ra; care beerandiyaŋ, care daŋ me ga yaŋ.
Da i na kar goobu fo, laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ ga ci boro ma bakar jama hari se.
A ga ba boro ma te poltik do haray lakkal, borey ma ni alhakey bay nda ni tinayey komino baafuna ra.
Laabiizetaray ce- kayandi manci kala alhaali kaŋ ra laabiize ga nga alhakey nda tinayey beerandi.

Darzey kaŋ go laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ ra Jama hari beerandiyaŋ Burcintaray Da hannay Goyey ra kambe daŋyaŋ Bisandi care se yaŋ Boro ma ceeci jama hari ma koy jina Gaakasinay Boro ma haggoy nda gomnanti jiney Laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ fondo ra saniizey: Laabiizetaray nda a ce-kayandiyaŋ sinda maana kala laabu fondo ra.
A ga hima i ma sanniizo wo bangandi.
Laabu: gomnati alhaali no Laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ Boro kaŋ go ga baafunay care ra, poltik fondo ra, batame ra kaŋ gonda hirri; boro yaŋ mo no kaŋ naamey ga hima care hini folloŋ mo no go ga i may.
(Ciiti fonda kaŋ ga mayray tirey bayra caw ga ne kaŋ laabu manci kala boro jama no kaŋ margu ga te afo, batame folloŋ boŋ; a gonda nga burcintaray batama din ra nda taray; a ga hin mo ga boro fo wala boro boobo tilasandi.
Saruusey kulu fuuma no, hiney dimma no, kaŋ ga fayanka nda laabiize folloŋ.
Laabu manci kala boro jama kaŋ te afo, kaŋ ga kay boro jama nangu ra, a ga salaŋ i ma ga.
A se no hini beero go batame ra kaŋ i jeeri, a ga fay nda laabu cindo.
Jama hawzuyaŋ fondo ra, laabu misa no ga hagu ga bisa hari kulu adamayzey baafunay ra.
Gomnato no ga a goyey te.
Laabu gonda hina yaŋ kaŋ nga hinne se no i go danga soojey, wala borey tilasandiyaŋ kaŋ go fondo, WKC.
I ga hin ga ne koyne kaŋ laabu manci kala mayray fuwey marganta nda saruusey kaŋ ga naŋ mayrayo nda goyo ma te.
A ga tilas no laabu ma borey hallasi, a ma goyey kulu te borey ma ga (biirima, ga-ham baani, hari, danji, windante ma hanan, wkc.) Gomnato saruusey no ga i te mate kaŋ i na goyo fay-fay nda.
A ga hima i ma kwaarandi mate kaŋ laabu arzaka hawzuyaŋ go ga te nda.
Laabu burcin hima ga bara nda mayray tira nda hini.
Laabu yaŋ kaŋ margu ga hin ga te sata kaŋ beeri nda laabu folloŋ, day i goy care ra danga afo.
Nga ga ci danga CEDEAO kaŋ ra gonda laabu waani-waani yaŋ; waafakay go i game ra kaŋ go mayray tira nangu ra; a gonda jine-fune kunda-kunda yaŋ kaŋ yaŋ ga ci a mayray fuwey.
Laabu (maana hinkanta) Adamayzey kaŋ go ga baafunay batame folloŋ kaŋ gonda hirri ra dimmaa; i fun-do folloŋ, i taarifi fo; i naamu fo ce fo yaŋ i ciine fo, i poltik fondo fo.
Bora kulu hari, kaŋ si fay, a ga fay nda borey kaŋ go a ra a burcintara mo ga beeri.
Ya-din ga laabu wo boro yaŋ kaŋ go care ra no kaŋ ga bay kaŋ ngey hima-cara, taariifey, naamey, ciiney nda diiney ga ngey margu.
Laabu manci kala poltik hari no, a gonda jama yaŋ kaŋ go ngey boŋ batame ra kaŋ gonda hirri.
Nga no ga sariya gorandi borey se kaŋ yaŋ go mayray tira folloŋ cire.
Laabu ciine gonda misaali yaŋ kaŋ i ga dunguryandi ga te laabu aleesi kaŋ go danga boonay hari laabiizey kulu se.
Adamayzey baafunay bayraykooni yaŋ ga ne kaŋ kala da borey kaŋ go ga baafunay care ra kulu yadda kaŋ ngey kulu laabu folloŋ ize yaŋ no.
Dumi fo yaŋ kaŋ go ga baafunay care ra ga yadda kaŋ ngey laabu folloŋ, a gar mo sanni yaŋ kaŋ bisa ma ga i go laabu ra kaŋ manci wo kaŋ i go ga miila.

Laabiizetaray nda ce-kayandiyaŋ Cawandiyaŋo nda dondonyaŋo sijiro ce-dirawo 4 Deemokarasi nda «Deemokarasi kaŋ boori manci hini no kaŋ ga borey sasabandiyaŋ dokkoray; hino no kaŋ ra borey bumbo no ga ngey boŋ suuban, a si hirri daŋ adamayze kulu tontoni se kala day boro kaŋ mana kookari wala kaŋ mana ba.
» Kayfuru anday booba kaŋ go ga Afirki wayno-kaŋa laabey jine-koyyaŋ ganji, danga nukkando, hini barmayyaŋ booba, poltik… ga deemokarasi sinjiyaŋ sandandi nga nda mayray.
Deemokaraasi ka ci borey hini kaŋ borey te, borey ma ga.
Day a ga hagu i ma ceeci ga bay hala borey ga hin ga goyo din gasandi wala i ma bay boro kaŋ yaŋ dumi, CEDEAO gandara go ga may ga ne borey ma ga.
Kuray fo haray, i hima ga tabbatandi kaŋ laabiize boobo no gonda bayray, laasaabu, gonitaray nda da kaŋ ga hagu i ma du ga furo gomnato goyey ra; kaŋ ga naŋ i ma ngey alhakey ceeci, i ma ngey tinayey mo toonandi, deemokarasi nda mayray hanno gaabandiyaŋ fondo ra.
Deemokarasi nda mayray hanno cawo i mana a te kala wo-din ma ga.
Tiraa bayray I ma carmay yaŋ, dabari yaŋ nda da ce-kayante yaŋ no borey se deemokaraasi nda mayray hanno gaabandiyaŋ fondo ra.
Dumbarey Deemokarasi Mayray hanno Deemokaraasi nda mayray hanno Dumbari 1: Deemokarasi Dumbaro bayra I ma darza, dabari nda da ce-kayante yaŋ gorandi deemokaraasi nda mayray hanno gaabandiyaŋ fondo ra Cawandiyaŋ nda dondonyaŋ nufey Borey ma du fahamay nda darza deemokaraasi fondey boŋ I ma dabariyaŋ te kaŋ ga naŋ deemokaraasi ma koy jine, i ma goy nda hari hanney kaŋ go laabo ra nda nafey kaŋ i ga du borey ga I ma cawandiyaŋ te deemokarasi gaabandiyaŋ fondo ra I ma da hanno yaŋ no kaŋ ga deemokarasi gaabandi.
hini kaŋ ce-diraw laabiizey no ga mo dake a ga, ngey boŋ se wala diptey
bayray kanandey Sanniizo maanaa Abaraham Linkoln ne kaŋ, a manci kala “borey hini kaŋ borey te borey ma ga” I ga hin ga ne mo kaŋ deemokaraasi manci kala: “Gomnati kaŋ go ga may laabiizey yaddayaŋ ra” “Gomnati alhaali kaŋ gaabo si kala borey se” “Alhaali no kaŋ ra laabiizey ga hin ga jine-borey barmay baani-baani, gomnato gonda fondo kaŋ ga may zama se borey yadda a ga” laabiizey manci kala jama kaŋ go care ra laabu folloŋ ra; ngey no ga may ngey mo no i go ga may.
Mate kaŋ borey ga deemokarasiyo te nda: deemokarasi kayante nda siirante Doŋ Gareesu laabu deemokarasiyo ikayante no; danga laabiizey kulu (kala day wayborey, zankey nda baggey) ga margu nangu fo ga sanka beerey sambu.
Deemokarasi no kaŋ ra bora kulu ga me daŋ sankey kaŋ ga laabiizey guna ra; i sambuyaŋo nda i teeyaŋo.
Hunkuna, poltik fondey baayaŋey kulu, deemokarasi kaŋ mana kay no go no zama borey sinda hino ngey boŋ se day boro yaŋ no i ga suuban kaŋ ga salaŋ i nangey ra (diptey).
Deemokarasi darzey, fondey nda a ganjey Deemokarasi gonda fondo yaŋ, mayray fu yaŋ teera yaŋ nda doonay WKC.
Kaŋ yaŋ ga ci a gaabo.
Alhaaley, alhaali bangante yaŋ no nda baayaŋ kulu: boŋ-duure, saba yaŋ, taray kwaaray sappe kaŋ ga saba, hiney fayyaŋ WKC.
Day, deemokaraasi batuko yaŋ go no kaŋ si bangay.
Ngey ga ci tirey kaŋ yaŋ i hantum kaŋ i hima ga gana (sappe banda, boro ma yadda kaŋ i na ni zeeri); Deemokaraasi Deemokarasi darzey Hari hanno hinka no deemokaraasi se ibeeriyaŋ, boŋ-duure nda borey sasabandiyaŋ.
Harey wo, adamayzey alhakey tirey kulu ra no i go: wo kaŋ yaŋ i te 1789 wala 1948.
Hari hanno fo yaŋ ka ga tonton danga: bisandi care se yaŋ, care beerandiyaŋ, margasinay, partiyey boobandiyaŋo, boro ma yadda nda fayankey, gaakasina, baani gooray wkc.
Deemokarasi fondey.
Sappe: kaŋ ga naŋ boro kulu kambe ma furo sanka beera sambuyaŋ ga.
Jama mayray: hino si kala laabiizey se, i na gomnato no amaana a ma a gaayi.
Jama baayaŋo nda borey kaŋ si ba alhakey: hino si kala nango kaŋ sappa no boro jama, wo kaŋ mana du jama mo i ma i alhakey kosaray.
Mayray tiraa: mayray tiraa no ga ci hiney nda nangu kaŋ me gomnanto ga may ga kay; nga mo no ga laabiizey kulu alhakey batu.
A ga hagu i ma sankey guna hala i go ga mayray tiraa gana kaŋ naŋ i mayray tiraa cimandi.
Hiney fay-fayyaŋo (diptey fuwo, gomnato nda zuuzu-kwaara): borey kaŋ ga sankey sappa te (diptey) si goyo te (gomnato); borey kaŋ ga sariyey te mo go no i ma du ga goyey te a ma boori.
Sariya nda borey sasabandiyaŋ: gomnato sankey hima ga saba, i ma si baara-baara te borey game ra.
Ciiti-fuwey ma bara ngey boŋ goray ra: ciiti-fuwey mana hima ga baara-baara te, i ma i fay mo nda mayray-fu cindo.
Faakaaray mate kaŋ ni ba: boro kulu ma ci hari kaŋ kaanu a se, ma salaŋ mate kaŋ ni ba, laabaari sambukey ma ci hari kaŋ i ba, borey ma ngey margey te mate kaŋ i ba.
Soojey boŋ ye ganda fuula-kwaaray hino se: sooje beerey manci boro kaŋ yaŋ i sappe ga daŋ, ya-din ga fuula-kwaaray hino no ga i dabari Parti boobo nda sappe cimi wane kaŋ sinda tilasandiyaŋ: parti booba game ra sappey sinda boro fo tilasandiyaŋ, boro kulu ga sappe, cimi sappe yaŋ no, kwaarayyaŋ ra mo no i ga i te.
Jama hari: I ma hari kaŋ jama kulu wane no hallasi.
Dabari-zaaray ga du waybora zama se wayboro no wala mate kaŋ a ga du wayboro ga ba mate kaŋ a ga du alboro.
Dabari-zaaray ga hin ga du bora, a ga-hamo, a farjo wala a lakkalo do hare.
Dabari-zaaray ga hin ga fun gomnanto do hare wala a me te hari kaŋ a yadda nd'a (nduggaa laabey boro hawzuyaŋ marga UNFPA, Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ kundaa do no sanney wo fun).

Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ daŋyaŋ sijiri hanney gorandiyaŋ nda teerey ra.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondo ra teerey nda haaley kaŋ ga baani goray nda jine-koyyaŋ ce-kayandi.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondo ra sijiri hima ga fayanka-fayankey kaŋ i ga te waybora se bonza zama ngey no ga i ganji i ma nga hina cabe goyey ra, nga mo no ga i ganji i alhakey ma kay ga boori.
Sijiri kaŋ ga goy nda alboro nda wayboro sasabandi fondey ga ti wo kaŋ ga fondey wo laasaabu za jine-koyyaŋ goyey dabarey, ce-dirawey nda i nufey gorandiyaŋo hane.
Cawandiyaŋ sijiri kaŋ ga haggoy nda alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey (za cawo sijirey teeyaŋo do kala a ma koy kalaasu hawzuyaŋ do) ra no i ga wandiya nda arwaso kulu biiri.
I ga hima ga goyteerey (cawkey nda cawandikey) nda fuwey kulu dimmaa bay, i ma du ga te i se fuuyaŋ kaŋ ga wasa.
Alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey laasaabuyaŋ ga borey no haali hanno kaŋ ga adilitaray daŋ borey nda care game ra.
Boro ma nga baafuna kulu te dondonyaŋ fondo ra Naamey goyey kaŋ ga wayborey nda alborey nafa fondey fay ga ka care ra Wayborey nda alborey ma saba jine-koyyaŋ goyey ra furoyaŋ do hare CEDEAO lakkal-kanay nda baani goray sandayey CEDEAO ganda haali waani-waani booba no kande baani goray nda jine-koyyaŋ gurjey ma fay.
Gurjey Alboro nda wayboro himandey kayandi, Baani Goray nda Jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ fondey wo ga guna: sappey kaŋ ga kande kusuuma kaŋ ga poltik yanjey hay; deemokaraasi gorandiyaŋ nda a gaabandiyaŋ sandayey; kunda laasaabu laalokoyey bangayyaŋo; Borey baayaŋo kaŋ sinda alhaalo nda zankey baayaŋo laabo ra (Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra, zankey kaŋ mana to jiiri 20 ga ba boro 50 boro zangu kulu boŋ); cawandiyaŋ, goy dondonyaŋ nda goy duuyaŋ sandayey; borey cawandiyaŋ do hare booney nda wo kaŋ i ga hin ga du mooru care yaŋo.
Baani hawzuyaŋ nda care diiyaŋ dabarey, nda borey sasabandiyaŋo kaŋ i si ga no gaabi.
talakataray laalo kaŋ go no zama boro zangu boŋ boro 50 no go haalo din ra, a ga to mo boro 60 kaŋ si du dolar 1 zaari ra boro 100 boŋ; zuru ga laabo naŋyaŋ booba kaŋ poltik fitiney nda wangey go ga te; CEDEAO ganda kulu ra, baayi windiyaŋo na doorey, boro neerayaŋ nda simoogalo kar ga say nango kulu; malfa kayney go ga koy nango kulu; poltik sijirey sinda gaabi; dumey nda care game ra kusuumey; hanakwaana neerayaŋo tontonyaŋo; wangey kuuyaŋo.
Teerey wo bonzayaŋ fondo ra, i ga hima ga laabey haalo guna ga du ga goy nda wayboro nda alboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey.
TIRAA SOGONYAŊO Dumbaro bayrayey I ma nafa nda alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ boŋ misaaley, sannizey nda alhaaley kaŋ ga baani goray nda jine-koyyaŋ gorandi.
Cawandiyaŋo nufey I ma baani goray ceeciyaŋ dabarey fisi alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ fondey ra I ma alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋ dabarey ceeci ga baani goray nda jine-koyyaŋ gaabandi windanta ra I ma caw te kaŋ ga alboro nda wayboro sasabandiyaŋo fondey kayandi Baano gorey nda jine-koyyaŋ gorandiyaŋ I ma du haali haano kaŋ ga alboro nda wayboro sasabandi.

Fondo baajiney kaŋ ga sabayaŋ kayandi, i ga fayanka-fayanka ganji boŋ no i na alhakey wo kayandi.
Afirki borey nda dumey alhakey boŋ waafaka ne kaŋ‘' dumey kulu gonda fondo i ma du windante hanno kaŋ ga i jine- koyyaŋo tabbatandi''.
Ga-ham baani nda windanta sanney wo gonda maana nangu kaŋ jaahilitaray nda tangari gonda gaabi, waana-waana Afirki laabey kaŋ go taneera se Dandi-kambe ra.
Laabey wo ra, wo kaŋ yaŋ go Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra no jaase ikulu.
CEDEAO deemookaraasi nda mayray hanno boŋ sankaa ne kaŋ deemookaraasi, baani goray, poltik lakkal-kanay, borey game ra adilitaray si te nangu kaŋ mayray hanno si.
Fondo follonka ra, nduIIaa laabey margaa jiiri zambar foanta fooro ga, saptambur 2002, nduIIaa jine-funey yadda i ma i daŋ nufey kaŋ tooyaŋo i ga hin ga neesi alwaati fo boŋ kundaa ra.
Nufey se no i ga ne ‘'jiiri zambar foanta jine-koyyaŋ nufey (OMD).
Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey jine-koyyaŋ fondey si kay ga boori, da manti i na fondo hanno yaŋ sambu no ga talakatara, doorey, arzaka ra kambe bandayaŋo bonza no.
Harey no ga ti fitiney kaŋ si bu nda lakkal-tuney mafaaro.
Laabey wo jine-koyyaŋo si tabbati da i mana borey kulu baani fondey kayandi, i ma arzaka fay a ma boori borey game ra, i ma Iayzetaray nda deemokaraasi mo no gaabi.
Haalo kaŋ go ga borey lakkaley tunandi fondo wo ra ga ti sijiri hanno yaŋ kaŋ ga windante baafunante fondey kayandi ga ga-ham baani sandey bonza duuyaŋ.
Ga-ham baani, windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ Fondo wo-ne ra no CEDEAO laabey kulu cawandiyaŋ fondey hima ga teerey wo guna ga daŋ ngey lokkoliize beerey nda ikayney kulu cawandiyaŋ nda goy dondonyaŋ sijirey ra.
Wo-din se no caw wo-ne ga salaŋ ga-ham baani nda windanta margasina boŋ, duumi jine-koyyaŋ fondo ra.
Tiraa bayrey: I ma misaali yaŋ, bayray yaŋ, waaniyaŋ nda haali hanno gorandi kaŋ ga windanta hawzu, ga-ham baani nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ fondey ma du ga kay ga boori bay.
Tiraa dumbarey: Gam-ham nda windanta Duumi jine-koyyaŋ Ga-ham baani, windanta Dumbari 1: Ga-ham baani, windanta Dumbaro bayray I ma misaali yaŋ, bayray yaŋ, waaniyaŋ nda haali hanno kaŋ ga windanta hawzu, ga-ham baani fondey ma du ga kay ga boori bay.
Cawandiyaŋo/goy dondonyaŋo nufey I ma windanta sandayey bay I ma ga-ham baani sandayey bay I ma margasinay daŋ ga-ham baani sandayey nda windanta sandayey game ra I ma du windanta hawzuyaŋ dabarey nda a goyey/teerey I ma windanta nda ga-ham baani saajawyaŋ goyey no gaabi I ma du haali hanno yaŋ kaŋ ga windanta nda ga-ham baani sandayey bonza.
Cawey Ga-ham baani Maanaa Maana boobo no go ga-ham baani se.
A maana fo ga ti ‘'borey ga-ham baani kayandikey cawo, wala teerey kaŋ ga borey ga-ham baani fondey kayandi cawo''.
A maanaa ga hin ga te mo ‘' goy kaŋ borey sijiri a ma adamayzey, kundey wala kwaaraa kulu ga-ham baani fondey gaabandi, a ma i hawzu, a ma i boryandi wala bine a ma ye ga i kayandi a ma boori''.
Maana zeeno fo go no kaŋ Chares-Edward Winslow bayray guuso tiraa, kaŋ i kar 1920 ra.
Maanaa din ne: ‘'ga-ham baani ga ti bayray guusa wala gonitaray kaŋ i ga te: Ga doorey kosaray, Ga adamayzey aloomarey kuukandi, Ga borey no baani nda gaabi, nda goyey kaŋ kundey go ga kambe daŋ care kambe ra ga: Windanta boryandi, ga doorey tangam, Borey cawandi ga-ham hananyaŋ boŋ, Loktoro-kwaarey sogon i ma doorey bay ga i bonza hala i ka, Ga fondey kaŋ ga borey baafuna hanse, i ga-ham baani hawzuyaŋ se sambu.
Teerey wo kulu nufa ga ti i ma adamayze kulu baani duure nda aloomar kuuku duuyaŋ alhako gorandi.'' Ga-ham baani, windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ Fahamay wo-ne no naŋ nduggaa ga-ham baani hawzuyaŋ sata beero (OMS) na kunda kayna fo goandi 1952 kaŋ cabe nafa kaŋ go boro fo wala jama cawandiyaŋ ga-ham baani hawzuyaŋ ra.
Borey ga-ham baani saruusey hawzuyaŋ boŋ laasaabo barmayyaŋo na kundaa wo beejandi.
Barmayyaŋey no kande i ma safaray kambu-kambey kulu daŋ care ra ga te afo: doori kosorayyaŋ, jantekomey safaryaŋ nda borey kaŋ jante ga du baani gaayaŋ i ma kay ga ngey boŋ ga boori.
Za hano din, i yadda kaŋ safara kaŋ i ga te ga doorey bonza mo go ga-ham baani kayandiyaŋ fondo baajiney no.
Amma ga-ham baani fondey ga fay nda loktorotaray bayray guusa nangu hinka: A ga doorey kosorayyaŋ no gaabi ga bisa doorey safar ga bonzayaŋo A ga jama ga-ham baani sandayey guna ga bisa boro fo-fo ga-ham baani.
Afirki laabey kaŋ go taneera se dandi-kambe ra jama ga-ham baani sandayey Nduggaa ga-ham baani hawzuyaŋ sata beero (OMS) na tira fo ka taray noobambur 20, 2006 Afirki boro miliyo 738 boŋ.
Tira ra i ne hunkuna Afirki fando borey to boro 1 073 487 000.
CEDEAO laabu 15 gonda, deedandi ga, boro miliyo 322 990 000.
Tiraa ra, sataa ne kaŋ ganda laabey borey ga-ham baani booriyaŋo no ga naŋ i arzaka fondey ma kay ga boori.
Tiraa teekey ne kaŋ ‘' ga-ham baani jaŋ ga booriyaŋ ga kande borey ga talakataray, buuyaŋ boobo, goy zabuya…'' Iri ga bay mo kaŋ Afirki ga-ham baani sandayey ga ba gumo.
Misaalo wo mo, doorey kaŋ ga diksa, waana-waana SIIDA, heemariizo nda koto-beero, kaŋ ga boro miliyo 3 wi jiiri kulu, no ga ti a mafaaro.
Boro kaŋ dorey ga wi ra mo hay-tajey nda kosorawey no ga ba gumo, sakufa nangey kaŋ wangey go ga te kaŋ sinda safaray fu hanno.
Ga-ham baani cawandiyaŋ Ga-ham baani cawandiyaŋ ga naŋ cawka ma du bayray nda haali hanno yaŋ kaŋ ga naŋ: A ma hari kaŋ ga kande a ga taali kosoray A ma nga boŋ kuru ga wa taalo A ma boro fo faaba A ma faham hala a ga te A ma suubanyaŋ hanno te A ma kay nga boŋ ga.
Sijiri beeri hanno fondo ra no ga-ham baani cawandiyaŋ go ga te.
Fondayze iyye (7) no go sijiro wo se: Hananyaŋ; Ŋwaari baafunante ŋwaayaŋ, biirimay nda gaabi-goy teeyaŋ; Wandiyey nda arwasey cawandi alboro nda wayboro boŋ, safarey kaŋ ga gunde sambuyaŋ ganji duuyaŋ, wayboro doorey nda siida kosorayyaŋ; Ga-ham baani, windanta Sigaari, hanakwaana wala baji haŋyaŋ doona; Teerey kaŋ si boori kosorayyaŋ; Alboro nda wayboro ma care dorandi bonzayaŋ; Jaŋ ma goray kaani bonzayaŋ; Cawandiyaŋo kaŋ ga naŋ boro ma taali ganji (safaray jina sintina boŋ cawandiyaŋo) Windanta Maanaa Sanney kaŋ Yvette Veyret, laabu bayka, te windanta boŋ biirima nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ margaa do, deesambur 17 ga koy 19, 2003: “Ay kaŋ ga ti laabu bayka se wo, windanta si kala adamayze boŋ caw guuso fo ra kaŋ ga goy borey nda kundey boŋ.
Ya-din ga, a ga hima a ma laasaabu te margasina kaŋ go borey nda windanta game ra boŋ (hawo kaŋ iri ga fulanzam, hari, tondey, subey, tuurey nda almaney).
Sanni boobo go margey tirey ra.
Sanney din ra, windanta nda kundey sanni go no.
Adamayzey nda baafuna fo yaŋ ndugga fando boŋ bangayyaŋ boŋ no sanno din ga dira.
I si salaŋ windanta boŋ i mana kande taarifi sanni.
Laabu bayko mo taarifi bayko no.
Taarifo banda, nduggaa ganda hayyaŋo boŋ no a ga goy.
Ya-din ga windanta boŋ goy ga batamey sogonyaŋo, i hanseyaŋ nda jine-koyyaŋ guna.
Bayray taaci no ga ti windanta ganjey: Arzakey boŋ laasaabo kaŋ darzaa ga kande batame sogonyaŋ Sandayey: ganda alhaalo ga hin ga kande sandey a songonyaŋ fondo ra Farratey Saajo nda borey nda farey.
Hari taaco wo ga fitina boobo te.
Ya-din ga, poltik mo go windanta sanney ra.
Windanta boŋ cawandiyaŋ Sanniizey maaney Windanta boŋ cawandiyaŋ wo diraw no kaŋ ga borey no bayray nda haali kaŋ ga naŋ i ma faham nda borey margasina, i naamey nda i baafunay nangey.
Cawandiyaŋo ga kande sanka hanno sambuyaŋ nda haali hanno duuyaŋ windanta boryandiyaŋ se (windanta hawzuyaŋ laabey margaa kaŋ te 1971).
Windanta boŋ cawandiyaŋo wo duumi jine-koyyaŋ fondo ra no i ga a te, ga borey fahamandi kaŋ ndugga fando wo arzaka no kaŋ borey kulu hima ga haggoy a ma boori.
A ga borey fahamandi kaŋ adamayzey kulu kaŋ go ndugga fando wo boŋ hima i ma care di, i ma haggoy mo nda fundikooney kulu kaŋ go a boŋ.
Cawandiyaŋo ga naŋ boro kulu ma hin ga laasaabu, ga sanka ka nga boŋo ra ga goy.
A ga naŋ boro ma anniya hanno sambu ga goy, a ga laabiizey kulu te boro yaŋ kaŋ boŋey ra deemookaraasi go, kaŋ yaŋ go soolante ga goy nd'a.
Ga-ham baani, windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ Windanta cawandiyaŋo nufey A nufey ga ti a ma kundey nda borey ga i ma: Faham nda windanta sandayey Du bayray hanno boobo windanta nda a sandayey boŋ Windanta nafa bay, i ma du a baakasinay kaŋ ga i tutay i ma a boryandi, i ma a hawzu mo Du bayray yaŋ kaŋ i ga windanta sandayey bay ga bonza nd'a.
Ma kambe daŋ windanta sandayey bonzayaŋ goyey ra.
CAWO SOGONYAŋO Dumbaro: Jama ga-ham baani nda windanta Cawo bayray: I ma bayray, waaniyaŋ nda haali hanno yaŋ gorandi kaŋ ga windanta hawzu, i ga jama ga-ham baani fondey mo boryandi.
Cawandiyaŋo nufey I ma windanta sandayey bay I ma ga-ham baani sandayey bay I ma margasinay daŋ ga-ham baani sandayey nda windanta sandayey game ra I ma du windanta hawzuyaŋ dabarey nda a goyey I ma windanta nda ga-ham baani saajawyaŋ goyey no gaabi I ma du haali hanno yaŋ kaŋ ga windanta nda ga-ham baani sandayey bonza.
Gayyaŋo deedando: guuru 14 Cawandiyaŋo/dondonyaŋo goy-jiney: cawo boŋ laabaari tirey, CEDEAO waafakay tiraa kaŋ i hanse, tirey hanney kaŋ ga salaŋ windanta sandayey boŋ.
Ga-ham baani, windanta sijirey sogonyaŋo walhã Cawyaŋ ce-diraw tira silmaŋ Dumbari 1: Jama ga-ham baani nda windanta Dumbaro bayrey I ma misaali, haali nda dabari hanno yaŋ gorandi, ga windanta hawzu, ga jama ga-ham baani fondey mo boryandi.
Cawo boŋo: Windanta nda jama ga-ham baano sandayey Cawandiyaŋo nufaa - I ma windanta sandayey bay Hiney kaŋ i ga gaabandi Gayyaŋo deedando: guuru 3 Cawandiyaŋo goy-jiney: cawo boŋ laabaari tirey, CEDEAO waafakay tiraa kaŋ i tajanda, tirey hanney kaŋ ga salaŋ windanta sandayey boŋ.
- 11 3 - Ga-ham baani, windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ dumbaro ce-dirawo Ga-ham baani, windanta Ga-ham baani, windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ Dumbari 2: Duumi jine-koyyaŋ Dumbari 2: duumi jine-koyyaŋ Dumbaro bayray I ma misaali yaŋ, bayray yaŋ, waaniyaŋ nda haali hanno kaŋ ga windanta hawzu, duumi jine-koyyaŋ fondey ma du ga kay ga boori bay.
Cawandiyaŋo/goy dondonyaŋo nufey I ma harey kaŋ ga duumi jine-koyyaŋ te bay I ma windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ gama ci I ma du windanta saajawyaŋ dabarey nda teere hanney I ma bay fondey kaŋ ra i ga goy nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ I ma windanta nda jama ga-ham baani fondey ra teerey kaŋ ga duumi jine-koyyaŋ te kwaara, gande wala laabu fo ra bay I ma teere yaŋ sijiri ga windanta boryandi I ma sanka sambu ga duumi jine-koyyaŋ gaabandi windanta ra.
Bayray kanandey: Duumi jine-koyyaŋ Maanaa Sanney kaŋ Yvette Veyret, laabu bayka, te ‘'windanta boŋ biirima, duumi jine-koyyaŋ boŋ, deesambur 17 ga koy 19, 2003'' margaa do: “Ay lakkal mana kani duumi jine-koyyaŋ laasaabo ga.
Sintina day, ay ga borey fongandi kaŋ saajo hawzuyaŋ satey no na duumi jine-koyyaŋ laasaabo ka taray za 1970, zama i di kaŋ iri teerey si ga baani hay nduAAa fando nda kundey kulu ga.
Ihinkanta, goray hanno no ga naŋ jine-koyyaŋ ma tabbati.
Ya-din ga, i ma baara-baarey bonza ga adilitaray daŋ borey nda care game ra.
Ganji hinza boŋ no duumi jine-koyyaŋ laasaabo go: saajo, arzaka fondey nda baafunay fondey hawzuyaŋ.
Ihinzanta, duumi jine-koyyaŋ laasaabu si ga te caw guuso fondo ra.
Sohoŋ kulu no i go ga a gorandi ga boori, wo banda mo a ce-dirawo ga maanu poltik ga ba caw guuso.
Za 1980 bananta waate no laasaabo wo gonda maana dumi-dumi waytaaci kaŋ afo kulu gonda nga diiyaŋo/miila.
Itaacanta, laasaabo kaŋ i ga te duumi jine-koyyaŋ boŋ laabu arzakantey ra ga waana wo kaŋ i ga te laabu hina buuney ra.
Laabu dumi jiney-koyyaŋ wo ra, goney nda bayray guusokoyey ne kaŋ a maana ga ti sohoŋ arzaka fondey ce-dirawo ma koy nda jina.
Sariya fondey kaŋ ga ce-dirawo sogon ga ba gumo, gagarey kulu ra.
Baafunay hanno maanaa ga no borey kulu yadda, nga mo no i go ga goy nda cawandiyey ra.
Laabu hina buuney wo, hala hoŋ i go ga guna arzaka fonda kaŋ ngey ga hima ga gana.
Iri arzaka fonda Duumi jine-koyyaŋ no i ga sambu ga goy nda?
Boro ga hin ga miila kaŋ Sin laabu boro miliyaaru 1,3 afo kulu ma baranda mooto?
Boro ga miila kaŋ adamayzey muraadey ga feeri hala manti i na jine-koyyaŋ wo-ne dumi gorandi?
Gomnati folloŋ ga hin ga haggoy nda nduAAaa nda nga saajey?
Wo-ne no ga ti laabiizetaray nda mayray gorandiyaŋ.
Laabu arzakantey ra duumi zaadayaŋ kande sanday laabey kaŋ yaŋ go ga ceeci ga koy jine ra: i ma saajey haggoy, adamayzey ma du ga hallasi.
Borey ga ngey boŋ hã bumbo hala manti annasaarey mayra alhaali no furo sanney wo gurbi ra.
Duumi jine-koyyaŋ wo hari no kaŋ ga i na kambe ka, saajey hawzuyaŋ ma ga no azawa nda dandi-kambe laabey ra borey tun ga kay ga kookari te.
Ay yadda nda sanney wo, amma da ay na ay kokor-banda laasaabey guna, ay hima ga te lakkal.
Duumi zaadayaŋ biirima Duumi zaadayaŋ biirima no ga naŋ borey ma faham nda ndugga ganda hayyaŋo, a bayray timmantey, lalabuyaŋ nda laabiizetaray cawandiyaŋ sijirey kulu ra no a ga windanta, arzaka nda naamey gama fahama no, ga cawko alborey, wayborey gaagasinay i ma wo-ne yaŋ guna ga boori: Adamayzey boŋ-duura Sasabandiyaŋ goy nda yaŋ alhaaley sambuyaŋo tilas ra ndugga izey kulu care diiyaŋo Duumi jine-koyyaŋ nufaa ga ti a ma laabiizey no suba hina yaŋ kaŋ ga naŋ i ma bay hari kaŋ ngey ga ba.
I ma laasaabu beeri yaŋ te duumi zaadayaŋo boŋ ga du ga sanka yaŋ sambu ga teere yaŋ goy lakkal-kayna ra, ngey baafuna ra, nda nduggaa kulu ra.
TIRAA SIJIRO Dumbari 2: Duumi jine-koyyaŋ Dumbaro bayra I ma bayray, teera nda alhaali hanno yaŋ gorandi windanta hawzuyaŋ fondo ra, duumi jine-koyyaŋ se.
Cawandiyaŋo nufey I ma duumi jine-koyyaŋ fondo nafantey bay I ma te hari kaŋ ga naŋ windanta nda duumi jne-koyyaŋ ma koy care banda I ma windanta hallasiyaŋ teerey nda dabarey bay I ma duumi jine-koyyaŋ goy nda fondey alhaaley bay I ma windanta nda jama ga-ham baani teere hanney bay kaŋ yaŋ ga koy nda kwaara, gande, nda Ga-ham baani, windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ sijiro walhã laabu duumi jine-koyyaŋ I ma goy ce-kayante yaŋ soola windante sasabante kaŋ ga baanu se I ma sanka sambu ga duumi jine-koyyaŋ gaabandi a windanta ra.
Cawo alwaato: guuru 16 Jiney/cawandiyaŋ tirey/tira fo yaŋ Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey tira nafanta, laabari tirey, sanniizey maaney tira beero, foto yaŋ, araaji nda teele albahaarey, windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ boŋ tirey kaŋ i te.
Laabu nda ndugga ciiti goy-jiney: zuwaŋ 27, 1986 tiraa kaŋ i ka taray adamayzey alhakey boŋ, Rio 1992 sanno; Bâle sankaa kaŋ i sambu marsu 22, 1989 ga ziibi laaley nda i darandiyaŋo laabey hirrey boŋ koy nda yaŋ guna; sankey kaŋ ganji i ma furo nda ziibi laaley Afirki laabey ra, wkc … Cawandiyaŋ tira silmaŋ Dumbari 2: windanta nda duumi jine-koyyaŋ Duumi jine-koyyaŋ Dumbaro bayra I ma bayray, teera nda alhaali hanno yaŋ gorandi windanta hawzuyaŋ fondo, duumi jine-koyyaŋ se.

CEDEAO sataa hima ga du hini nda sata beeri yaŋ kaŋ ga laabey kulu guna, ga du ga sankey gasandi, poltik fondey mo ma te afo
7 Laabey care diiyaŋ Kayfuru a alwaato kaŋ Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey du ngey boŋ no, i go ga ceeci ngey ma margu ga du ga hirrey kaŋ annasaarey daŋ jeeri.
Nufey kaŋ yaŋ i daŋ jine ga i ne ngey ma du waafakay marga ga ngey marga-marga zaadayaŋ nufey gasandi, ngey ma Iayzetaray mo cina ga gaabandi, ngey nda care game.
Kokor-banda jiiri way wo-ne yaŋ ra, boona wo ga ti i laabey margasina poltiko fonda.
Care diiyaŋ poltiko ma te nafa hanno jarjara baafuna nda borey yadda se ma ga no CEDEAO laabey jine- funey na fondo sambu ga bisa laabey CEDEAO ga, ga to dumi-dumey kulu CEDEAO ga.
Laabey na satey sinjiyaŋo danga: Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey arzaka gorandiyaŋ sataa (CEDEAO), Afirki wayno-kaŋay fondey margaa (UEMOA), Sinigal isaa baafunadiyaŋ sataa (OMVS), Saahel laabey ra koogando tangamo kundaa (CILS), Niizer laabu isaa hawzuyaŋ sataa (OCBN), wkc … Satey sinjiyaŋo no ga cabe kaŋ Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey na sanka sambu ngey ma goy care banda, care diiyaŋ fondo hanno ra.
Cawo bayra I ma bayray, teera nda alhaali hanno yaŋ gorandi laabey care diiyaŋo gorandiyaŋ fonda ra.
Cawo gonda dumbari hinka (2): CEDEAO nufaa nda a goyo CEDEAO ma ciya dumey kulu wane Laabey care diiyaŋ boŋ cawo Dumbari 1: CEDEAO nufaa nda a goyo Cawo ce-dirawo Dumbaro bayray I ma bayray, teera nda alhaali hanno yaŋ gorandi CEDEAO nufaa gaabandiyaŋ nda goyo gasandiyaŋ fondo ra.
Cawandiyaŋo nufey I ma CEDEAO nufaa boŋ bayrayey gaayi; I ma du dabari yaŋ nda goy hanno yaŋ CEDEAO nufaa gaabandiyaŋ nda goyo gasandiyaŋ boŋ I ma cawandiyaŋ hanno te CEDEAO nufaa gaabandiyaŋ nda goyo gasandiyaŋ boŋ I ma da hanno yaŋ gorandi CEDEAO nufaa gaabandiyaŋ nda goyo gasandiyaŋ fondo ra.
Cawey CEDEAO cabeyaŋo Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey arzaka sataa wo laabu way cindi gu (15) no margu ga a sinji 1975 jiire.
A goyo ga ti a ma arzaka furoyaŋ Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey gaabandi kambey wo ra: ganda arzakaa, koy nda ya, sisirey, danjo nda naamey.
Jiiri 1993 ra no i na a hino tonton, sanka kaŋ i hanse ga laabey lakkal-kana gaayiyaŋo daŋ ra, ga baani goray nda lakkal-kanay daŋ laasaabu.
Wo-din no naŋ i na kambe dake waafakay tira fo ga 1999 kaŋ ga salaŋ fitiney hawzuyaŋ nda baani goray nda lakkal-kanay gorandiyaŋ boŋ.
Laabu way cindu gu no CEDEAO ra (Beene, Burkina-Faaso, Kapver, Kuduwaaru, Gambi, Gaana, Giine, Giine-Biiso, Libeeriya, Maali, Niizer, Niizeeriya, Sinigal, Seeraleewon nda Togo).
Murtaani fatta CEDEAO ra jiiri 2000 ra.
Nduggaa sundurku beero (FMI) laasaabey ga, Afirki wayno-kaŋay laabey kaŋ go CEDEAO ra nooru wiiyaŋ hinaa ga to dolaaru miliyar 564,86; a se no a te nduggaa ra arzaka gaabikooni 25ta.
CEDEAO ganda hayyaŋo ga to km2 miliyo 5,1.
Borey mo ga to miliyo 299 deedandi.
CEDEAO taarifo CEDEAO sinjiyaŋo wo i mana a miila te kala jiiri 1964.
Wiliam Tubman kaŋ ga ti Liibeeriya parsidaŋo no na a toonandi borey do.
Laabu gu (5) no na sankaa din gasandi (Beene, Kuduwaaru, Maali, Niizer nda Togo) Laabu sata yaŋ sinjiyaŋ koy nda ya ma dogon sijrey gunayaŋ.
Laabu way cindi hinka (12) no na satey din sinji: Beene, Burkina-Faaso, Kuduwaaru, Gaana, Giine, Giine-Biso, Maali, Niizer, Seeraleewon, Sinigal nda Togo.

Gunayaŋ nangu taaci (4): Kotonugu, Wagadugu, Banjul, Mooroobiya Guna ga laasaabuyaŋ Abuja sakatariya do Sabayaŋ nda lakkal-kanay yaamarkey daŋyaŋ kaŋ ra laabu yagga (9) go Laabey care diiyaŋ boŋ cawo Dottiijey sataa sinjiyaŋ Soojey kaŋ soola ga batu Jiney ka tarayyaŋ, i daŋyaŋ nda malfa dogoney teeyaŋ ganjiyaŋ.
Sanney kaŋ i te oktoobur 1998 mo yadda nd'a.
Mooto funyaŋ konda goy sijiriyaŋ suubanyaŋ Baani goray zaadayaŋ Bonfeeray kaŋ i ga soojey no Malfa dogoney gunayaŋ hirrey boŋ Malfa dogoney laasaabey jarjara boobo ra Malfey margu ga tonyaŋ (Liibeeriya nda Maali no na a te) Salaŋ ga ye care me ra dogonandiyaŋ nda malfa teekey nda a nookey.
Care diiyaŋ taaley nda nafey Care diiyaŋ gaabandiyaŋ no ga kande dabari hanno yaŋ CEDEAO sandayey bonzayaŋ se hala i na laabu kulu arzaka jaŋ ga wasayaŋ guna.
Afirki laabey habey kaynayaŋo se, gaabey daŋ care ra yaŋo nda poltik sanka gaabikoono, ga hin ga kande gaakasinay.
Laabey ma waasi ga zaada hala i na albarkey, noorey daŋyaŋey nda barmayyaŋey tonton.
Nafa fo yaŋ no laabey care diiyaŋo se?
Habu kaŋ ga hirri daŋ antampiirizey wala porzey ga, ga hin ga margu ga du gaabi antampiriiz kookarantey ga hin ga koy jine Habey beerandiyaŋ ga naŋ noorey daŋyaŋey ma tonton CEDEAO laabey ra.
A ga albarka boryandi, a ga bayray nda dabarey barmay Care diiyaŋ ga hin ga laabey arzaka fondey boryandi.
A ga kande gomni arzaka dabarey hino kaŋ ga goy nda alhaku lalabuyaŋ ga, ciiti fondo hanno gunayaŋ ga nda mayray hanno ga.
Laabey gonda fondo yaŋ kaŋ i ga gana ga ngey game hanseyaŋ hina gaabandi nduggaa ra.
I ga hin ga te sata yaŋ ga ceeci ga hanse ngey game ra.
Laabey nafey fayankayaŋ se, wo-din si hin ga te waati kulu.
Laabu kayna ga hin ga du nafa beeri jarjara ra markasinay ga hala i na ngey arzakey margu ga fay.
Care diiyaŋ ga hin ga fitiney zabu hala naanay furo, lakkal-kanay markasinay mo faala.
CEDEAO ma ciya dumey kulu wane Care diiyaŋ caada Nafa wo si du yaamo boŋ, a gonda hari kaŋ ga naŋ i ma duw'a.
I ma laabey kaŋ si CEDEAO ra jinay faaley barmay nda CEDEAO laabu jinay caadantey.
Barmayyaŋo din ga kande sanday jarjara boobo ra.
Care diiyaŋ fondey ga hin ga jama arzaka nooro zabu kaŋ i du dug$e alhakey ga.
Zabuyaŋ boobey wo mamburey arzaka marguyaŋ hiney ga no i fun.
Care diiyaŋ ga hin ga laabu mayray zabu wala i darzey nda naamey furoyaŋ.
Nafey ga ba nda harey kaŋ ga naŋ i ma duw'ey.
Sandayey nda bonzayaŋ fondey Sandayey Ciiney Laabiizetaray Mayray laalo Bayray jaŋay Jaŋ ga goy nda harey kaŋ ga hagu adamayzey nda ngey jiney windiyaŋ fondo ra Lakkal-tunay Naarumay nda sisirey caada Talakataray Mayray fuwey jaŋ ga teeyaŋo Poltiko jaŋ ga goro do fo yaŋo nda mayray laalo: hini zeeriyaŋ booba (laabu cindey ra mana Afirki wayno-kaŋa poltik hasara Laabo arzakey jaŋ ga wasayaŋ: Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra boro fo kulu duure sasaba ga ti dolar 410.
Laabey arzakey kooguyaŋo CEDEAO laabey ga du farmi albarkey nda ganda arzaka kaŋ i si nafa nda Afirki wayno-kaŋa ra.
Kampaney mana koy jine sanku laabey nda care arzakaa ma zaada Fondo, sisiri nda kuuraŋ goy-jinay beeri jaŋay Fondey si wasa, i si boori Talfono si nangu boobo, a ga caada Kuuraŋ si ba, a ga caada Fondey boŋ gaayiyaŋey ga ba: fondo baraz boobo nda care za ga kayyaŋ.
I si saktariya nooru gaakasina bana waati kulu.

Sijiro walhã Cawandiyaŋ tira silmaŋ Sanno kaŋ i ŋwa batu: laabey care diiyaŋo Dumbari 2: CEDEAO dumey kulu waney Dumbaro bayra I ma bayray, waaniyaŋ nda alhaali hanno yaŋ gorandi CEDEAO ganda ra laabiizetaray ce-kayandiyaŋ se Cawandiyaŋ nufey I ma faham nda laabey care diiyaŋ bayrayey I ma du dabari yaŋ nda goy yaŋ ganda ra baafunay hanno gaabandiyaŋ se I ma cawandiyaŋ te laabey care diiyaŋ sandayey bonzayaŋ se Cawo boŋo: laabey care diiyaŋ darzey Waaniyaŋey Alwaato: guuru 4 Care diiyaŋ: CEDEAO ma ciya dumey kulu wane Lazare Ki Zerbo (Burkina-Faaso mayray kundaa beero) Suura wo-ne Afirki care diiyaŋ neesiyaŋo sintina no.
Care diiyaŋ jiiri waytaaci (40) banda, i mana du a ra gomni.
Laabey nda care game ra sataa mana hari kulu hay.
I si ga kookari kulu te care banda.
Borey kaŋ laabey care diiyaŋo nafa si ga furo poltikey laasaabey ra.
Afirki care diiyaŋo si jeeri kala gomnatey jaŋ ga zaamayaŋo ga.
Wo-din se, i hima waasi boŋ ga care diiyaŋ cina gomnatey nda care game.
I ma ma care se yaŋ ganda beeri ka kaŋ ra sata dumi-dumey ga furo, I ma du ga poltikey guna ga sata hanno yaŋ te.
Afirki care diiyaŋo: i ma teekey daŋ jina.
Konkonsey nda neesiyaŋey ga wo-ne yaŋ cabe: Mayray fuwey jaŋ ga teeyaŋo hawzuyaŋ fondo ra Gaabey daŋ care ra yaŋo jaŋ ga wasayaŋ nda mayray fuwey care tontonyaŋ Poltik nafa jaŋa ga koy a teekey ga, laabey care diiyaŋo ra Laabey care diiyaŋ boŋ cawo Gagaro cawandiyaŋo CEDEAO ma ciya dumey kulu wane Ceeyaŋey kaŋ i te ne: Fuula-kwaarey satey diiyaŋey gomnatey mayray fuwey nda laabey care diiyaŋo ga.
Mayray fuwey nda poltikey jine borey gonda sanday sanka sambuyaŋ nda fondo hanno sambuyaŋ do haray.
Afirki laabey care diiyaŋo poltikey mana nga arzaka kambo goyey gasandi mate kaŋ a hima nda.
Fondey kaŋ i sambu, i si ga goy nd'ey.
Harey kaŋ ga jaŋ ga goyyaŋo din ganji ne: Ministarey ga ba ngey boŋ ga daaru Laabey ra saruusey ce-dirawey go ga kande sanday laabey care diiyaŋ fondo kaŋ i sambu se Goyey gana ga neesiyaŋey si ga to jamaa do Goobey kaŋ i ga daŋ ga goyteerey kar si goy nda i goy teeyaŋ hina.
Gomnatey ra satey hanseyaŋo nda i gaabey daŋ care ra yaŋo gonda hari yaŋ kaŋ ga nafa dumi-dumey kaŋ goro ga boori ma waasi ga fatta.
May yaŋ no ga ti Afirki care diiyaŋ teekey kaŋ ga du a nafey?
May yaŋ no ga dabarey ceeci, ga goyey gasandiyaŋ fondey ci, ga haggoy nda fondey ganayaŋo?
Hããyaŋ wo-ne yaŋ sinda tuuyaŋ.
Satey kaŋ sata fo yaŋ ga jare, sata albarkantey waana-waana wo kaŋ yaŋ hirrey ga saba nda laabey ngey ndey ga gaakasinay ga.
Kawye meeriyey kaŋ mayray fay-fayyaŋo kande mana goy nda sijiri soolantey ga care diiyaŋo no gaabi.
Da sohõ care diiyaŋ teekey mana du a mo-banda.
A ga hima nda i ma care diiyaŋ teekey no fondo satey kaŋ go no yaŋ nda dabarey kaŋ i ga te yaŋ ra, i ma sijiro barmay.
Teekey goyey darzantey za daba ga Care diiyaŋ sanney ciya hunkuna sanni yaŋ kaŋ fahama ga gaabu.
Nufey, goyey teeyaŋ alhaalo nda gaakasinay fondey kaŋ teekey ci mana du seaware guuso.
Wo-ne si dambarandi.
Laabey gandey poltikey sijirey, I gasandiyaŋo nda i neesiyaŋo man ate dumi folloŋ.
Afirki jine-koyyaŋo nda a care diiyaŋo jaŋa kulu mayray alhaaley kaŋ yaŋ mana te no kand'ey.
Sankey ga koy nda bayray guusey.
Wo-din si ga teekey goyey daŋ laasaabu ngey kaŋ jine-koyyaŋ goyey ga nafa.
Deemokaraasi fondo ra hari taji no kaŋ teeyaŋo ga cindi.
Hala manti ya-din, polikey barmayyaŋey si kande nafa ce-kayante.
A ga hima nda no i ma goy ga teera barmay: dabarey, goyey gasandiyaŋey nda i neesiyaŋey ci, i ma i te nda teekey.
I ma teekey daŋ i ma dabarey kaŋ go no te.
Nangey kaŋ ra wo-ne na hari fo te ne: Mayray kambo: a ga teekey kaŋ si gomnato ra daŋ mayray fuwey hawzuyaŋ ra, i ga waafaku mo Laabey care diiyaŋ boŋ cawo ga sankey sambu.
Neesiyaŋey ga te nda fondo, a to jamaa do, i ga goy nda taaley goobey.
Laabey nda gomnatey ceeyaŋ wala ganayaŋ fondo dogono (dugugey nda poliisey kaŋ go hirrey ga kaŋ yaŋ ga fondey ganayaŋ ganji.
Sanday yaŋ no kaŋ ga ba alwaati sasabo soola kaŋ ga hima ga fongu za sohoŋ.
Care diiyaŋ dabarey nda gomnati satey hanseyaŋ fonda Fondo hinka no i soola Waafakuyaŋ nda sata dumi-dumey nda meeri kayney (gandey, koominey kaŋ go hirrey ga) Waafaka wo nufey ne: teekey ma care diiyaŋ bayray zeeney guna ga neesi, i ma i sijiro nda goyey barmay.
Kwaara meeriyey kaŋ go hirrey ga gonda hari kaŋ naŋ i ma care di.
Wo-din banda i ga ngey kominey te afo.
I na ngey boŋ sogon ga du mayray fuwey hawzuyaŋ fondo fatawciizey, mootokoyey, antampiriizey, borey kaŋ go ga nafa, mayray hanno.
I ga ceeci ga margasinay poltiko kaŋ go no tonton ga gomnatey satey gaakasinay care diiyaŋ fondo ra.
Harey kaŋ laasaabu ga du hima ga fun fondey kaŋ i ga gaayi, dabarey nda gaakasinaykey goyey.
Fuula-kwaarayey satey fondey kaŋ i ga gana gonda nafa, gomnatey satey ce-dirawo, sijirey kaŋ i ga teeyaŋ nda mate kaŋ i ga i te guna.
I hima no ga fondey kayandi kaŋ i ga gana ga fuula-kwaaray hin sabante i dabarey nda goyey gunayaŋey ra.
Antampiriizikoyey sata beero na teera kaŋ mana hagu gunayaŋ kunda gorandiyaŋ soola.
Fondo wo-din ra no i ga hari taji beeri yaŋ ka taray.
Iri me ciino ra sata beeri nda kunda yaŋ go no gandey ra, a ma ciya, alfarey, antampiriizikoyey wala goy fo yaŋ dumi wane yaŋ, wo-ne kaŋ go no ga no i ga jeeri ga laasaabo teeyaŋ sintin.
Teeko cindo se, i hima ga i laasaabo te laabo ra, ganda mo ra i hima ga di care.
Poltikey teeyaŋ, mayray fuwey nda ngey dabarey neesiyaŋo Di cara banda goyey ne: I ma fondo yaŋ sambu ga mayra hanse I ma poltik nda dabari yaŋ te nda fondo ce-kayante yaŋ kaŋ ga i gasandi.
Wo-din se, i ga fondo yaŋ sambu kaŋ ga naŋ teekey ma ngey goyey te; ngey ga ti poltik albahaaru, hina tontonyaŋ.
I ga ye ga margasinay poltik nda i nango ci.
Ngey no ga gomnati satey fonda hanse yaŋ nda margasinay gaakasina care diiyaŋ fondo ra ganjo.
Gaakasinaykey nda gomnatey yadda kambe daŋyaŋ nda mayray hanno sanney ga.
Wo-din se fuula- kwaarey laasaabey hima ga naŋ i ma sanka yaŋ sambu kaŋ gomnatey nda ngey gaakasinaykey ga toonandi.
Kubandi Cawandiyaŋ fondey Bayray gorandiyaŋ dabaro Lokkoliize beerey cawandiyaŋ sijrey gonda caw dumi-dumi yaŋ.
Cawandika goyo ga ti a ma bayray boobo no.
Ya-din ga a mana to a ma ceeci ga bayrayey margu alhaali fo boŋ.
Tirey bayray boobo duuyaŋ si naŋ boro ma hin ga nafa nd'ey alhaali fo yaŋ ra.
Sijirey ra gazeyaŋey wo no ga bayray gorandiyaŋ dabaro gaayi.
Dabari wo-ne no ga naŋ cawka ma nga bayrayey daŋ ga sanday bonza danga mate kaŋ a ga doona ga te nga gora ra, Bayray kaŋ maanaa ga ti << bay ga nafa>> ga naŋ cawka ma nga bayrayey margu, a ma i gorandi a ma nafa nd'ey.
Bayrayey fondo hinka boŋ no dabaro wo ga dira: sintina bayray taji si fun kala izeeno ga.
Amma ya araŋ wayborey, wa maa Rabbi sanno, Araŋ hangey mo m'a me sanney ta. W'araŋ ize wayey dondonandi hẽ eni, I afo kulu ma nga gorokasin dondonandi bu baray.
Ay m'araŋ diina batey bare i ma te bu hẽ eni, Araŋ dooney kulu mo ma ciya hẽ eni. Ay ga bufu zaara daŋ ka daabu cante kulu gaa, Boŋ-tali mo ma bara boŋ kulu gaa. Ay ma naŋ a ma hima sanda bu baray ize folloŋ kaŋ go nga hayra se buuyaŋ sabbay se, Bananta mo ma ciya sanda zaari fotto. "
Zama ay si waani mate kaŋ boro ga me-kaanay sifaw te d'a. Da yaadin mo no, Kal ay Takakwa m'ay hibandi sahã adin-sahã adin.
amma sooje fo na Yesu carawo gooru nda yaaji. Sahã adin-sahã adin mo kuri nda hari fatta.
Diyey binde konda tirey da cahã yaŋ bonkoono lordo boŋ, i n'a fe mo Susan faada ra. Bonkoono da Haman goro zama ngey ma baji haŋ, amma Susan kwaara borey boŋ haw.
Hẽ eni alwaati go no, Haari alwaati mo go no. Barayyaŋ alwaati go no, Gaani alwaati mo go no.
I na halaciyaŋ ce a ma halaciyaŋ gana, Zama i na laabo kulu halaci. Baaru si i n'ay kuuru fuwey kulu halaci, Ay daabuley mo halaci sahã adin.
Kal a kande ay Rabbi windo meyo kaŋ ga guna azawa kambe haray gaa. Kal ay di wayboroyaŋ go ga goro, i goono ga bu baray hẽ eni te tooro Tammuz se.
Ni hinjey mo ga hima sanda feeji kuru, hõ seyaŋ taji, Kaŋ yaŋ go ga fun nyumayyaŋ do. I ga sasare ihinka-hinka, ihinka-hinka, Baa afolloŋ mana gaze i ra.
Sahã adin, ma ji kolba woone sambu ni kambe ra k'a dooru a boŋo boŋ. Ma ne a se: ‹Rabbi ne: Ay na ji dooru ni boŋ, ni ma ciya Israyla bonkooni.› Sahã adin kala ni ma fu meyo fiti ka zuru gumo, ma si kay bo. "
Sahã adin-sahã adin Yesu na nga talibey tilasandi k'i daŋ jina i ma furo hi ra ka daŋandi ka koy ya-haray hala Baytsayda, hala nga ma jama sallama.
Ya laabo, ma s'ay kuro fiji, Ay hẽ eno mo ma si du kayyaŋ nangu.
A go mo, waato kaŋ a go nga dirawo ra, kaŋ a maan Damaskos, kala sahã adin kaari fo fun beene ka nyaale a windanta.
Kala gumandi izey tun da cahã yaŋ ka daabu Jibeya boŋ. Gumandi izey binde sasare care gaa ka feeri. I na birno kulu kar da takuba.
Woone mo koyne araŋ go ga te: araŋ go ga Rabbi feema daabu nda mo mundi, da hẽ eni, da bine jisiyaŋ, hal a si ye ka sargayey saal koyne. A s'i ta mo da bine yadda araŋ kambe ra.
Amma Yesu mana tu a se da baa sanni fo. A talibey binde kaa k'a ŋwaaray ka ne: "M'a sallama, zama a go g'iri gana nda hẽ eni."
Yesu na nga kambe salle k'a ham ka ne: "Ay yadda. Ni ma hanan." Sahã adin-sahã adin mo jiraytara ban a gaa.
A ciya binde, waato kaŋ jiiri hinka timme, Absalom gonda feeji hamni hõ sekoyaŋ Baal-Hazor ra, kaŋ go Ifraymu jarga. Absalom mo na bonkoono izey kulu ce i ma kaa bato do.
Amma sahã adin-sahã adin Yesu salaŋ i se ka ne: "Araŋ laakaley ma kani, ay no! Wa si humburu."
Israyla ize wandiyey ga fatta jiiri kulu ka Yefta Jileyad bora ize wandiya hẽ eni te jirbi taaci.
Ma si fatta nda cahã yaŋ yanje teeyaŋ se, Zama a ma si ciya kokor banda ni ma jaŋ haŋ kaŋ ni ga te waati kaŋ ni gorokasin na ni haawandi.
Ngey kaŋ ga ne ay se: "Ahã a! Ahã a!" Naŋ i ma dangay siw i haawo sabbay se,
Yaa no Rabbi ci: Waati kaŋ jirbi woodin yaŋ ga kaa, Da alwaati woodin to, Israyla izey da Yahuda izey ga kaa care banda, Ka konda ngey hẽ eno ka Rabbi ngey Irikoyo ceeci.
Nga mo go baaru ciyaŋ gaa bonkoono se, mate kaŋ cine a ye ka buukwa no fundi, kala waybora kaŋ Iliyasu n'a izo fundo ye a gaa din go, a kande nga hẽ eno bonkoono do, nga windo nda nga farey se. Gehazi mo ne: "Ya Koyo ay bonkoono, woone no ga ti waybora kaŋ izo Iliyasu ye ka kand'a fundo a gaa."
Sahã adin-sahã adin i na hiyo da ngey baabo naŋ, k'a gana.
Ya Irikoy, ma maa ay hẽ eno se, Ma hanga jeeri ay adduwa se mo.
Ngey wo goono ga tammahã a ga fuusu, wala mo Bulos ma gaaru ka kaŋ sahã adin ka bu. Amma kaŋ i gay i mana di haŋ kaŋ du a, i bare ka ne kaŋ irikoy fo no.
A na adduwa te ka Rabbi ŋwaaray ka ne: " Ya Rabbi, ay ga ni ŋwaaray, manti haya kaŋ ay ci za ay go yongo ay laabo ra, nga neeya? Woodin se no ay tun da cahã yaŋ ka ne ay ma zuru ka koy Tarsis, zama ay bay kaŋ ni ya Irikoy bine-baani-koy no, toonante nda suuji, kaŋ ga munye bine tunyaŋ gaa, gomni yulwante koy mo no. Ni ga ba ye mo ka fay da masiiba.
Araŋ kwaara ra furanta sahã adin araŋ g'a gar, za a mana ziji ka koy sududuyaŋ nango do zama nga ma ŋwa. Zama jama si hin ka ŋwa kala nd'a kaa jina, zama nga no ga albarka gaara sarga gaa. Woodin banda no borey kaŋ yaŋ i ce, ngey mo ga ŋwa. Wa ziji fa, zama alwaati woone ra araŋ g'a gar. "
Ay ga hẽ eni nda wurru yaŋ te tondi kuukey se, Ay ma bu baray te saajo do haray kurey nangey se, Zama koogandi n'i halaci hala boro kaŋ ga furo ka bisa si no, Boro si maa haw hẽ eni mo noodin. Za beene curey ka koy ganji hamey, I kulu zuru ka daray.
Sahã adin-sahã adin Yesu maa nga ra kaŋ dabari fo fun nga do. Gaa no a bare ka zagu jama gaa ka ne: "May no k'ay bankaaray ham?"
Sahã adin-sahã adin wandiya tun ka dira. A gonda mo jiiri way cindi hinka. Kal i dambara gumo-gumo.
Yaa no Rabbi ci: Ma ni jinda ganji hẽ eni. Ni moy mo ma si te mundi, Zama ni goyo ga du nga alhakko. Jama ga ye ka kaa ka fun ngey ibarey laabu. Yaadin no Rabbi ci.
I ci Tamar se ka ne: "Guna, ni anzuray neeya ga koy Timnat ka nga feejey hõ se."
I tammahã yaŋ gaa, Ngey windey wo ga tondo no hal abada, Ngey nangorayey mo hala zamaney kulu me. I ga ngey bumbey maayey daŋ ngey laabey gaa.
Irimiya mo na bu baray doon Yosiya se. Alborey kaŋ ga doon, da wayborey kaŋ ga doon mo, i kulu no ga Yosiya maa ce ngey hẽ eney ra, hala ka kaa sohõ. I na woodin ciya mo alaada Israyla ra. A go mo, i n'i hantum bu baray tira ra.
Kala y'ay hẽ eno ŋwaarayyaŋ soola a jine, Ay m'ay meyo toonandi nda sabaabuyaŋ.
Woodin sabbay se, yaa no Rabbi Kundeykoyo ci: A go, ay ga ba k'i gooji. I sahã kooney, takuba g'i wi. I ize arey da ize wayey mo, haray g'i wi.
Saaya din alfaga beero Azariya da alfagey kulu n'a guna, a go, kala jiraytaray fatta a sukuto gaa. I n'a tuti da cahã yaŋ. Oho, nga bumbo te waasi ka fatta, zama Rabbi n'a ham.
Sahã adin-sahã adin bonkoono na nga doogari fo donton. A n'a lordi ka ne a ma kande Yohanna boŋo. A koy mo k'a boŋo kaa kaso ra,
Ay ga farhã mo Urusalima sabbay se, Ya te bine kaani mo ay jama sabbay se. I si ye ka maa hẽ eni jinde wala kaatiyaŋ jinde a ra koyne.
I n'a gurzugandi k'a taabandi, Kulu nda yaadin a mana nga meyo fiti. Sanda feej'ize kaŋ i ga konda ka wi, Wala sanda feeji nya kaŋ go ga dangay nga hamni hõ sekoy jine, Yaadin cine no a mana nga meyo fiti.
Nga mo, a kay a boŋ. A deeni konno gaa kala konno n'a taŋ. Sahã adin waybora tun k'i saajaw.
A go no binde, ay goono ga dira, hal ay maan Damaskos, sanda zaari sance cine. Kala sahã adin, kaari bambata fo fun beene ka nyaale ay windanta.
Alwaato din gaa Yehu na tira hantum sorro hinkanta ka koy i do ka ne: "D'araŋ go ay banda, d'araŋ ga hangan ay sanno se mo, kal araŋ ma borey din, araŋ jine bora izey, boŋey kaa. Araŋ ma kaa ay do suba mã sancine Yezreyel ra." Bonkoono izey mo, ngey boro wayye no, i go kwaara boro beerey banda, ngey kaŋ yaŋ n'i biiri.
Koyne, ni di iri kaayey kankamo Misira laabo ra, ni maa i hẽ eno mo Teeku Cira me gaa.
Ma-carare sahã kooney din binde furo Rahab windo ra. I na Rahab d'a baabo, d'a nyaŋo, d'a nya-ka-fo-siney, da hay kulu kaŋ go a se, d'a dumey kulu mo kaa taray. I n'i kaa taray k'i ye Israyla borey banda.
Sahã adin-sahã adin Rabbi malayka fo n'a kar, zama a mana Irikoy beerandi. Nooniyaŋ mo di k'a ŋwa kal a bu.
Waato kaŋ i goono ga maa hayey din, Yesu tonton ka misa fo ci i se, zama nga ga maan Urusalima, ngey mo go ga tammahã hala Irikoy koytara ga bangay sahã adin-sahã adin.
Absalom binde kaa bonkoono do ka ne: "Guna ay, ni tamo gonda feeji hamni hõ sekoyaŋ. Ay ga ni ŋwaaray, da bonkoono yadda, nga nda nga tamey kulu ma kaa ay, ni tamo banda."
Baa boro ga yadda nga ma kakaw d'a, Boro si hin ka tu a se baa ce fo hã ayaŋ zambar ra.
Kala a n'a feeri ay jine, a gonda hantum a ra d'a banda mo gaa. Haya kaŋ i hantum din, hẽ eni sanni, da bu baray, da bone koonu no.
Kala sahã adin, farka di Rabbi malayka kaŋ go fonda ra ga kay, da takuba foobante nga kambe ra. Farka binde kamba ka fonda taŋ ka koy faro ra. Kala Balaam na farka kar k'a ye fonda ra.
Koy Beero ciya danga konnako, a na Israyla gon k'a faadey kulu mo gon. A n'a wongu fuwey kulu bagu-bagu, Yahuda ize wayo se mo a naŋ bu baray da hẽ eni ma baa.
Sahã adin-sahã adin, Irikoy na baabo meyo fiti, a n'a deena taŋ mo, hal a salaŋ ka Irikoy sifa.
Kala sohõ kaŋ ay maa ni gonda feeji hamni hõ sekoyaŋ. Ni hawjiyey gay iri do, iri mana hay kulu te i se, hay kulu mana daray i se mo, alwaatey kulu kaŋ i go Karmel ra.
Rabbi ne Musa se: "Ma kaaru ka kaa ay do tondo ra ka goro noodin. Ay mo ga ni no tondi walhã yaŋ da asariya nda ganayaŋ sanney kaŋ yaŋ ay hantum zama ni ma jama dondonandi nd'a."
Sahã adin wayboro fo go no kaŋ a ize kayna gonda follay. Waato kaŋ a maa Yesu baaru, a kaa ka ye ganda Yesu jine.
Waato din gaa Dawda nda nga borey kulu kaŋ yaŋ go a banda na jinde sambu ka hẽ hal a to naŋ kaŋ i sinda baa hẽ eno gaabi koyne.
Zama araŋ si fatta nda cahã yaŋ, Araŋ si fatta nda zuray mo, Zama Rabbi ga koy araŋ jine. Israyla Irikoyo mo ga ciya kosaray araŋ se banda.
Ariyoku binde konda Daniyel bonkoono jine nda cahã yaŋ. Yaa mo no a ne a se: "Ay du boro fo Yahuda tamtaray izey ra kaŋ ga bonkoono bayrandi nda feerijo."
I furo Kafarnahum kwaara. Sahã adin-sahã adin Yesu furo Yahudance diina marga * fuwo ra asibti zaari fo hane ka dondonandi.
